title: AI and The Enclosure of the Scientific Commons
background_knowledge: 本文不属于天文学实证分支，而属于科学社会学、科研基础设施治理与人工智能政策交叉领域。其核心背景是：科学文献可被视为一种“信息公地”（information commons）——由共同体共同生产、共享使用、原则上不归私人独占的知识资源。在天文学中，文献、星表、观测数据与软件工具同样构成典型的共享知识基础设施。历史上，英格兰等地的农业公地曾由社区按习俗共同使用；经济学与政治学由此发展出公地治理、公地悲剧等框架。但公地消失的主因常被归结为“圈地运动”（enclosure movement，约 1600—1800 年），即把公共土地转为私人产权，而非单纯的过度使用。与此类似，开放科学依赖论文、数据、代码、同行评议和引用网络等共享基础设施；生成式 AI 可大规模抓取、重组和生成文本，可能把公共知识转化为私人或平台价值，并通过低质量批量内容（“slop spam”）污染文献生态、侵蚀信任与可发现性。理解这些历史与理论框架，有助于评估 AI 对科学公地的结构性影响。
contribution: 文章首先梳理公地治理与英国圈地运动的历史和理论，指出信息公地与历史上的农业公地不同：前者极具价值且具有韧性，后者已基本消失；其消失的关键并非众所周知的“公地悲剧”，而是把公地转为私有产权的圈地运动。作者进而提出，**人工智能恰好提供了实现信息公地“圈地”的技术工具**：AI 使原本不可行的大规模知识提取与私有化成为可能。虽然 AI 圈地与物理圈地并不完全相同，但二者共享关键特征——**把公共资源转化为私人财富，并借助“slop spam”等机制削弱支撑公地的社会系统**。文章认为，这一分析可为审视“AI 可能不只是攫取资源，而是攻击一种生活方式”的不安感提供学术基础。
summary: The scientific literature can be viewed as an "information commons:" an intangible resource that "no one owns and is shared by everyone." There are well-established economic and political frameworks for understanding such commons, emerging from the history of agricultural common lands found in places like preindustrial England. This article provides a primer on the history and these frameworks, and considers a key difference between the information commons and the fields of yore: while information commons are robust and immensely valuable --- some can be said to rank among humanity's greatest achievements --- the English agricultural commons no longer meaningfully exist. The latter are gone not because of the well-known "tragedy of the commons," but rather a phenomenon known as the enclosure movement (~1600--1800) that transformed the common lands into private property. Many observers, then and now, judge enclosure to have been theft at a societal scale. This article argues that artificial intelligence (AI) provides precisely the tools needed to enable a previously-infeasible enclosure of the information commons. Although AI-enabled enclosure does not operate identically to physical enclosure, it shares the key features of turning the commons into private wealth and undermining the social systems that support them (via "slop spam"). The concepts presented in this article can provide a scholarly basis for interrogating the foreboding feeling that AI may represent not just a smash-and-grab, but an attack upon a whole way of life.

title: Twenty-five years of XMM-Newton EPIC-MOS2 Unfocused Particle Background: Solar Cycle Modulation, Galactic Cosmic-Ray Correlation, and Implications for NewAthena
background_knowledge:
高能天体物理中的 X 射线观测依赖空间望远镜上的 CCD 探测器，例如 XMM-Newton 的 EPIC-MOS。探测器记录的光子事件中，除来自天体的聚焦 X 射线外，还混有由高能粒子（银河宇宙线、太阳高能粒子以及次级粒子）在探测器及卫星结构中沉积能量产生的非聚焦背景。这类粒子背景通常不随指向变化，可用视场外（out-of-field-of-view，outFOV）区域进行监测，是 X 射线弱源、弥散源和星系团外围等研究中的关键系统误差来源。
\n银河宇宙线进入日球层后受到太阳风与行星际磁场的调制：太阳活动增强时，日球层磁场更强、更湍动，低能宇宙线进入内日球层的通量下降，因此地面与空间探测器看到的宇宙线计数率呈现约 11 年太阳活动周变化；太阳磁场每约 22 年完成一次极性反转，形成 Hale 周期。太阳自转（约 27 天）也会通过共转相互作用区等结构在宇宙线通量中留下准周期信号。理解这些时变规律，是把仪器背景与真实天体信号区分开、建立长期背景模型并服务未来 X 射线任务（如 NewAthena）的基础。
contribution: 该工作利用 XMM-Newton EPIC-MOS2 约二十五年（至 2025 年底）的视场外粒子背景数据，系统研究非聚焦背景的长期演化，并与银河宇宙线的独立示踪量进行比对。结果显示，MOS2 outFOV 计数率与 AMS 质子通量之间存在极紧的相关，**内禀弥散仅约 1.1%**，表明非聚焦背景的变化主要由银河宇宙线通量驱动。长基线数据清晰呈现太阳活动周调制以及 **22 年 Hale 周期**的特征信号；Lomb-Scargle 分析给出 **11.28 年**的主周期，结构函数与小波分析则揭示与太阳自转相关的持续 **约 27 天**调制。作者还确认存在一个不随银河宇宙线通量成比例变化的残余背景成分，与以往研究一致，可能来自高能 X 射线的康普顿散射光子。该研究把 MOS2 粒子背景置于银河宇宙线研究框架中，并为 NewAthena 等未来 X 射线任务的背景监测与抑制策略提供直接依据。
summary: We present a study of the unfocused particle-induced background measured by the XMM-Newton EPIC-MOS2 detector, extending previous analyses to the end of 2025 and covering approximately twenty-five years of observations. Using out-of-field-of-view (outFOV) data, we investigate the long-term evolution of the particle background over two complete solar cycles and compare it with independent tracers of the Galactic cosmic-rays. We find an extremely tight correlation between the MOS2 outFOV count rate and the AMS proton flux, with an intrinsic scatter of only about 1.1\%, confirming that variations in the unfocused background are primarily driven by changes in the Galactic cosmic-rays flux. The extended temporal baseline clearly reveals the modulation associated with the solar cycle and the characteristic signatures of the 22 year Hale cycle. A Lomb-Scargle analysis identifies a dominant periodicity at 11.28 yr, while structure-function and wavelet analyses reveal a persistent $\sim$27 day modulation associated with solar rotation. We also confirm the presence of a residual background component that does not scale with the Galactic cosmic-ray flux, consistent with previous studies and possibly associated with Compton-scattered high-energy X-ray photons. This work places the particle-induced background measured by the XMM-Newton EPIC-MOS2 detector in the broader context of Galactic cosmic-ray studies, while also providing direct implications for the development of background-monitoring and mitigation strategies for future X-ray missions such as \textit{NewAthena}.

title: Dual and lensed AGN at sub-arcsecond separations uncovered by ERIS
background_knowledge:
超大质量黑洞普遍存在于大质量星系中心，其质量与宿主星系核球性质（如恒星速度弥散）之间存在紧密的经验关联，暗示黑洞的吸积增长与星系演化相互耦合。在等级结构形成的框架下，星系通过并合不断增长，因此并合过程中两个星系中心的黑洞应当先形成束缚的双黑洞系统，最终通过引力波辐射并合；这一过程是脉冲星计时阵列与未来空间引力波探测器的重要探测目标。双 AGN（在 kpc 量级投影间距上同时观测到两个正在吸积的黑洞）被视为这一演化链条的早期阶段，其数目与间距分布可直接检验星系并合率与黑洞增长模型。
\n然而，观测上证认双 AGN 极为困难。一方面，kpc 级物理间距在高红移处对应亚角秒甚至更小的角距离，常规成像与单缝光谱往往把两个源混合成一个点源；另一方面，并合系统常伴随大量气体与尘埃，光学波段被严重遮蔽，因此需要在近红外波段并借助自适应光学（AO）达到接近衍射极限的空间分辨率。积分视场单元（IFU）光谱是理想工具：它同时给出每个空间像素的光谱，可以从空间上分离各成分，并通过发射线（如氢复合线、$[\mathrm{O\,III}]$、$\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 与 $[\mathrm{N\,II}]$ 等）测量各自的红移、速度差、线宽与流量比，从而判断某一成分是 AGN、恒星还是恒星形成区，并区分物理上成团的系统与视线方向的偶然投影。ERIS（Enhanced Resolution Imager and Spectrograph）是 ESO 甚大望远镜上的新一代近红外仪器，其 SPIFFIER 积分视场光谱仪在激光导星 AO 模式下工作，视场约 $0.8''\times0.8''$，低分辨率光栅下 $R \sim 5000$，正适合对亚角秒间距的暗弱多重源逐个做光谱分解。
\n候选体的高效选取同样关键。Gaia 的天体测量在沿扫描方向上具有优于 0.1 角秒的角分辨率；当两个光学亮源在约 0.1–1 角秒内成对出现时，Gaia 的窗口扫描会呈现多峰信号，由此发展出的 Gaia Multi-Peak（GMP）方法能够从 Gaia DR3 中系统地挑出亚角秒间距的明亮、未被遮蔽的 AGN 候选体，其效率远高于传统的颜色或变光筛选。
\n但 GMP 样本中混有大量假阳性。其一是 AGN 与前景恒星的偶然叠加：恒星为点源，光谱呈连续谱加吸收线，没有宽发射线；其二是强引力透镜类星体——透镜产生的多重像在成像上同样表现为亚角秒间距的多个点源，其光谱几乎完全相同、红移一致、速度差近乎为零，与通常具有数百 $\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ 速度差及不同光谱特征的物理双 AGN 形成对照。因此，唯有借助高空间分辨率的近红外 IFU 光谱，才能在同一数据集内同时完成双 AGN 证认与透镜系统证认，并定量估计样本的污染率。
contribution:
本文报告了 INAF GTO 项目利用 ESO 甚大望远镜（VLT）上的 ERIS 近红外积分视场单元 SPIFFIER 系统搜寻亚角秒双 AGN 的首批成果。观测在激光导星自适应光学模式下进行，使用低分辨率光栅（$R \sim 5000$–$5600$），对 34 个多重 AGN 候选体进行了积分视场光谱观测；这些候选体由 Gaia DR3 星表通过 Gaia Multi-Peak（GMP）方法选出，该方法优先识别亚角秒间距下明亮的、未被遮蔽的 AGN。目标红移跨度为 $0.7 < z < 3.4$，投影角间距约 $0.2''$–$0.9''$，对应物理间距约 1.7–7.8 kpc。
\n在 34 个被观测系统中，**13 个（约 40%）被分辨为多个类 AGN 成分**；18 个（约 53%）被判定为 AGN 与前景恒星的叠加；1 个为单一 AGN；另有 2 个为 AGN 主源加一个未能分类的次源。在多重 AGN 系统中，作者**确认了 6 个双 AGN，投影间距为 $0.26''$–$0.80''$（2.2–6.7 kpc），红移范围 $z = 0.68$–$1.57$，速度差 $\Delta v \sim 290$–$950\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$**。同时，作者**新发现 7 个引力透镜类星体，其中仅 1 个此前已知，包括 4 个双像系统和 3 个四像系统**。上述结果**显著扩充了 $z > 0.5$ 处经光谱证认的致密多重 AGN 系统样本**，并证明了 ERIS-SPIFFIER 在系统性刻画亚角秒双 AGN 与透镜 AGN 候选体方面的高效性。
summary: We present the first results of the ongoing INAF GTO program focused on the search of sub-arcsecond dual AGN, carried out with the near-infrared integral-field unit SPIFFIER of the Enhanced Resolution Imager and Spectrograph (ERIS) at the ESO Very Large Telescope, operating in adaptive-optics mode with a laser guide star. We report integral field spectroscopy with the low-resolution gratings (R ~ 5000 - 5600) of 34 multiple AGN candidates selected from the Gaia Data Release 3 source catalog via the Gaia Multi-Peak (GMP) method, which preferentially identifies luminous unobscured AGN at sub-arcsecond separations. The targets span the redshift range 0.7 < z < 3.4 and exhibit projected angular separations between ~0.2'' and ~0.9'', corresponding to physical separations of ~1.7-7.8 kpc. Of the 34 observed systems,13 (~40 %) are resolved into multiple AGN-like components; 18 (~53 %) are classified as AGN plus foreground star superpositions, one as a single AGN, and two as systems with an AGN primary and an unclassified secondary component. Among the multiple AGN systems, we confirm six dual AGN at projected separations of 0.26'' - 0.80'' (2.2 - 6.7 kpc), in the redshift range z = 0.68 - 1.57, and with velocity offsets in the range Δv ~ 290 - 950 km/s. We also identify seven gravitationally lensed quasars, only one of which was previously known, including four doubly imaged and three quadruply imaged systems. These results substantially enlarge the census of spectroscopically confirmed compact multiple AGN systems at z > 0.5 and demonstrate the efficiency of ERIS-SPIFFIER for the systematic characterization of sub-arcsecond dual and lensed AGN candidates.

title: Deglobalising the fit: how to search for physics beyond vacuum General Relativity in LISA catalogues
background_knowledge: 该工作属于 LISA 引力波数据分析与广义相对论检验的交叉方向。LISA 是计划中的空间激光干涉引力波天文台，将在毫赫兹（mHz）频段观测大质量黑洞双星并合、极端质量比旋近（EMRI）、银河系致密双星和随机引力波背景等。其数据中大量信号在时域和频域相互重叠，预计可达约 $10^{7}$ 个。这要求采用全局拟合（global fit），同时推断所有源的参数并给出后验分布。检验广义相对论（General Relativity，简称 GR）的常用范式，是将观测到的引力波应变与 GR 波形模板比较；偏离可表现为相位演化、振幅、偏振、传播速度或铃宕（ringdown）等。若把偏离参数化，则可通过贝叶斯模型比较或零检验（null tests）给出偏离幅度及置信上限。真空广义相对论假设源附近没有额外物质场，也没有 GR 之外的自由度；超出真空 GR 的效应可能来自修改引力、额外极化、环境物质或波形未建模细节。LISA 的挑战在于信号高度重叠，单源分析不再适用，必须进行联合全局拟合；而针对每一种超出真空 GR 的模型重新运行全局拟合，计算成本极高。两步后处理策略先用真空模型做一次全局拟合，再减掉其他源，对选定的目标源在非真空模型下复核。其隐含前提是第一步拟合不会把目标源的新物理吸收到其他源中；但重叠信号之间的相关性会破坏这一前提。
contribution: 论文指出，在两步后处理策略中，**目标源中超出真空广义相对论的效应会被第一步真空全局拟合中的重叠冗余源部分吸收，并随这些源一起被减掉，从而无法进入复核阶段。** 在线性信号近似下，这种损失由单一数字——掩蔽比（masking ratio） $\mathcal{R}\in[0,1]$ ——刻画。**全局拟合本可达到的 $n_{\sigma}$ 显著性，在后处理中只会以 $\mathcal{R}\,n_{\sigma}$ 报告；零检验得到的上限也会以同一因子被报告得过紧。** 作者给出从真空全局拟合的后验样本计算 $\mathcal{R}$ 的方法，并设计了按吸收能力排序冗余源的算法：先找出与目标源效应最相关的少数源，只将这些源与目标源一起放入降规模复核。随后，他们用由 21 个重叠啁啾正弦信号组成的玩具模型和完整的 Markov-chain Monte Carlo（MCMC）推断进行验证：其中一个信号携带小的非线性啁啾，代表被遗漏的物理，其余 20 个信号充当冗余源。**该结果确立了在 LISA 目录中做超出真空 GR 检验时必须校正掩蔽损失的关键点，并提供了可操作的校正与源排序流程。** 该方法可作为在真实 LISA 模拟数据中开展 GR 检验的基础，也可推广到研究不同引力波源之间系统误差的影响。
summary: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna will observe up to $\sim 10^{7}$ overlapping signals, which have to be characterised simultaneously with a global fit. This is a challenge for model comparison since rerunning the global fit for every physical model of interest, including deviations from vacuum General Relativity, is computationally demanding. An alternative is a two-step post-processing strategy: a first global fit with vacuum models only, after which a selected group of target sources is reanalysed under a different model with all other sources subtracted. We show that in this strategy a beyond-vacuum effect in a target source can be partly absorbed by the overlapping nuisance sources in the first fit, subtracted with them, and never reach the reanalysis. In the linear-signal approximation, the loss is captured by a single number, the masking ratio $\mathcal{R}\in[0,1]$. A deviation the global fit would detect at $n_σ$ is reported by post-processing at $\mathcal{R}\,n_σ$, and bounds in null tests are also reported too tight by the same factor. We show how to compute $\mathcal{R}$ from the posterior samples of the vacuum global fit, and give an algorithm that ranks the nuisance sources by how much of the effect each can absorb, so that only those most correlated with it need to be refitted with the target in a down-scaled reanalysis with a few sources. We validate our method with full Markov-chain Monte Carlo inference on a toy model of 21 overlapping chirping sinusoids, where one carries a small non-linear chirp that represents the missed physics, while the other 20 act as nuisance sources. This method can serve as a basis for tests of General Relativity in realistic LISA mock datasets and can be adapted to study the impact of systematics between different gravitational-wave sources.

title: The science case for an in-situ measurement platform in the Venus clouds
background_knowledge: 金星是类地行星，大小与地球相近，但经历了失控温室效应：地表温度约 464 ℃、气压约 92 bar，并被浓厚的二氧化碳大气和硫酸云层包裹。金星云层在约 50–70 km 高度范围内温度与气压相对温和，理论上可处于宜居带，但其化学环境极端，云粒成分、垂直输运、光化学循环及潜在宜居性仍存在重大未知。金星火山活动与地质重塑历史也直接关系到其气候演化，而金星可作为理解系外类金星行星的重要类比对象。早期 2030 年代的遥感任务将提供大气、表面与地质的新观测，但云层化学、云粒和局部大气结构的原位测量仍需空中平台完成。
contribution: 该白皮书面向 UKSA Space Frontiers 2035 programme，论证在早期 2030 年代遥感任务之后，金星探测的关键下一步应是**原位空中平台**，即金星版本的火星车。文章指出，复杂金星气球技术已处于研发中，**英国可凭借该技术作为双边合作伙伴参与未来金星任务**，以回答金星火山与地质历史、金星云层潜在宜居性，以及金星作为系外行星类比对象等核心科学问题。其核心贡献是系统提出并论证这一原位测量平台的科学案例与任务定位，而非报告新的观测结果。
summary: The next step for Venus exploration after the remote sensing missions of the early 2030s will be in-situ aerial platforms, the Venus equivalent of rovers for Mars. Sophisticated Venus balloon technology is already under development and presents an opportunity for the United Kingdom to act as a bilateral partner in missions exploring key questions about the volcanic and geological history of Venus, the potential habitability of the Venus clouds, and Venus as an analogue for exoplanets. White paper written for the UKSA Space Frontiers 2035 programme.

title: Inferring the shapes of low-mass galaxies at $z>6$ from FIREbox$^{HR}$. Where are the disks?
background_knowledge: 星系的三维形状是理解其形成与演化的重要线索。在冷暗物质宇宙学框架下，星系由暗物质晕中的气体冷却、恒星形成、并合与反馈过程塑造；盘状、椭球状与三轴结构反映了角动量、并合历史和重子物理之间的竞争。在 $z>6$ 的高红移低质量星系处于早期星系形成阶段，观测上通常只能得到投影天球上的半光半径、轴比与表面亮度分布，而本征轴比、三轴性和本征大小需通过群体分布假设进行贝叶斯前向建模推断。常用假设包括轴比分布、椭球或三轴参数化以及本征大小分布；若群体模型不符合真实星系，推断可能产生偏差。JWST/NIRCam 提供高红移星系的深场成像，模拟星表与 mock 图像可用于检验这些推断方法。FIREbox$^{HR}$ 等宇宙学流体模拟提供恒星粒子的三维信息，可作为真值基准。投影轴比 $q$ 与本征大小 $\log a$ 的联合分布携带形状信息，是连接模拟与观测的关键统计量。
contribution: 论文分析 FIREbox$^{HR}$ 中红移 $z\sim6-15$ 且恒星质量 $\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=6.5-9.5$ 的星系，使用最小协方差行列式（MCD）估计器从恒星粒子测量本征形状；并生成 mock JWST/NIRCam 图像，测量半光半径与投影轴比，从投影轴比 $q$ 与大小 $\log a$ 的联合分布推断本征分布。结果显示，**低质量星系以长椭球（prolate）为主，并含有显著球状成分**；本征椭率 $E$ 与三轴性 $T$ 可由 Johnson SB 分布很好描述，本征大小 $A$ 近似对数正态。作者因此用多元正态分布建模 $(\mathrm{logit}(E),\mathrm{logit}(T),\log A)$ 并允许一般相关性。该模型比在 $(E,T,\log A)$ 中使用多元正态的模型更忠实地恢复粒子测量的形状分布；**三轴性相关参数在无大样本或信息先验时仍难以由投影数据约束**。结论指出，当群体模型充分描述底层星系时，贝叶斯前向建模可恢复本征形状分布；**不合适的分布会偏置高红移形态演化的推断**。
summary:
Context. The three-dimensional shapes of galaxies provide clues to their formation and evolution. Inferring intrinsic shapes from projected sizes and axis ratios requires assumptions about the population distribution of shape parameters.
  Aims. We test commonly adopted assumptions in Bayesian shape inference for high-redshift galaxies.
  Methods. We analyze FIREboxHR galaxies with $\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=6.5-9.5$ at $z\sim6-15$. We measure intrinsic shapes from stellar particles using the minimum covariance determinant (MCD) estimator. We also create mock JWST/NIRCam images, measure half-light radii and axis ratios, and infer intrinsic distributions from the joint distribution of projected axis ratio $q$ and size $\log a$.
  Results. Low-mass galaxies are predominantly prolate, with a substantial spheroidal component. Intrinsic ellipticity $E$ and triaxiality $T$ are well described by Johnson SB distributions, while intrinsic size $A$ is approximately log-normal. We therefore model $(\mathrm{logit}(E),\mathrm{logit}(T),\log A)$ with a multivariate normal distribution and allow general correlations. This model recovers the particle-measured shape distributions more faithfully than a multivariate normal model in $(E,T,\log A)$. Triaxiality-related parameters remain difficult to constrain from projected data without large samples or informative priors.
  Conclusions. Bayesian forward modeling can recover intrinsic shape distributions when its population model adequately describes the underlying galaxies. An unsuitable distribution can bias inferences about morphological evolution at high redshift.

title: Probing the Optical/UV Continuum Variability of Active Galactic Nuclei with the Damped Random Walk Model
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积物质驱动，其光学/紫外连续谱主要来自黑洞周围几何薄、光学厚的吸积盘。理解吸积盘结构、温度分布和黏滞机制是 AGN 物理的核心问题之一。观测上，AGN 连续谱在数天到数年尺度上表现随机亮度变化，常被描述为阻尼随机游走（DRW）：用特征阻尼时标 $\tau$ 和振幅 $\sigma$ 概括光变，前者可能与吸积盘热时标有关，从而携带黑洞质量 $M_{\rm BH}$、吸积率和盘半径等信息。研究范式通常包括：由长时间基线、多波段测光获得光变曲线；用 DRW 拟合提取参数并控制红移、光度、测光误差和选择效应；再将 $\tau$、$\sigma$ 与黑洞质量、无量纲吸积率 $\dot{\mathscr{M}}$、质量吸积率 $\dot{M}$ 等做标度关系分析；并结合标准薄盘模型和微引力透镜测得的盘尺寸，推断黏滞参数 $\alpha$ 与盘温度剖面。
contribution: 论文利用 Y. Shen 等和 C. J. Burke 等汇编的 1214 个 AGN，在最长约 20 yr 的光学/紫外连续谱光变基线上检验 DRW 模型；其中 115 个具有可靠且无偏 DRW 参数（静止系 2500 Å 处的时标 $\tau_{2500}$ 与振幅 $\sigma_{2500}$）的样本用于研究光变与吸积性质的关系。作者发现 **$\tau_{2500}$ 与黑洞质量 $M_{\rm BH}$ 和无量纲吸积率 $\dot{\mathscr{M}}$ 显著相关**，标度关系为 $\tau_{2500} \propto M_{\rm BH}^{0.50\pm0.07} \dot{\mathscr{M}}^{0.27\pm0.04}$；在控制 $M_{\rm BH}$ 后，5100 Å 连续谱光度和红移的依赖不再显著。$\tau_{2500}$ 也与质量吸积率 $\dot{M}$ 相关，$\tau_{2500} \propto \dot{M}^{0.41\pm0.04}$，与标准薄盘模型预期的热时标在 $3\sigma$ 不确定度内一致；其平均值符合模型预期，而关系中的弥散可能来自黏滞参数 $\alpha$ 或盘温度剖面的差异。若将 $\tau_{\rm UV}$ 视为吸积盘热时标，则静止系 2500 Å 的盘发射半径 $R_{2500}$ 与 $M_{\rm BH}$ 满足 $R_{2500} \propto M_{\rm BH}^{0.53\pm0.05}$；结合 C. W. Morgan 等基于微引力透镜的 $R_{2500}$ 与 $M_{\rm BH}$ 关系，统计估计出 **$\alpha = 0.04\pm0.01$**。
summary: Optical/UV continuum variability over baselines of up to 20 yr is investigated using the damped random walk (DRW) model for 1214 active galactic nuclei (AGNs) compiled from Y. Shen et al. and C. J. Burke et al. Among these, 115 AGNs with reliable DRW fitting and unbiased DRW parameters (timescale $τ_{2500}$ and amplitude $σ_{2500}$ at the rest-frame 2500~Å) are used to examine the relations between the variability and the accretion properties. We found a significant correlation of $τ_{2500}$ with black hole mass ($M_{\rm BH}$) and dimensionless accretion rate ($\dot{\mathscr{M}}$) of the form $τ_{2500} \propto M_{\rm BH}^{0.50\pm0.07} \dot{\mathscr{M}}^{0.27\pm0.04}$, while the dependence on the continuum luminosity at 5100~Å and redshift becomes insignificant after controlling for $M_{\rm BH}$. $τ_{2500}$ also correlate with the mass accretion rate ($\dot{M}$) as $τ_{2500} \propto \dot{M}^{0.41\pm0.04}$, which is consistent with the thermal timescale expected from the standard thin-disk model within $3σ$ uncertainties; while the average value is consistent with the expectations of the model, the scatter in the relation can be due to differences in the viscosity parameter ($α$) or in disk temperature profiles. Assuming that \tauuv\ corresponds to the accretion disk thermal timescale, the disk-emitting radius at rest-frame 2500~Å ($R_{2500}$) is found to correlate with $M_{\rm BH}$ as $R_{2500} \propto M_{\rm BH}^{0.53\pm0.05}$. Using the microlensing-based $R_{2500}-M_{\rm BH}$ relation of C. W. Morgan et al., $α$ is statistically estimated to be $0.04\pm0.01$.

title: Probing Minihalos in the Late Dark Ages through Velocity Acoustic Oscillations in the 21-cm Power Spectrum
background_knowledge: 宇宙在复合之后进入黑暗时代：微波背景辐射温度持续下降，重子物质以中性氢为主，第一代恒星尚未点亮。中性氢基态超精细能级跃迁产生 21 cm 线；其观测信号取决于中性氢密度、自旋温度 $T_S$ 与辐射背景温度 $T_\gamma$ 的差异。若 $T_S<T_\gamma$，信号表现为吸收；若 $T_S>T_\gamma$，则表现为发射。小质量暗物质晕（minihalos，微晕）一旦高于 Jeans 质量，会从星系际介质（IGM）吸积气体；气体在引力势阱中激波加热到维里温度 $T_{\rm vir}$，可产生 21 cm 发射，而大部分仍留在 IGM 的冷气体产生吸收。由于 IGM 的体积填充因子远大于微晕，微晕信号通常被 IGM 信号掩盖。另一个关键背景是复合后残留的暗物质—重子相对速度流（streaming velocity）$v_{\rm bc}$：它在复合时具有超音速、相干的大尺度结构，会抑制低质量微晕的气体吸积，并把大尺度调制印刻到 21 cm 功率谱 $P_{21}(k)$ 上，形成速度声学振荡（VAO）。21 cm 功率谱测量是探测黑暗时代和宇宙黎明期间物质分布、辐射背景及小尺度暗物质结构的核心手段；干涉阵列的灵敏度由偶极子数量、基线分布、带宽与积分时间共同决定。
contribution: 论文提出并量化了利用晚黑暗时代 21 cm 功率谱中的 VAO 探测微晕的方案。作者指出，在尚未受到 Pop III 星辐射影响的区域，晚黑暗时代碰撞耦合已变弱，IGM 的 21 cm 信号较弱，从而减弱了对微晕信号的掩盖；更重要的是，残余的暗物质—重子超音速相对速度流会抑制较小微晕的气体吸积，并将其大尺度相干特征编码进 21 cm 信号，产生 VAO 特征。计算表明，在 $k=0.05\ \mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ 处，净 VAO 振荡的第一个峰在 $z\sim15$ 时约为 $1.4\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{mK}^2$，在 $z\sim20$ 时约为 $3.1\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{mK}^2$。**在总积分时间为 24 个月夜/8064 小时（60 个月夜/20160 小时）时，由 82944（278784）个偶极子组成、覆盖约 3.5（6.3）km 的阵列可以探测到 $z\sim15$（$z\sim20$）的信号。** 作者进一步指出，**若小尺度物质功率谱被增强、微晕数量显著多于标准 $\Lambda$CDM 模型，则可用更小尺度的阵列实现探测**。
summary: In the Dark Ages, minihalos above the Jeans mass accrete gas from the intergalactic medium (IGM). The accreted gas would be heated to virial temperature and produces 21 cm signal in emission, while the majority of gas retained in the IGM is cold and has 21 cm signal in absorption. The 21 cm signal of the IGM generally dominates over that of minihalos, making it difficult to extract the contribution of minihalos from the detected 21 cm signal. However, in the late Dark Ages, in regions where the gas has not yet been influenced by the radiation from Pop III stars, the 21 cm signal from the IGM is weak because collisional coupling has become less efficient. More importantly, the relic supersonic dark matter-baryon relative streaming velocities suppress the gas accretion of smaller minihalos and encode their large-scale coherent features into the 21 cm signal, generating the velocity acoustic oscillation (VAO) features on the 21 cm power spectrum. This offers a promising avenue for detecting minihalos. We found that, at $z\sim 15$ ($\sim 20$), the first peak of the net VAO wiggle at $k=0.05$ Mpc$^{-1}$ is $\sim 1.4\times 10^{-3}$ ($\sim 3.1\times 10^{-4}$) mK$^2$. With a total of 24 lunar nights/8064 hr (60 lunar nights/20160 hr) of integration, the signal from $z\sim 15$ ($\sim 20$) is detectable for an array composed of 82944 (278784) dipoles, spread over $\sim 3.5$ ($\sim 6.3$) km. If the small-scale matter power spectrum is enhanced and minihalos are much more numerous than in the standard $Λ$CDM model, the signal is detectable for an even smaller scale array.

title: Axion detection in the non-Markovian noise
background_knowledge: 暗物质与暗能量是当代宇宙学和粒子物理的核心问题。大量天文观测，包括星系旋转曲线、星系团动力学、宇宙微波背景和大尺度结构，表明宇宙中存在不发光且与电磁作用极弱的暗物质。轴子（axion）是一类重要的暗物质候选粒子，起源于解决强 CP 问题的理论框架，也可由弦论等超越标准模型理论预言；它与标准模型粒子的耦合通常极弱，因此直接探测需要极高灵敏度、低噪声和可控系统误差的实验方案。量子计量与量子传感利用自旋系综、超导电路或原子干涉等量子相干性来提升微弱信号探测能力，其中自旋系综可把外部极弱场或粒子耦合转化为可测量的自旋进动或能级响应。与此同时，真实传感器不可避免与环境耦合而产生耗散与退相干；传统分析常采用马尔可夫近似，把环境记忆忽略为瞬时噪声，但在结构化环境中非马尔可夫记忆效应和束缚态等能谱特征可显著改变噪声影响。理解复合量子系统能谱与噪声鲁棒性的关系，是设计下一代暗物质探测和超越标准模型物理搜索方案的关键背景。
contribution: 论文提出并研究了一种基于耦合 $^{129}$Xe 自旋系综的耐噪声量子计量方案，用于搜寻与标准模型粒子耦合极弱的轴子暗物质。**在实验可及参数范围内，该方案对轴子耦合常数给出的理想排除限比传统探测方法严格数个数量级。** 作者进一步分析耗散噪声下的方案性能，发现**其鲁棒性从根本上由复合自旋-环境系统的能谱结构决定**。特别地，**当能谱中出现束缚态时，非马尔可夫动力学下的排除限可渐近恢复理想值；而在马尔可夫近似下，该排除限会因噪声显著恶化**。这些结果**建立了一种通过调控自旋系综拉莫尔频率来工程化束缚态形成、从而实现噪声鲁棒的超越标准模型物理探索的普适机制**。
summary: The detection of axion dark matter poses a significant challenge due to its exceptionally weak coupling to standard-model particles. Here we develop a noise-tolerant quantum-metrology scheme based on coupled $^{129}$Xe spin ensembles to search for such weakly interacting particles. Within an experimentally accessible parameter regime, our scheme achieves an ideal exclusion limit on the axion coupling constant that is several orders of magnitude more stringent than that of conventional detection methods. We further investigate the performance of our scheme under dissipative noise and find that its robustness is fundamentally governed by the energy-spectrum structure of the composite spin-environment system. Remarkably, when a bound state emerges in the spectrum, the exclusion limit asymptotically recovers its ideal value in the non-Markovian dynamics, whereas under the Markovian approximation the limit deteriorates significantly due to noise. Our results establish a universal mechanism for noise-resilient exploration of beyond-standard-model physics, which can be practically implemented by engineering bound-state formation via tuning the Larmor frequency of the spin ensembles.

title: The T-matrix method for modeling the optical properties of grains in exoplanetary atmospheres
background_knowledge: 系外行星大气研究主要通过凌日透射谱、发射谱和反射光谱来推断大气的温度、压力、化学组成与云层性质。除气体外，凝聚相（云滴、尘埃和霾）会显著改变辐射传输：颗粒通过吸收和散射削弱沿视线传播的星光，其消光截面由成分、粒径、形状、孔隙率以及复折射率共同决定。正演模型在给定大气结构和颗粒光学常数的条件下计算光谱；反演模型则从观测光谱反推大气参数。传统上常把颗粒近似为球体，并用 Mie 理论快速计算其吸收与散射；但真实凝聚颗粒可能为非球形、团聚或多孔结构，因此需要更一般的电磁散射方法。T-matrix（跃迁矩阵）方法能够严格且高效地处理非球形颗粒在宽广尺寸和折射率范围内的消光问题，是把颗粒微物理与可观测光谱联系起来的重要工具。
contribution: 本文利用 T-matrix 方法计算镁橄榄石（forsterite）、尖晶石（spinel）和一氧化硅（silicon monoxide）颗粒从近红外到远红外的吸收与散射截面，系统比较不同粒径以及从由球体组成的致密集合体到多孔团聚体等不同形状的颗粒。结果显示，取决于粒径和构型，消光差异**可高达 2–3 倍**；对于大于 $1\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 的颗粒，结构复杂的颗粒在近红外是更有效的吸收体。在一个基准透射光谱中，在 $\lambda = 1$ 至 $5\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 范围内，为匹配结构复杂颗粒的贡献所需的球形材料量**可高出约 2 倍**。作者将相关计算通过 Zenodo 仓库向社区开放，并指出这些结果有助于解释当前和未来的系外行星大气观测。
summary: Observations of exoplanetary atmospheres have revealed a rather complex co-existence between the gaseous and condensed phases, ranging from atmospheres apparently covered in clouds to clear ones, across a myriad of intermediate regimes. The interaction between solids and stellar radiation is of fundamental importance when forward or retrieval models are compared to observations. The simplest approach is to assume spherical particles, whose scattering and absorption properties are readily computed with Mie theory. More advanced computational methods, however, can also treat non-spherical condensates. Among these, the transition matrix approach has proven to provide a rigorous and efficient calculation of the extinction by non-spherical particles over a broad range of sizes and refractive indices. We here focus on the absorption and scattering cross sections of forsterite, spinel and silicon monoxide from the near to the far infrared range for particles of different sizes, with shapes ranging from compact ensembles of spheres to porous aggregates. We find that, depending on the size and the configuration chosen, the differences in extinction can be as high as a factor of 2-3, with structured grains being more efficient absorbers in the near infrared for sizes greater than 1 $μ$m. In a fiducial transmission spectrum we show that in the $λ= 1-5\,μ$m range the amount of spherical material needed to match the contribution of the structured grains can be a factor 2 higher. Such calculations, available for the community through a Zenodo repository, prove to be useful for interpreting recent and future observations of exoplanetary atmospheres.

title: Pulsar J1909+0749 and Supernova Remnant G42.1-0.2: A case of a pulsar that has exited the shell of its associated supernova remnant
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星核心坍缩超新星爆发后，核心可留下快速自转、强磁场的中子星，即脉冲星；抛射物与周围星际介质相互作用形成超新星遗迹（SNR）。壳层型 SNR 的射电辐射通常由相对论电子在磁场中产生的同步辐射主导，因而具有幂律谱和非热谱指数。脉冲星诞生时可能获得 natal kick，具有高空间速度；当它运动到遗迹壳层之外时，可在遗迹外部表现为点源，并可能产生指向运动方向的弓激波或彗尾。判断脉冲星与 SNR 成协需综合角距离、距离、年龄、自行、射电谱指数和演化模型；其中色散量（DM）距离、特征年龄 $\tau_c=P/(2\dot{P})$ 与 Sedov-Taylor 模型均存在系统不确定性。
contribution: ATNF 脉冲星目录中仅 63 颗脉冲星可能与 SNR 成协，而脉冲星逃出遗迹壳层的案例更为罕见。论文把偶然发现的壳层型天体 G42.1-0.2 证认为超新星遗迹（SNR）。已知脉冲星 PSR J1909+0749 位于该壳层之外，但其彗尾指向 SNR 中心，作者据此 **提出两者起源于同一次超新星爆发，且脉冲星已逃出遗迹壳层**。他们测量了 G42.1-0.2 从 ${\sim}200~\mathrm{MHz}$ 到 ${\sim}6~\mathrm{GHz}$ 的流量密度，得到射电谱指数 $\alpha=-0.36\pm0.08$，**确认其辐射主要为非热同步辐射**。自行测量约束不强，但幅度和方向与成协解释一致。若脉冲星的特征年龄和 DM 距离分别代表真实年龄和真实距离，则标准演化方程表明 SNR 仍处于 Sedov-Taylor 阶段，环境密度约为 1.5 cm$^{-3}$；由成协关系推得 PSR J1909+0749 的横向速度约为 1460 km s$^{-1}$，**位居银河系已测脉冲星横向速度的最高之列**。
summary: (Abridged) The ATNF pulsar catalogue features only 63 pulsars that are possibly associated with a supernova remnant (SNR). Even rarer is the scenario in which the pulsar has escaped the physical extent of its corresponding SNR. We aim to identify the serendipitously discovered shell-type object G42.1-0.2 as a SNR. The known pulsar (PSR) J1909+0749 lies well outside the shell of SNR G42.1-0.2, but it has a cometary tail pointing towards the centre of the SNR; we propose that the SNR and the pulsar originated from the same supernova explosion. By measuring the flux densities of the shell G42.1-0.2 from ${\sim}$200 MHz to ${\sim}$6 GHz, we establish the nonthermal nature of its emission. With the characteristic age of the pulsar, its distance from the Sun estimated from the dispersion measure (DM), and the angular separation between the pulsar and the centre of the shell, we infer the evolutionary state of the SNR and the transverse velocity of the pulsar. Using proper motion measurements, we compare the SNR-pulsar direction with the velocity of the pulsar. The radio spectral index of the shell is $-0.36 \pm 0.08$, confirming that the emission is primarily nonthermal synchrotron. The proper motion measurements are not well constrained, but the amplitude and the direction are consistent with the interpretation that the SNR and the pulsar are associated. If the characteristic age and the DM-based distance represent the true age and the true distance of the pulsar and the SNR, then the standard evolution equations suggest that the SNR must still be in the Sedov-Taylor phase, evolving in a medium with a density of about 1.5 cm$^{-3}$. In addition, as a result of the PSR-SNR association, the transverse velocity of the pulsar PSR J1909+0749 is estimated to be ${\sim}1460~\mathrm{km\,s}^{-1}$, ranking it among the highest transverse velocities observed for pulsars in the Milky Way.

title: Kinematically isolating intracluster light in AS1063: a distinct stellar population tracing the dark matter core
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中由暗物质主导的最大引力束缚系统，其中包含大量高温团内气体和数百至上千个星系。团星系在并合、潮汐剥离和动力学摩擦等过程中会将部分恒星抛入星系团内空间，形成弥漫且无自引力束缚的团内光（intracluster light，ICL）。最亮团星系（brightest cluster galaxy，BCG）通常位于星系团势阱中心，与 ICL 在空间上高度重叠，因此仅靠测光分解很难可靠区分二者。积分场光谱（integral-field spectroscopy，IFU）能够获得二维视向速度、速度弥散和恒星族参数分布，使研究者可依据运动学特征将 BCG 与 ICL 的恒星成分分离。暗物质晕的内区密度轮廓是检验暗物质模型的重要探针：冷暗物质模型在无重子影响时倾向于给出中心尖峰（cuspy）轮廓，而重子反馈、并合历史和暗物质粒子性质等可能形成中心有核（cored）轮廓。强引力透镜、恒星运动学和 ICL 表面亮度分布均可独立约束星系团内区的暗物质分布。MUSE 是安装在甚大望远镜（VLT）上的光学积分场光谱仪，适合对星系团中心区域进行宽视场、高信噪比的光谱成像观测。
contribution: 作者提出一种利用积分场光谱对最亮团星系（BCG）与团内光（ICL）进行运动学分离的方法，并将其应用于 Abell S1063 的 MUSE 数据，从而同时研究二者的恒星族差异和星系团内区暗物质晕轮廓。结果显示，BCG 与 ICL 均较年老（约 9 Gyr），但 **ICL 比 BCG 更贫金属，暗示二者具有不同的前身星系演化路径**。在 100 kpc 范围内，**ICL 占 BCG+ICL 恒星质量的 55%**，显著高于测光分解所得比例。BCG 与 ICL 具有不同的速度分布，且这些分布随半径近乎保持不变；**ICL 的速度弥散超过 BCG 的两倍**，二者视向速度偏移为 **86 ± 18 km/s**。二维 Sérsic 拟合给出 **ICL 质心相对 BCG 偏移 5.2 ± 1.5 kpc**。这些相空间偏移表明 **BCG 正在一个宽广的势阱极小值附近振荡**。此外，**ICL 表面亮度轮廓与假设中心有核暗物质晕的强引力透镜估计一致**；模拟表明，不同暗物质模型会系统性地改变暗物质晕内区轮廓。因此，将该方法应用于更大样本，可提供一条检验暗物质本质的互补途径，并同时揭示 ICL 的恒星起源。
summary: We present a technique using integral-field spectroscopy to kinematically isolate intracluster light (ICL) from the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG), enabling insights into their contrasting stellar populations and the inner dark matter halo profile. Applying this technique to MUSE data of Abell S1063, we find that both components are old (~9 Gyr), but the ICL is more metal-poor than the BCG, implying distinct progenitor pathways. Within 100 kpc, the ICL comprises 55 per cent of the BCG+ICL stellar mass - substantially more than inferred from photometric decompositions. The BCG and ICL possess distinct velocity distributions, which remain nearly constant with radius, with an ICL velocity dispersion more than twice that of the BCG, and a line-of-sight velocity offset of 86 +- 18 km/s. Two-dimensional Sérsic fits yield an ICL centroid offset of 5.2 +- 1.5 kpc from the BCG. These phase-space offsets are indicative of the BCG oscillating in a broad potential minimum. Furthermore, the ICL surface-brightness profile matches that of strong-lensing estimates assuming a cored halo. Simulations indicate that the inner halo profile varies systematically for different dark matter models. Applied to larger samples, our method therefore offers a complementary route to testing the nature of dark matter, while simultaneously revealing the stellar origins of the ICL.

title: Resolving the extended interstellar medium of infrared galaxies II. Fine-structure line emission
background_knowledge: 红外星系中的恒星形成与活动星系核（AGN）活动发生在高尘埃遮蔽环境中，紫外与光学辐射被尘埃吸收后主要在红外波段再辐射。研究这类系统的星际介质（ISM）需要借助可穿透尘埃的红外细结构谱线：中红外（MIR）高激发离子线（如 [Ne III]、[Ne II]）主要追踪 H II 区以及 AGN 硬辐射场；远红外（FIR）低激发线（如 [C II]、[O I]）则来自电离气体与光致离解区（PDR），是探测中性气体、分子云界面和多相气体冷却的关键。谱线比值对电离参数、气体密度、辐射场硬度、恒星年龄和金属丰度敏感，因此常与 CLOUDY 等光致电离模型比较，反演 ISM 的物理状态。近邻亮红外星系（LIRGs）与超亮红外星系（ULIRGs）是研究星暴和 AGN 如何塑造多相 ISM 的理想实验室；空间分辨光谱可避免星系积分谱把核区、星暴环和延展盘混合在一起，从而揭示径向梯度与 AGN 的影响范围。
contribution: 论文利用 GOALS 样本中 67 个近邻亮红外/超亮红外星系，将 Spitzer 红外光谱仪（IRS）的 MIR 光谱映射与 Herschel 光电探测器阵列相机和光谱仪（PACS）的 FIR 光谱结合，在延伸到约 14 kpc 的孔径网格中测量细结构发射线，并与 CLOUDY 光致电离模型比较，约束电离参数、氢密度、恒星年龄和金属丰度。对星暴主导星系，MIR+FIR 联合拟合给出**电离参数随半径下降、氢密度近似恒定、星族年轻且均匀、金属丰度剖面平坦**；而仅用 MIR 拟合会得到电离参数随半径上升的趋势，说明包含 [C II] 等 PDR 诊断的 FIR 数据对约束多相气体至关重要。对最强 AGN 主导系统，核区及内延展区呈现**升高的 [Ne III]/[Ne II] 和受抑制的 [C II]/[O I]**，而约 6 kpc 以外的外区恢复为恒星形成区的典型值，暗示**AGN 可能影响约 5 kpc 范围内的气体激发**。这些结果表明，联合 MIR 与 FIR 诊断能够恢复被星系积分测量掩盖的径向趋势，并与 Paper I 一起为星暴和含 AGN 星系中气体与尘埃的空间分辨研究提供基准。
summary: We investigate how star formation and active galactic nuclei (AGNs) shape the ionized and neutral interstellar medium in 67 nearby luminous and ultraluminous infrared galaxies from the Great Observatories All-sky LIRG Survey (GOALS). Combining mid-infrared (MIR) spectral mapping from the Spitzer Infrared Spectrograph with far-infrared (FIR) spectroscopy from the Herschel Photodetector Array Camera and Spectrometer, we measure fine-structure emission lines in aperture grids extending to projected galactocentric distances of about 14 kpc. We compare the measurements with CLOUDY photoionization models to constrain the ionization parameter, hydrogen density, stellar age, and metallicity. In starburst-dominated galaxies, the combined MIR+FIR fits yield a decreasing ionization parameter with radius, approximately constant hydrogen densities, uniformly young stellar populations, and flat metallicity profiles. MIR-only fits instead yield an increasing ionization parameter with radius, highlighting the importance of FIR diagnostics, particularly the [C II] emission associated with photodissociation regions, in constraining the multiphase gas. In the strongest AGN-dominated system, the nucleus and inner extended regions show elevated [Ne III]/[Ne II] and suppressed [C II]/[O I] ratios, while the outermost regions, at projected distances of about 6 kpc and beyond, show values typical of star-forming regions. This suggests that the AGN may affect gas excitation out to about 5 kpc. Our results demonstrate the importance of combining MIR and FIR diagnostics to recover radial trends that can be hidden in galaxy-integrated measurements. Together with Paper I, they provide a benchmark for spatially resolved studies of gas and dust in starbursts and AGN-hosting galaxies.

title: Large fluctuations and cusp-core transformation in dwarf galaxies
background_knowledge: 在 $\Lambda$CDM 宇宙学中，暗物质通过引力成团形成暗物质晕，星系位于这些晕的中心。无重子物理的冷暗物质 N 体模拟通常给出中心密度随半径按 $r^{-1}$ 上升的尖峰剖面（如 NFW 剖面），而许多矮星系观测暗示中心密度更接近平坦的核心，这构成所谓 cusp/core problem。矮星系数量多、暗物质占比高，是检验暗物质小尺度性质与星系形成中重子反馈的理想实验室。重子反馈（恒星形成、超新星和活动星系核驱动的气体外流）可通过反复、局部的引力势涨落向暗物质轨道注入能量，逐渐把尖峰改造为核心；该过程是否有效取决于气体密度涨落的功率谱、涨落持续时间和核心形成弛豫时间。
contribution: 论文测量了一组富气体矮星系的中性气体密度反差功率谱，并将观测涨落的影响纳入随机动力学模型。结果显示，**观测到的涨落水平与理论预期一致**；在观测估计的核心半径处，**核心形成的弛豫时间一般为哈勃时间量级或更短**。因此，**所测核心尺度与“宇宙历史中长期稳态涨落生成核心”的保守估计相符**。此外，**弛豫时间随暗物质晕质量增加而增大**，表明这种由涨落驱动的核心形成机制在更大质量系统中效率较低。
summary: Dwarf galaxies are abundant and dark matter dominated, rendering them particularly relevant for testing a cosmological model dominated by a dark sector. Whether their density profiles agree with $Λ$CDM expectations has long been a point of contention, dubbed the cusp/core problem. While numerical simulations have suggested that the erasure of central dark matter cusps may arise from potential fluctuations in feedback-driven gas, whether the required fluctuation levels are achieved in actual galaxies has remained uncertain. By measuring the power spectra of neutral gas density contrasts in a sample of gas-rich dwarf galaxies, we show that the observed fluctuations match theoretical expectations when their impact is derived from a stochastic dynamical model. Specifically, the relaxation times for core formation at the observationally estimated radii are generally on the order of a Hubble time or less. Core sizes are therefore consistent with conservative estimates assuming their generation through steady fluctuations acting over cosmic history. The relaxation time increases with halo mass, suggesting that core formation via this mechanism becomes less efficient in more massive systems.

title: The "Rubin 2036: Opportunities for Discovery" Workshop: A Community Roadmap for the Future of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory After the LSST
background_knowledge: Vera C. Rubin Observatory 是美国 NSF 与 DOE 资助、位于智利 Cerro Pachón 的宽视场光学巡天台。其 8.4 m 主镜、9.6 平方度视场和大型拼接 CCD 相机带来极高的 étendue（口径面积与视场的乘积），使单位时间巡天效率显著领先。LSST 计划在约十年内对南天进行高频率、多波段深度成像，核心科学包括暗能量与宇宙学（Ia 型超新星、弱引力透镜、星系团、重子声学振荡）、时域暂现源、银河系结构、太阳系天体等。该领域的研究范式是“巡天 + 时序”：通过重复观测、不同滤光片组合和曝光节奏（cadence）同时获取静态宇宙与变化宇宙的信息；多波段测光用于估计光度红移，重复测光用于发现瞬变并触发后续观测。LSST 结束后，Rubin 仍具备独特的大视场与深成像能力，因此社区需要规划后 LSST 时代的巡天模式、滤光片、时域采样、多信使跟进与计算/读出技术升级。
contribution: 论文总结 **Rubin 2036: Opportunities for Discovery** 研讨会（KIPAC/SLAC，2026 年 8 月 3–5 日）的结构与讨论，约 100 名参与者共同勾勒 LSST 结束后 Rubin 的科学与技术路线图。会议设五个工作组：持续巡天组探讨以 Rubin 图像预训练的机器学习基础模型用于天体检测、去混合与分类；节奏组讨论后 LSST 观测时间分配，以及凌星系外行星、Ia 型超新星宇宙学、时间延迟宇宙学和秒级暂现源的采样策略；滤光片组评估宽带、中带与窄带滤光片在光度红移、高红移大尺度结构、AGN 混响映射、银河系考古和发射线成像方面的作用；多信使组讨论对下一代引力波与中微子源的跟进，包括标准汽笛、千新星和银河系超新星；技术组按成本与研制周期整理快速读出、新滤光片、更快快门和山顶边缘计算等选项。跨领域议题包括 **AI/ML、智利与拉美共同主导、卫星巨型星座以及 Cerro Pachón 的天气与气候趋势**。白皮书与会议报告可通过给定 Zenodo 与 GitHub 页面获取。
summary: The NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory will complete its ten-year Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) in the mid-2030s. Its 8.4 m aperture and 9.6 square degree field of view give it an étendue unmatched by any facility planned for that era. The Rubin 2036: Opportunities for Discovery workshop (KIPAC/SLAC, 3-5 August 2026) brought together approximately 100 participants to discuss Rubin's future after LSST. This paper summarizes the workshop's structure and discussions across five working groups. The continued-surveying group explored a machine-learning foundation model pretrained on Rubin imaging for detection, deblending, and classification. The cadence group considered allocating post-LSST observing time and strategies for transiting exoplanets, Type Ia supernova cosmology, time-delay cosmography, and second-scale transients. The filter group explored broadband, medium-band, and narrowband filters for photometric redshifts, high-redshift large-scale structure, AGN reverberation mapping, Galactic archaeology, and emission-line imaging. The multi-messenger group explored follow-up of next-generation gravitational-wave and neutrino sources, including standard sirens, kilonovae, and Galactic supernovae. The technology group organized options by cost and lead time, including fast readout, new filters, a faster shutter, and summit edge computing. Cross-cutting topics included AI/ML, Chilean and Latin-American co-leadership, satellite megaconstellations, and weather and climate trends at Cerro Pachón. White papers and workshop talks are available through https://zenodo.org/communities/rubin2036workshop/ and https://rubin-observatory.github.io/Rubin-Beyond-LSST/pages/Rubin2036proceedings/.

title: High-cadence GW astrometry in the $μ$Hz gap
background_knowledge: 随机引力波背景（SGWB）是大量独立且无法分辨的引力波源叠加形成的时空应变场，可用于研究早期宇宙、宇宙相变、宇宙弦以及致密双星等源群体性质。不同频段依赖不同探测手段：脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）覆盖纳赫兹（nHz）频段，LISA 等空间干涉仪覆盖毫赫兹（mHz）频段，而两者之间的微赫兹（$\mu$Hz）频段长期缺乏连续覆盖。天体测量探测引力波的物理图像是：经过的引力波会使恒星视位置产生微小周期性偏转，偏转幅度与引力波应变量级相当，因此可通过大量恒星位置的时序变化及其空间相关性寻找随机背景。此类观测的关键参数包括采样 cadence、曝光时间、参考星数量、巡天时标、口径与天区覆盖；采样频率需高于信号频率（Nyquist 条件），而交叉相关估计与远源极限下的天体测量重叠函数用于从恒星位置噪声中提取公共应变信号。
contribution: 论文预测了一颗专门设计、快速自旋的天体测量卫星对 PTA 与 LISA 之间微赫兹间隙中 SGWB 的探测灵敏度。**更快的自旋会提高对每颗恒星的采样频率，从而提升 Nyquist 频率并打开更高频段，同时不增加噪声代价：更短、更 noisy 的单次曝光由其数量精确补偿，因此每个位置序列的白噪声底与 cadence 无关。** 高频正是天体测量最具竞争力的地方，因为视位置偏转直接测量应变，其应变噪声为白噪声，而脉冲星计时的等效噪声随 $f^2$ 增长。作者采用对 $N$ 颗参考星的交叉相关估计量，并在远源极限下计算天体测量重叠函数，发现 **Gaia 式卫星扫描黄极、在 $10$ yr 内使用 $N\sim10^4$ 颗亮星时，仍比 PTA 已测到的背景灵敏度差约 $\sim 60$ 倍**。**更大的 $8$ 米级口径，或覆盖全天区的卫星星座，则可达到该灵敏度，并连续扩展对 $\mu$Hz 频段的覆盖。**
summary: We forecast the sensitivity of a dedicated, fast-spinning astrometric survey to a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) in the microhertz gap between pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and LISA. Spinning the satellite faster samples each star more often, raising the Nyquist frequency and opening higher frequencies at no cost in noise: the shorter, noisier exposures are exactly compensated by their number, so the white-noise floor of each position stream is independent of cadence. High frequencies are where astrometry is most competitive, because the deflection measures the strain directly: its strain noise is white, whereas the equivalent noise of pulsar timing grows as $f^2$. With a cross-correlation estimator over $N$ reference stars and the astrometric overlap computed in the distant-source limit, we find that a Gaia-like satellite scanning the ecliptic poles, with $N\sim10^4$ bright stars over $10$~yr, falls short of the background measured by PTAs by a factor $\sim\!60$. A larger, $8$-m-class aperture, or a constellation of satellites covering the whole sky, reaches it, while extending the reach continuously across the $μ$Hz band.

title: A MUSE Study of Stellar and Ionized-Gas Kinematics in Central Group Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系群是暗物质晕质量介于孤立星系与星系团之间的系统，其中心通常 hosted 一个早型星系，即最亮星系群星系（brightest group galaxies，BGGs）。在冷暗物质主导的结构形成框架下，星系演化取决于气体如何被吸积、加热、冷却、混合以及被恒星形成和活动星系核（AGN）反馈所调节。BGGs 因此成为连接孤立椭圆星系与星系团中最亮星系团星系（BCGs）的重要过渡对象。积分场光谱（如 MUSE）能够同时绘制恒星与电离气体的二维运动学：恒星速度场反映引力势与并合历史，气体速度场则对近期吸积、冷却和反馈更敏感；气体与恒星运动学对齐常暗示内部循环或同源演化，而错位则更可能指示外部吸积、并合或晕气冷却。热晕中多相气体能否凝结，常以冷却时标与动力学/湍流时标的比较来讨论，并涉及热不稳定性、降水判据、AGN 扰动和湍流等物理过程。
contribution: 论文利用 MUSE 对 17 个近邻 BGGs 进行观测，系统比较恒星与暖电离气体的运动学，以追溯星系群中心星系气体储库的来源。由 H$\alpha$ 和 [N II] 示踪的暖电离气体在 77%（13/17）样本中被探测到，形态包括带尾或不带尾的旋转盘、弥散发射、环状结构和纤维状结构。与 BCGs 不同，多数 BGGs 拥有规则旋转的恒星，而气体运动学呈现多样性。近一半旋转气体盘与恒星对齐，支持内部循环；但在三个对齐系统中，尾、弥散发射或环状结构可能保留过去吸积或相互作用的痕迹。其余盘、环状结构以及多数纤维状系统与恒星错位，支持气体通过并合、相互作用或晕气冷却获得。紧凑盘与中心集中、低角动量气体一致，可能与残余冷却有关。多数纤维状系统位于降水阈值附近（ $t_{\rm cool}/t_{\rm eddy} \sim 1-2$ ），并优先占据 k-plot 的湍流主导区域，支持与混沌冷吸积一致的凝结图像。所有探测到 X 射线晕的星系，包括未探测到暖气体的星系，均具有低中心熵（ $<30\,\mathrm{keV}\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$ ）和短中心冷却时标（ $<3\,\mathrm{Gyr}$ ）。这些条件本身不足以预测多相气体的存在，说明 AGN 或相互作用驱动的扰动以及湍流诱导的热不稳定性有助于调节凝结。**没有单一机制占主导：BGGs 是内部循环、环境吸积与冷却驱动凝结共存的过渡系统，从而连接孤立椭圆星系与星系团主导星系。**
summary: Understanding gas accretion and feedback in low-mass galaxy groups bridges the gap between isolated ellipticals and cluster-dominant galaxies. We present new Multi Unit Spectroscopic Explorer (MUSE) observations of 17 nearby brightest group galaxies (BGGs), revealing diverse origins for their gas reservoirs. Warm ionized gas, traced by Halpha and [N II], is detected in 77% (13/17) of the sample, with morphologies including rotating disks with or without tails and diffuse emission, rings, and filaments. Unlike brightest cluster galaxies, most BGGs host regularly rotating stars, whereas their gas displays diverse kinematics. Nearly half of the rotating gas disks are aligned with the stars, consistent with internal recycling. However, tails, diffuse emission, or rings in three aligned systems may retain signatures of past accretion or interactions. The remaining disks, ring-like structures, and most filamentary systems are misaligned, supporting gas acquisition through mergers, interactions, or halo cooling. Compact disks are consistent with centrally concentrated, low-angular-momentum gas, possibly linked to residual cooling. Most filamentary systems lie near the precipitation threshold (tcool/teddy ~ 1-2) and preferentially occupy the turbulence-dominated region of the k-plot, supporting condensation consistent with chaotic cold accretion. All galaxies with detected X-ray halos, including those without warm gas, exhibit low central entropies (<30 keV cm^2) and short central cooling times (<3 Gyr). These conditions alone cannot predict multiphase gas, suggesting that AGN- or interaction-driven perturbations and turbulence-induced thermal instabilities help regulate condensation. No single mechanism dominates: BGGs are transitional systems in which internal recycling, environmental accretion, and cooling-driven condensation coexist, linking isolated ellipticals to cluster-dominant galaxies.

title: PSR~B0355+54: An Unexpected Compendium of Nearly All Scintillation Arc Morphologies
background_knowledge: 脉冲星发出相干射电波，穿过星际介质中的电离气体时，会因电子密度涨落发生多路径散射与折射。不同路径的波在观测者处干涉，形成随频率和时间变化的动态谱；对其做二维傅里叶变换得到的二次谱中，常出现抛物线状的闪烁弧。闪烁弧的曲率与散射屏的位置、距离和相对运动有关，可用于反演星际介质的分布；弧列及其随时间的变化则编码了散射屏上的小尺度结构。地球周年运动还会引起弧曲率的周年变化，从而帮助确定散射屏的分数距离。该方向将射电脉冲星作为探针，研究星际介质湍流、电离区结构以及散射屏的几何与动力学。
contribution: 利用上海天马射电望远镜在 2.25 GHz 与 8.60 GHz 同时观测 PSR B0355+54，作者在 2020 年至 2026 年的 54 次观测中，于 2.25 GHz 的 53/53 次可用观测和 8.60 GHz 的 33/49 次观测里探测到闪烁弧。2.25 GHz 二次谱呈现前向弧、倒置弧列、弥散弧、弥散功率和不规则结构五类形态，并多次出现显著位移弧列；8.60 GHz 则以微弱前向弧为主。尽管形态差异明显，两个频率的标度曲率及其周年变化一致，表明它们共同追踪**同一主导散射屏**，其分数距离为 $s=0.069^{+0.015}_{-0.014}$，靠近脉冲星，并进一步支持该屏可能与 H II 区 Sh 2-205 相关。模拟表明，**屏内散射像分布的变化即可产生观测到的形态多样性**；2.25 GHz 亮度重建可分辨至约 0.02 mas 的局域结构。在 8.60 GHz 追踪四个弧列（含两个位移弧列）达 10 h，发现共同演化趋势，**与视线扫过小尺度散射结构的情形相符**，有助于解释闪烁弧的快速演化。
summary: Scintillation arcs are sensitive probes of multipath propagation, offering a window into the distribution of scattering material in the interstellar medium. Contrary to the common observational finding that individual pulsars exhibit only a limited range of scintillation arc morphologies, we report that PSR~B0355+54, observed simultaneously at 2.25/8.60~GHz with the Shanghai Tianma Radio Telescope, displays nearly the full range of known arc patterns, many of which evolve rapidly. Across 54 observations from 2020 to 2026, we detect scintillation arcs in 53/53 usable observations at 2.25~GHz and 33/49 at 8.60~GHz. At 2.25~GHz, the secondary spectra exhibit five broad morphological types: forward arcs, inverted arclets, diffuse arcs, diffuse power, and irregular structures, with prominent displaced arclets appearing in several observations. In contrast, the 8.60-GHz spectra are generally dominated by faint forward arcs. Despite these marked morphological differences, the scaled curvatures and their annual variations agree between the two frequencies, showing that both trace the same dominant scattering screen at a fractional distance of $s=0.069^{+0.015}_{-0.014}$ near the pulsar, further supporting a possible association with the \ion{H}{ii} region Sh~2-205. Simulations show that this diversity can arise from variations in the scattered-image distribution within this screen, while brightness reconstructions at 2.25~GHz resolve localized structure down to $\sim0.02~\mathrm{mas}$. Tracking four arclets over 10~h at 8.60~GHz, including two displaced arclets, reveals a common evolutionary trend consistent with the line of sight sweeping across small-scale scattering structure, helping explain the rapid arc evolution.

title: J-PLUS: Identifying Outlier Spectral Energy Distributions in the Fourth Data Release Using Unsupervised Machine Learning
background_knowledge: 在本地宇宙中，恒星、白矮星、低质量恒星及双星等天体的辐射跨越从紫外到近红外的宽波段，其光谱能量分布（SED）由有效温度、表面重力、金属丰度、尘埃消光及伴星贡献等共同决定。宽带测光可给出连续谱形状和粗略颜色，窄带测光则对特定谱线或分子带敏感，因此多滤光片测光组合能够在一定程度上替代低分辨率光谱，用于识别特殊恒星族群。J-PLUS 等大规模测光巡天会产生海量天体，其中稀有天体、特殊化学丰度星、白矮星、激变变星和双星等只占很小比例。传统颜色选择依赖先验阈值，难以充分挖掘高维测光空间中的异常结构。无监督机器学习特别适合此类探索：自编码器可学习绝大多数正常 SED 的低维表示，并以重构误差寻找偏离主群体的异常 SED；t-SNE 等降维方法则可在二维视图中保留局部邻域结构，把具有相似颜色的天体聚成岛状结构，从而辅助识别稀有族群并为光谱后续观测提供候选体。
contribution: 论文利用 J-PLUS 第四次数据发布（DR4）中 **12 个滤光片**的测光数据，将宽波段与窄波段信息结合，采用基于**自编码器**的无监督异常检测方法，从 J-PLUS 天体样本中筛选出偏离主导 SED 模式的异常源。随后，作者对异常 SED 群体的 J-PLUS 颜色应用 **t-SNE** 降维，并结合 SIMBAD 数据库及其他天文巡天的信息对异常源进行分类，从而刻画 t-SNE 图中的过密区域及其对应的特定恒星族群。研究识别出**大量白矮星和低质量恒星**，其中包括**少量污染白矮星**，并给出可供光谱后续观测的候选体：**19 颗富碳星、11 个激变变星和 170 个白矮星-主序星双星**，这些目标此前均未见文献报道。该工作表明，多滤光片测光与无监督机器学习结合能够有效挖掘稀有恒星族群和新颖天体。
summary: The selection of candidates belonging to rare or underrepresented stellar populations, as well as novel objects, is essential for spectroscopic follow-up. In this work, we demonstrate how combining broad- and narrow-band photometric information with machine-learning techniques enables this selection. Using photometric data in twelve filters from the Javalambre Photometric Local Universe Survey (J-PLUS) as input, we applied an anomaly detection technique based on autoencoders to identify spectral energy distributions (SEDs) that deviate from the dominant pattern in the J-PLUS objects sample. Subsequently, we applied the t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) algorithm to the J-PLUS colors of the outlier SEDs population. Combining information from the SIMBAD database and other astronomical surveys to classify the outliers identified by the autoencoder, we are able to characterize over-densities in the t-SNE map. Our study specifically focuses on well-defined islands in the t-SNE space, corresponding to specific populations. We identified a large sample of white dwarfs and low-mass stars, including a small subset of polluted white dwarfs, and report potential candidates for spectroscopic follow-up, including 19 carbon-rich stars, 11 cataclysmic variables and 170 white-dwarfs-main-sequence binaries, all previously unreported in the literature.

title: Cosmic-ray melt windows in interstellar ice make a four-carbon ketose but not the sugar pattern of G+0.693-0.027
background_knowledge: 星际分子云中的尘埃颗粒表面会形成冰幔，紫外光子与宇宙线在其中驱动自由基反应、辐射分解和热加工，是生成醛、醇、糖类等前生命有机分子的重要途径。高能宇宙线重离子穿过冰层时，可在纳米至微米尺度、极短时间内沉积能量，形成瞬态“熔融窗口”；液态水环境可能让平时受低温扩散限制的化学反应快速进行。该方向的研究范式通常是把观测到的分子柱密度、同分异构体比例和碳链长度分布，与冰化学网络、辐射剂量和分子云暴露历史相比较。银河系中心分子云 G+0.693-0.027 富含复杂有机分子，是检验此类化学的重要实验室；其中四碳酮糖赤藓酮糖（ERU）与乙醇醛（GA）的观测比值，以及三碳糖未被探测到的事实，为区分低温表面化学、辐射分解和熔融窗口化学提供了关键约束。
contribution: 论文检验宇宙线重离子在星际冰中打开的熔融窗口能否重现 G+0.693-0.027 中 ERU 与 GA 柱密度相当、而三碳糖未被探测到的模式。作者建立包含 11 种宇宙线核的径迹模型，计算熔融窗口的发生率、持续时间以及窗口内外沉积的能量，并用包含甲醛和甲醇来源 C1 自由基的自由基网络追踪多次事件后的分子库存；事件之间的辐射分解采用冷冰中有机物实测半寿命剂量。结果表明，水合 GA 可打开优先生成 C4 酮糖的通道，因此熔融窗口化学能够解释 ERU 的酮糖身份，尽管冷表面化学也能产生 ERU；但**整体分子模式未能被重现**。C1 自由基逐次加碳时，当 ERU/GA 达到观测值时，二羟丙酮（DHA）已高达其上限的 **15 倍**。离子在熔融区外每次事件每分子沉积 $0.41$ eV，会在事件间破坏糖类；只有半寿命剂量高于 $1000$ eV 时才能达到观测比值，而实测值低于 $5$ eV。暴露条件同样紧张：模型给出 2940 次整颗粒熔融事件，以及在 $\zeta=10^{-14}$ s$^{-1}$ 下约 65 Myr 的暴露时间；若要求在 7 Myr 内完成，则需 $\zeta\gtrsim9.3\times10^{-14}$ s$^{-1}$，为中央分子区致密气体上限的 9.3 倍，若 trapped radicals 可复合则需 $5.8\times10^{-15}$ s$^{-1}$。**在标准假设下，G+0.693-0.027 中的糖类并非由宇宙线熔融窗口生成**；要解释该模式，还需 C1 自由基不加入糖自由基、糖类能经受固相剂量，以及 $\zeta\gtrsim2\times10^{-13}$ s$^{-1}$ 的局部 MeV 离子源。
summary: Erythrulose (ERU), a four-carbon (C4) ketose, is reported towards the Galactic-centre cloud G+0.693-0.027 at a column density comparable to that of glycolaldehyde (GA), while the three-carbon (C3) sugars are not detected. We test whether melt windows opened in interstellar ice by cosmic-ray heavy ions can reproduce this pattern, with each rate fixed to a published value where available. A track model for eleven cosmic-ray nuclei determines the rate and duration of the liquid windows and the energy deposited inside and outside the melts. A radical network including C1 radicals from formaldehyde and methanol follows the inventory through repeated events. Radiolysis between events uses measured half-life doses of organics in cold ice. Hydrated GA opens a channel that preferentially forms the C4 ketose, so the melt-window chemistry can account for the ketose identity of ERU, although cold surface chemistry also yields it. The overall pattern, however, is not reproduced. The C1 radicals add one carbon at a time: dihydroxyacetone is at 15 times its limit when ERU/GA reaches the observed value. The ions deposit 0.41 eV per molecule per event outside the melts, which destroys the sugars between events; the ratio is reached only for half-life doses above 1000 eV, against measured values below 5 eV. The exposure is less certain: 2940 whole-grain melting events, 65 Myr at an ionisation rate $ζ=10^{-14}$ s$^{-1}$. Within 7 Myr it needs $ζ\gtrsim9.3\times10^{-14}$ s$^{-1}$, 9.3 times the dense-gas limit in the Central Molecular Zone, or $5.8\times10^{-15}$ s$^{-1}$ if the trapped radicals recombine. With standard assumptions the sugars of G+0.693 are not made in cosmic-ray melt windows. The pattern would need C1 radicals that do not add to the sugar radicals, sugars that survive the solid-phase dose and a local source of MeV ions with $ζ\gtrsim2\times10^{-13}$ s$^{-1}$.

title: Supermassive Black Hole Winds in X-rays -- SUBWAYS. VI. Interplay between the soft X-ray excess and ultra-fast outflows
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动。标准图像中，吸积盘发出光学/紫外辐射，热电子日冕通过逆康普顿散射把种子光子提升到 X 射线波段；软 X 射线超出（soft X-ray excess, SE）通常出现在约 2 keV 以下，可由光学厚、温度较低的暖日冕或相对论反射等机制解释。超快外流（ultra-fast outflows, UFOs）是高速、高度电离的盘风，常在硬 X 射线铁 K 吸收线中表现为蓝移吸收；暖吸收体（warm absorbers, WAs）则是较慢、电离度较低的软 X 射线吸收气体。它们关系到黑洞吸积、风反馈和多波段能量分配。研究这些成分需要同时或准同时的光学、紫外与 X 射线观测，并用日冕、反射和吸收模型联合拟合宽波段谱。
contribution: 本文基于 SUBWAYS 项目，对 $0.1 \leq z \leq 0.4$ 的 21 个 AGN 开展宽波段、多波段研究，联合 XMM-Newton（EPIC pn 与 OM）、NuSTAR 和 Hubble 空间望远镜（HST）的同时或准同时紫外、光学与 X 射线数据，考察软 X 射线超出（SE）、超快外流（UFOs）和暖吸收体（WAs）之间的相互联系。作者用双日冕（two-coronae）框架拟合 SE：光学厚暖日冕产生光学/紫外和软 X 射线辐射，光学薄热日冕产生硬 X 射线连续谱；并检验加入相对论反射的混合模型。光学/紫外数据把康普顿化种子光子温度约束在 $0.1$–$5.5$ eV。双日冕模型能一致描述宽波段辐射，暖日冕电子温度 $kT_e$ 约为 $0.1$–$0.9$ keV、光子指数 $\Gamma > 2$，与先前研究一致。**然而，21 个 AGN 中有 9 个需要混合模型，表明 SE 具有多种起源且相对贡献可变；在 UFO 宿主中这一现象尤其明显，7 次观测中有 4 次偏好混合模型。** 与无 UFO 源相比，UFO 宿主呈现较低的暖日冕温度、较硬的热日冕谱和正的硬度比；作者提醒这些趋势受小样本及谱参数和仪器响应依赖性的限制，需谨慎对待。有 WAs 与无 WAs 的源之间未发现显著差异。相关分析发现放大因子与暖日冕温度、暖日冕光学深度与硬度比、暖日冕斜率及光学深度与紫外光度之间存在联系，并发现暖日冕光学深度与 UFO 外流速度之间可能存在初步反相关趋势。
summary: We present a broadband, multiwavelength study of the interplay between the soft X-ray excess (SE), ultra-fast outflows (UFOs), and warm absorbers (WAs) in 21 active galactic nuclei (AGN; 0.1 <= z <= 0.4) from the SUBWAYS project. We combine simultaneous or quasi-simultaneous UV, optical, and X-ray data from XMM-Newton (EPIC pn and OM), NuSTAR, and the Hubble Space Telescope. We model the SE using a two-coronae framework, in which a warm, optically thick corona (WC) produces the optical/UV and soft X-ray emission, while a hot, optically thin corona produces the hard X-ray continuum. We also test a hybrid model that adds relativistic reflection. The optical/UV coverage constrains the Comptonization seed photon temperature to 0.1-5.5 eV. The two-coronae model consistently describes the broadband emission, with WC electron temperatures kT_e ~ 0.1-0.9 keV and photon indices $Γ> 2$, consistent with previous studies. However, 9/21 AGN require the hybrid model, suggesting that the SE has multiple origins whose relative contributions vary. This is especially evident in UFO hosts, where 4/7 observations favor the hybrid model. Compared with sources without UFOs, UFO hosts show lower WC temperatures, harder hot-corona spectra, and positive hardness ratios. These trends should be treated cautiously because of the small sample and their dependence on spectral parameters and instrumental response. We find no significant differences between AGN with and without WAs. Our correlation analysis finds links between the amplification factor and WC temperature, WC optical depth and hardness ratio, and WC slope and optical depth with UV luminosity. We also find a tentative anticorrelation between WC optical depth and UFO outflow velocity.

title: Resolving the extended interstellar medium of infrared galaxies I. Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon emission
background_knowledge: 星际介质（ISM）是星系中气体、尘埃与辐射场相互作用的场所。多环芳香烃（PAH）是一类含数十至数百个碳原子的大分子，吸收紫外光子后会在 3.3、6.2、7.7、8.6、11.3 微米等红外波段产生特征发射。其谱线强度比携带 PAH 尺寸、电离态和辐射场硬度的信息：例如 $11.3/7.7$ 常与中性、较大的 PAH 相关，$6.2/7.7$ 对电离 PAH 更敏感。PAH 还通过光电效应把紫外辐射能转化为气体热能，即光电加热，是星系冷星际介质中的重要加热机制。中心星暴或活动星系核（AGN）会改变辐射场，导致 PAH 光致破坏、电离和尺寸分布随半径变化；因此，空间分辨的中红外光谱与远红外冷却线联合分析，可检验星系不同区域尘埃性质与加热效率如何响应恒星形成和 AGN 反馈。
contribution: 论文利用 GOALS 样本中 67 个近邻亮红外星系的 Spitzer 中红外光谱和 Herschel 远红外冷却线图，在同心环带与匹配孔径网格中提取光谱，最远至约 14 kpc，并用 CAFE 光谱分解工具测量 PAH 特征；在扣除中性气体贡献后，将 PAH 发射与冷却线结合以追踪光电加热效率。**在星暴星系中，$11.3/7.7$ 在约 5 kpc 内升高而 $6.2/7.7$ 近乎不变，表明 PAH 以大型中性分子为主；在 5 至 8 kpc 之间 $11.3/7.7$ 继续升高但推断的 PAH 尺寸减小；超过 8 kpc 后 $11.3/7.7$ 下降、$6.2/7.7$ 升高，表明 PAH 更小且更电离，这些趋势与中心星暴附近的光致破坏一致。** 强 AGN 系统的核区与内区显示更中性的 PAH 和更硬的辐射场；在约 5 kpc 之外，随着辐射场减弱，PAH 变得更电离并趋近星暴星系的位置。**强 AGN 在 6 至 14 kpc 对平均 PAH 电荷态的影响，可与中等强度 AGN 在 1 至 6 kpc 的影响相当。** 两类星系中光电加热效率均随半径增加而升高，反映辐射场减弱；在星暴星系中较高效率对应更中性的 PAH，而 AGN 主导系统呈相反关系。该工作为亮红外星系群体中 AGN 对尘埃性质的影响范围提供了定量、空间分辨的约束。
summary: We investigate spatial variations in polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) properties and photoelectric heating efficiency in 67 nearby luminous infrared galaxies from the Great Observatories All-sky LIRG Survey (GOALS). Using mid-infrared spectroscopy from Spitzer and far-infrared cooling-line maps from Herschel, we extract spectra in concentric annuli and matched aperture grids out to about 14 kpc. PAH features are measured with the CAFE spectral decomposition tool. We trace photoelectric heating efficiency by combining PAH emission with cooling lines after isolating the neutral-gas contribution. In starburst galaxies, the PAH 11.3/7.7 ratio rises out to about 5 kpc while 6.2/7.7 remains nearly constant, indicating predominantly large, neutral PAHs. Between 5 and 8 kpc, 11.3/7.7 continues to rise while inferred PAH sizes decrease. Beyond 8 kpc, 11.3/7.7 falls and 6.2/7.7 rises, indicating smaller, more ionized PAHs. These trends are consistent with PAH photodestruction near the central starburst. Strong active galactic nucleus (AGN) systems show more neutral PAHs and harder radiation fields in their nuclear and inner regions. Beyond about 5 kpc, PAHs become more ionized and approach the starburst locus as the radiation field weakens. Strong AGNs influence average PAH charge states at 6-14 kpc as effectively as moderate AGNs at 1-6 kpc. Photoelectric heating efficiency increases with radius in both starburst and AGN-hosting galaxies as the radiation field weakens. In starbursts, higher efficiency is associated with more neutral PAHs, while AGN-dominated systems show the opposite relation. These results provide quantitative, spatially resolved constraints on the extent of AGN effects on dust properties in a population of luminous infrared galaxies.

title: The clumpy fraction of galaxies at $z=1-9$ with JADES: evidence for a mass-dependent transition in clump origin
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究的一个核心问题是高红移星系如何吸积气体、形成恒星并塑造其形态。观测发现，许多高红移恒星形成星系并非光滑盘，而是呈现由多个致密、偏离星系中心的亮区组成的团块状形态；这些团块通常是尺度为几百秒差距、质量可达 $10^7$--$10^9\,{\rm M_\odot}$ 的强恒星形成区，在静止系紫外到光学波段最为显著。其物理成因包括引力不稳定性驱动的盘碎裂、剧烈盘不稳定性、星系并合、气体吸积与外流等。在高红移，宇宙恒星形成率密度高、气体分数大、盘旋转支撑较弱而湍流和随机运动较强，因此盘易碎裂；同时并合频繁。团块寿命、迁移和最终命运与星系盘演化、中心黑洞增长及反馈相关。观测上，静止系紫外光追踪近期恒星形成，因此紫外团块选择对年轻星团敏感；光学波段则更受尘埃和年龄影响，比较不同波段可检验团块性质。研究范式上，人们通过高分辨率空间望远镜成像识别团块，统计团块比例 $f_{\rm clumpy}$ 随红移 $z$、恒星质量 $M_\star$ 和恒星形成率的变化，并结合探测完备性模拟与并合率比较来区分不同形成通道。JWST/NIRCam 的高分辨率近红外成像使得在 $z\gtrsim6$ 系统研究静止系紫外团块成为可能。
contribution: 作者利用 JWST/NIRCam 的 JADES 成像，在 $z=1$--$9$、$\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})\geq8$ 的样本中测量团块星系比例 $f_{\rm clumpy}$。他们将团块定义为尺度约几百秒差距、偏离星系中心的致密表面亮度峰，并基于 astrodendro 发展树状图（dendrogram）团块识别方法，直接在静止系紫外、蓝光和光学图像中探测团块。通过注入—回收模拟量化探测完备性后，作者给出依赖于 $(M_\star,z)$ 的 50% 完备性限制下的 $f_{\rm clumpy}$，并给出概率加权的完备性改正统计量作为对照。主要结果为：蓝光和光学波段的 $f_{\rm clumpy}$ 在 $z\approx1$--$2$ 达到约 55%，到 $z\approx8$--$9$ 降至 $\lesssim5\%$，而紫外波段比例仍较高，约 12%；在 $z\approx1$--$2$，$f_{\rm clumpy}$ 随恒星质量显著上升，从最低质量端的约 35% 增至 $\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})\geq10$ 处的约 85%。**大多数团块星系仅包含一个或两个可靠探测的偏离中心团块，而更高多重度的系统优先出现在低至中等红移的大质量、强恒星形成星系中。** 与主并合率的比较表明，**并合可以解释低质量（$\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})<8.5$）、高红移团块星系中的相当一部分，但大质量系统（$\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})>9$）的观测比例需要额外的原位团块形成通道**。这些结果与如下图像一致：**团块状形态由早期、低恒星质量阶段的并合主导，逐渐转变为大质量系统中盘不稳定性等原位团块形成通道贡献增加。**
summary: We measure the fraction of clumpy galaxies ($f_{\rm clumpy}$) over the redshift range $z=1-9$ and stellar masses $\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot}) \geq 8$ using JWST/NIRCam imaging from JADES. We define clumps as compact off-centre surface-brightness peaks with characteristic sizes of a few hundred parsecs, and develop a dendrogram-based clump-finding method with astrodendro to identify them directly in rest-frame UV, blue, and optical images. Clump-detection completeness is quantified through injection-recovery simulations, which we use to define ($M_\star$, $z$)-dependent 50 per cent completeness-limited $f_{\rm clumpy}$, alongside a probability-weighted completeness-corrected statistic for comparison. For the full sample, the blue and optical $f_{\rm clumpy}$ reach $\approx55$ per cent at $z\approx1-2$ and decline to $\lesssim5$ per cent by $z\approx8-9$, while the UV fraction remains higher at $\approx12$ per cent. At $z\approx1-2$, $f_{\rm clumpy}$ increases strongly with stellar mass, from $\approx35$ per cent in the lowest-mass bin to $\approx85$ per cent at $\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})\geq10$. Most clumpy galaxies host only one or two robustly detected off-centre clumps, while higher-multiplicity systems occur preferentially in massive, strongly star-forming galaxies at low to intermediate redshift. Comparison with major merger rates suggests that mergers could account for a substantial fraction of low-mass ($\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})<8.5$), high-redshift clumpy galaxies, while the observed fractions in more massive systems ($\log_{10}(M_\star/{\rm M_\odot})>9$) require an additional in situ clump-formation channel. Our results are consistent with a transition from merger-dominated clumpy morphologies at early times and low stellar masses to an increasing contribution from in situ clump-formation channels, such as disc instabilities, in more massive systems.

title: An improvement to the spatial discretisation in the Astrophysical Weighted Particle Hydrodynamics method
background_knowledge: 天体物理流体模拟通常需要在恒星、吸积盘、星际介质和宇宙结构等复杂且多尺度的环境中求解流体方程。数值方法既有基于网格的 Euler 方法，也有无网格粒子方法。此类粒子方法把流体离散为携带质量、动量等状态的粒子节点，并在局部邻域内借助核函数或单位分解重构物理量；与 SPH 类似，其空间积分常写成节点求和，因此节点权重、核支撑尺度和邻域几何会直接影响守恒性与精度。论文关注的 Astrophysical Weighted Particle Hydrodynamics 采用基于单位分解（partition of unity）的 cubature 规则离散空间积分：将积分近似为 $I[f] = \sum_i w_i f(x_i)$，其中 $w_i$ 是节点（粒子）权重，$x_i$ 为节点位置或质心。实际计算中 $w_i$ 往往没有精确解析值，需要构造近似；核函数紧支撑半径可随局部密度自适应，也可设为常数。评估这类离散时，需要考察求积规则的精度、误差随粒子数或样本数的统计行为，以及权重和质心近似对整体流体模拟的影响。
contribution: 论文围绕 Astrophysical Weighted Particle Hydrodynamics 的空间离散，提出新的节点（粒子）权重近似，系统研究其性质，并评估这些近似对 cubature 规则精度以及整个方法精度的影响。论文还提出并研究节点质心近似，说明其可能应用；针对核函数紧支撑尺度取常数而非自适应的方案，也给出相应的权重与质心近似。最后，针对文献中已有权重近似对应的 cubature 规则，推导其平均相对误差的渐近表达式，并用简单例子展示该表达式有助于理解该规则的有限样本性质。**核心贡献是扩展并评估该粒子流体方法的权重与质心近似体系，并为相关 cubature 规则提供误差渐近分析工具。**
summary: The discretisation of space in the Astrophysical Weighted Particle Hydrodynamics method is attained through a partition-of-unity-based cubature rule. The node (particle) weights in such rules must in general be obtained using approximations, for which only one has been thus far proposed in the literature. In this work, new approximations for these weights are proposed, their properties are studied, and their impact on the accuracy of the cubature rule and the overall method is assessed. Approximations for node centroids are also proposed and studied, and their possible applications are laid out. Additionally, for schemes in which the kernel-function compact-support size is set to be constant, rather than adaptive, weight and centroid approximations are provided as well. Finally, for the cubature rule arising from the weight approximation previously proposed in the literature, an asymptotic expression for its mean relative error is derived, and its usefulness for understanding the finite-sample properties of the cubature rule is showcased with some simple examples.

title: Core-Collapse Supernova Rates in the Dark Energy Survey
background_knowledge: 核心坍缩超新星（core-collapse supernova, CC SN）是大质量恒星（初始质量约 $8\,M_\odot$ 以上）在核心核燃烧结束后发生引力坍缩与爆炸的终点；由于前身星寿命短，CC SN 发生率可视为近期恒星形成活动的直接示踪。单位共动体积、单位时间内的 CC SN 率随红移的演化，通常与宇宙恒星形成历史（cosmic star-formation history, CSFH）比较；CSFH 约在宇宙正午（$z\sim2$）达到峰值，因此 CC SN 率也预期在更高红移出现转折。该比较还受初始质量函数（initial mass function, IMF）、前身星质量范围、双星比例以及超新星类型（如富氢的 II 型与剥离包层的 Ib/Ic 型）影响。观测上，宽视场重复成像巡天通过发现大量光变曲线、进行光变分类与红移估计，再结合巡天体积和选择函数测量体积率。Dark Energy Survey（DES）在 2013–2017 年的五年超新星巡天为这一测量提供了大样本与宽红移覆盖。
contribution: 论文基于 DES 五年超新星巡天记录的 31,636 条光变曲线，使用专门构建的两阶段随机森林分类器，在用于发生率分析的巡天区域内识别出 2,445 个可能的 CC SN。作者据此在 $z=0$ 到 $z=1.3$ 的 11 个红移分箱中测量 CC SN 体积率，给出了迄今单巡天最细致的覆盖，跨越约 90 亿年回看时间。测量结果可由幂律 $R_{\mathrm{CC}}(z)=R_0(1+z)^{\alpha}$ 很好地拟合，其中 $R_0=1.58\pm0.17\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-3}$、$\alpha=2.85\pm0.25$；**预期在宇宙正午出现的发生率转折尚未显现**。由于 CC SN 示踪近期恒星形成，作者将结果与近期 CSFH 模型比较，发现**测量值比采用 Salpeter IMF 的 CSFH 模型预测高约 70%**；若改用 Baldry & Glazebrook IMF 并取 $8-40\,M_\odot$ 的 CC SN 前身星质量范围，则可弥合差距。另一种可能是 CSFH 遗漏了尚未识别的一类低光度星系。作者还测得本地剥离包层超新星（SE SN）占全部 CC SN 的比例为 $31\pm5\%$，且该比例在 $z=0$ 到 $z=1.3$ 保持不变。结合针对富氢超新星“缺失前身星问题”的 IMF 分析，**结果支持 SE SN 前身星为单颗大质量恒星与双星系统的混合，而红移不变的比例更有利于双星通道**。
summary: Over its five-year campaign (2013-2017), the Dark Energy Survey (DES) supernova (SN) survey recorded 31,636 light curves. Using a custom-built, two-stage random forest classifier, we identified 2,445 likely core-collapse SNe (CC SNe) within the survey rate analysis footprint. With this sample, we measure the volumetric CC SN rate from redshift z = 0 to 1.3 in 11 redshift bins, representing the most detailed single-survey coverage to date across nine billion years of lookback time. Over this interval, the CC SN rates are well fit by a power law R_CC(z) = R_0 (1 + z)^α, with R_0 = 1.58 \pm 0.17 \times 10^{-4} \text{ yr}^{-1} \text{ Mpc}^{-3} and α= 2.85 \pm 0.25. The rate turnover, expected at cosmic noon, is not yet apparent. Because CC SNe trace recent star formation, we compare our measurements with recent cosmic star-formation history (CSFH) models. Our measurements are ~70 per cent higher than CSFH models using a Salpeter initial mass function (IMF) to predict CC SN rates. Replacing the Salpeter IMF with a Baldry and Glazebrook IMF and a CC SN progenitor mass range of 8-40 M_\odot bridges the gap. Alternatively, CSFHs may miss a hitherto unidentified population of low-luminosity galaxies. We further find that the local ratio of stripped-envelope (SE) SNe to all CC SNe is 31 \pm 5 per cent, remaining constant from z = 0 to 1.3. Combined with an IMF analysis accounting for the "missing progenitor problem" of hydrogen-rich SNe, our results favour a mixture of single massive stars and binaries as SE SN progenitors, with the redshift-invariant ratio favouring binary channels.

title: Localizing binary neutron stars with the Einstein Telescope: a full Bayesian comparison of the triangular and 2L configurations
background_knowledge:
双中子星（binary neutron star，BNS）并合是引力波天文学与多信使天文学的核心目标之一。并合产生的啁啾信号携带质量、自旋、距离和天区位置等信息；地面激光干涉仪通过测量引力波应变在不同探测器间的到达时间、振幅与相位差来反演源的天区位置。定位结果通常以一定可信度（如 90%）的天区面积和可能的多峰后验表示，面积越小、主峰越集中，越有利于电磁波、中微子等后随观测。
\n爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope，ET）是欧洲规划的下一代地面引力波天文台，拟采用地下、低温、长基线且灵敏度显著优于当前一代的干涉仪。其候选布局包括在 Euregio Meuse-Rhine 场址的三角形（$ \Delta $）设计，以及在意大利撒丁岛和德国劳西茨分别放置干涉仪的 2L 设计。不同几何布局会改变天线响应、基线方向和探测网络对天区定位简并的打破能力。ET 计划先运行高频干涉仪，再逐步加入更具挑战性的低频仪器，因此评估早期高频阶段的定位能力具有现实意义。
\n天区定位的后验分布常呈多峰结构，尤其当信噪比不高或探测器网络无法有效打破距离—倾角、天线响应等简并时。Fisher 矩阵预报在接近高斯后验时高效，但难以可靠描述多峰、非高斯后验；完整贝叶斯参数估计则能直接刻画这些模态。地球自转、非长波近似响应以及高阶模式等物理效应，均可通过改变信号在不同探测器中的调制来改善定位。
contribution:
论文针对 ET 的两种候选布局——Euregio Meuse-Rhine 场址的三角形（$ \Delta $）构型与位于意大利撒丁岛和德国劳西茨的 2L 构型——给出了 BNS 并合天区定位的定量比较。作者主要考虑早期仅由高频干涉仪组成的观测场景，采用完整贝叶斯参数估计而非 Fisher 矩阵预报，从而捕捉天区后验的多峰结构；分析放宽了长波近似，并纳入地球自转和高阶模式。注入信号覆盖不同天区位置和 40 至 2000 Mpc 的光度距离，对应信噪比（signal-to-noise ratio，SNR）约为 12 至 720。
\n结果表明，$ \Delta $ 构型对低、中等 SNR 源的定位后验呈八个简并天区模式，散布于南北半球以及地球昼夜两侧，90% 可信区域可达 $ \sim 2 \times 10^4 \, \mathrm{deg}^2 $。相比之下，2L 构型恢复出一个单一主导模式，该模式包含至少 50% 的后验概率，且面积比 $ \Delta $ 构型小一到两个数量级。**这一差异意味着 2L 构型可为多信使后随观测提供显著更强的天区定位优势。**
summary: The Einstein Telescope (ET), the European next-generation gravitational-wave observatory, is at a decisive stage: the choice of its detector configuration is still open, with profound implications for its scientific output. We provide a quantitative basis for this choice by comparing two candidate configurations at their proposed sites: the triangular design ($Δ$) at the Euregio Meuse-Rhine site, and the 2L design, with interferometers in Sardinia, Italy, and Lusatia, Germany. We present the first realistic estimates of sky-localization uncertainties for binary neutron star (BNS) mergers, moving beyond Fisher-matrix forecasts to full Bayesian parameter estimation that captures the multimodal structure of the sky posterior. We focus mainly on the high-frequency interferometers alone, providing an expected scenario for the first years of ET operations, as the more challenging low-frequency instruments will come online later. BNS injections span different sky positions and luminosity distances between 40 and 2000 Mpc, corresponding to signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) from 12 to 720. Our analysis relaxes the long-wavelength approximation and includes Earth's rotation and higher-order modes, all of which improve sky localization. We find that the $Δ$ configuration localizes low- and moderate-SNR sources in eight degenerate sky modes spread across both hemispheres and over the day and night sides of the Earth, with 90% credible areas reaching $\sim 2 \times 10^4 \, \mathrm{deg}^2$. In contrast, the 2L configuration recovers a single dominant mode that contains at least 50% of the posterior probability and is one to two orders of magnitude smaller in area. This represents a substantial advantage for multimessenger follow-up campaigns.

title: Untangling Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals and Massive Black Hole Binaries in LISA Data
background_knowledge: LISA 是计划中的空间引力波天文台，将在毫赫兹（mHz）频段开展观测。该频段预期包含大量银河系双星（GB）、大质量黑洞双星（MBHB）以及极端质量比旋近（EMRI）等引力波源。MBHB 由两颗大质量黑洞组成，并合阶段会辐射强引力波；EMRI 则是恒星级致密天体旋入大质量黑洞，质量比可低至 $10^{-4}$ 量级，波形周期多、持续时间长，可用于检验强引力场和黑洞时空。LISA 数据将是未知数量引力波源的叠加，并包含仪器噪声以及大量未分辨 GB 形成的随机前景。此类数据分析通常依赖贝叶斯推断与全局拟合：同时建模多个源，在高维参数空间中抽样，并处理源间混淆、参数简并和波形扣除误差。核心问题是，一个源的参数误差与残余信号是否会污染另一个源，以及是否必须进行完全联合推断，还是可以先拟合并扣除强源，再依次推断其他源。该问题直接决定 LISA 数据分析 pipeline 的计算策略与系统误差预算。
contribution: 论文系统评估了 LISA 数据中 MBHB 与 EMRI 信号联合推断时的源间耦合，考虑了假定仪器噪声与随机 GB 前景下多种代表性 MBHB 和 EMRI 组合。贝叶斯分析证实，尽管单个源内部的参数相关性很强，EMRI 之间以及 EMRI 与 MBHB 之间的源间耦合较弱；**这支持对 EMRI 与 MBHB 采用分层、顺序推断，而非完全联合推断**。论文进一步表明，由缺失波形模式或 MBHB 相互重叠造成的不完美 MBHB 扣除，对 EMRI 推断只有较弱影响；对于多个 MBHB，可通过联合 MBHB 拟合来减小推断误差。作者在包含噪声、3 个 MBHB 和 3 个 EMRI 的模拟 LISA 数据上演示了该策略：先联合拟合并扣除 MBHB，再顺序推断 EMRI，最终**所有恢复的天体物理参数几乎无偏**。这些结论对当前正在开发的基于全局拟合的 LISA 数据分析 pipeline 具有直接指导意义。
summary: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe sources in the millihertz regime, such as Galactic Binaries (GBs), Massive Black Hole Binaries (MBHBs), and Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals (EMRIs), so its data stream will be a superposition of an unknown number of gravitational-wave sources. We consider the joint inference of various representative combinations of MBHB and EMRI signals in LISA data (with assumed instrumental noise and stochastic GB foreground). Our Bayesian analyses confirm the expectation of weak inter-source coupling between EMRIs, and between EMRIs and MBHBs, despite strong intra-source parameter correlations. Weak EMRI-MBHB coupling enables a hierarchically sequential approach to EMRI and MBHB inference, rather than fully joint inference. We further show that imperfect MBHB subtraction, arising from missing modes or overlapping MBHBs, has only a weak impact on EMRI inference. For multiple MBHBs, we mitigate inference errors through a joint MBHB fit. We demonstrate this strategy on simulated LISA data containing noise, three MBHBs, and three EMRIs, jointly fitting and subtracting the MBHBs before sequentially inferring the EMRIs - ultimately observing little to no bias on all recovered astrophysical parameters. The notions described throughout our work are highly relevant to informing optimal strategies for the global-fit-based pipelines that are currently being developed for LISA.

title: Phakoseismology: Asteroseismology of gravitationally microlensed stars
background_knowledge:
星震学通过测量恒星亮度的微小周期起伏，探测恒星内部结构。类太阳恒星的对流包层会随机激发声学振荡（p 模式），每个本征模式可用球谐函数 $Y_l^m$ 描述，其中 $l$ 为球谐度，$m$ 为方位角阶数。传统盘面积分测光给出的观测振幅，是表面亮度扰动经临边昏暗加权后的球面积分；当 $l$ 较大时，表面上相位相反的区域相互抵消，产生几何相消，使可见度随 $l$ 迅速下降。因此，对遥远恒星通常只能观测到穿透较深、$l \lesssim 3$ 的低阶模式；而携带外包层信息的 $l \geq 4$ 高阶模式几乎不可见，只有太阳等可分辨天体才能直接观测到高阶模式。
\n引力微透镜为突破这一限制提供了契机。致密透镜天体从背景源星前方掠过时，引力偏折会产生随时间变化的放大，其特征角尺度为爱因斯坦半径。当透镜与源星的角距离缩小到与源星角半径相当时，有限源效应变得重要：放大率在恒星表面不再均匀，而是呈空间梯度，源星不同表面元被放大的程度不同。对振荡恒星而言，这相当于一个短暂的空间滤波器，可打破盘面积分的对称性。另一方面，恒星自转会使每个模式分裂为 $2l+1$ 个频率相近的转动多重态，其相对功率取决于自转轴倾角 $i$；在轴对称的常规观测中，自转轴在天空的投影方位角 $\gamma$ 无法被约束。
contribution:
作者研究了高放大率微引力透镜事件能否通过差异放大振荡源星表面，暂时突破盘面积分的限制，并将这一思路称为 phakoseismology。他们建立模型，将恒星表面按临边昏暗与局部放大率加权，计算类太阳振荡多重态的可见度以及各方位角分量之间的功率分布，并构造似然模型，从可分辨的转动多重态中反演自转轴的三维取向。
\n主要结果：当透镜与源星的角距离可与源星角半径相比时，放大率梯度会充当瞬态空间滤波器，**打破盘面积分对称性，使高阶模式（$l \geq 4$）的可见度最高提升约三个数量级**。同一非轴对称加权还使各方位角分量的相对功率同时依赖自转轴倾角 $i$ 与天空投影方位角 $\gamma$，从而**将完整的自转取向信息印刻到功率谱中**；在相对功率不确定度为 $5\%$ 时，可分别以 $\sigma_i = 2.9^\circ$ 和 $\sigma_\gamma = 11.5^\circ$ 的精度恢复倾角与方位角。
\n作者也指出该方法的局限：效应在罕见的近距离交会事件中最强，难以支撑大样本统计；新出现的高阶模式会与转动分裂模式及混合模式重叠，增加模式证认的困难。尽管如此，**个别高质量事件仍可能为银河系核球及更远恒星的外包层物理与自转几何打开新的观测窗口**。
summary: Asteroseismology relies on disk-integrated photometry or radial velocities, in which geometric cancellation suppresses modes of high spherical degree ($l\geq4$). Observations are thus limited to deeply penetrating, low-degree modes, leaving the outer envelope inaccessible. We investigate whether a high-magnification microlensing event can temporarily lift this limitation by differentially magnifying the surface of an oscillating source star. We modelled the visibility of solar-like oscillations during microlensing, weighting the surface by limb darkening and the local magnification. We computed multiplet visibilities and the power distribution among azimuthal components, and built a likelihood model for recovering the 3D spin-axis orientation from resolved rotational multiplets. When the lens-source separation becomes comparable to the source's angular radius, the magnification gradient acts as a transient spatial filter that breaks the symmetry of disk integration, raising high-degree mode visibilities by up to three orders of magnitude. The same non-axisymmetric weighting makes the relative power of azimuthal components depend on both the inclination and sky-projected azimuth of the spin axis, imprinting the full spin orientation onto the power spectrum. With $5\%$ relative-power uncertainties, we recover the orientation to $σ_i=2.9^\circ$ and $σ_γ=11.5^\circ$. Microlensing thus does more than amplify distant stars: its magnification pattern enables spatially selective asteroseismology. The effect is strongest for rare close encounters and unlikely to support large samples, and the newly visible high-degree modes will overlap with rotationally split and mixed modes, complicating mode identification. Nevertheless, individual high-quality events may open a window on envelope physics and spin geometries for stars in the Galactic bulge and beyond.

title: A Radiation-Hardened, Fault-Aware Quantized Neural Network That Self-Heals
background_knowledge: 该工作属于面向空间与加速器等高辐射环境的抗辐射机器学习与可靠计算交叉方向。高能粒子击中商用现货（COTS）存储器时可能造成单粒子翻转，使神经网络中量化的权重或激活值发生位翻转，并随时间累积，导致模型推理性能退化。传统容错手段包括硬件冗余、纠错码（如 SECDED）以及 Fault-Aware Training（FAT）等训练期方法；其核心挑战在于：模型训练时通常假设参数静态且可靠，但推理阶段的新数据会经过已受损网络，静态离线保证不再充分。量化神经网络以低比特整数存储权重，因而对位翻转尤其敏感；同时，若能在不保存完整副本的前提下利用未损坏参数的结构冗余重建损坏坐标，就有可能延长运行期清洗（scrub）间隔并维持模型精度。
contribution: 论文提出 **Projection Healing**：一种在商用 COTS 硬件上、无需存储额外副本即可在运行时修复量化神经网络权重位翻转的方法。该方法扩展 FAT 范式，加入对齐惩罚，使未损坏的激活与权重集中到低秩子空间，再由未损坏的幸存坐标重建被标记的损坏坐标。作者在六个回归基准的量化神经网络上验证该方法：固定 FAT checkpoint 不变、仅开启运行时修复，可使 native-unit excess integral 进一步降低约 **23%**；这些数据集上，在 RMSE 退化 $+5\%$ 时运行 scrub 间隔中位数延长 **2.04 倍**，在退化 $+50\%$ 时延长 **1.96 倍**，而经典 SECDED 分别为 **1.62 倍**与 **1.07 倍**。该工作为设计韧性数据驱动模型提供了补充硬件冗余、ECC 与 FAT 技术的新路径。
summary: Deep learning (DL) models are increasingly being deployed into radiation-challenging environments in spacecraft, particle accelerators, and, soon, space-based data centers. Instantiated as a learned orchestration of numbers stored in persistent memory, models are susceptible to continual degradation as high-energy particles corrupt data. At inference time, new data passed through the network fundamentally break the off-line assumptions and guarantees of a static model determined during training. To preserve the quality and efficacy of the models, fault tolerance against bit flips is a clear objective. In this work we developed a runtime method for repairing the quantized weights of neural networks (NNs) after bit flips on commodity, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) hardware, without storing extra replicas. Our work extends the well-established Fault-Aware Training (FAT) paradigm by adding an alignment penalty to concentrate undamaged activations and weights into a low-rank subspace, and we then reconstruct flagged corrupted coordinates from the uncorrupted survivors. We call this method {\it Projection Healing} and apply it to six regression benchmarks on quantized NNs. Holding a FAT checkpoint fixed and toggling only the runtime heal gives a further ${\sim}23\%$ reduction in the native-unit excess integral. Across those datasets the method extends the operational scrub interval by a median of $2.04\times$ at a $+5\%$ RMSE degradation and $1.96\times$ at $+50\%$, compared with $1.62\times$ and $1.07\times$ for classical Single Error Correction, Double Error Detection (SECDED). This introduces a new path towards designing resilient data-driven models, complementing established hardware redundancy, ECC, and FAT-based techniques.

title: A $\wedge$-like metallicity profile in the disk of the Sagittarius dwarf galaxy
background_knowledge: 在冷暗物质宇宙学框架下，银河系通过等级并合逐渐组装而成，矮星系及其潮汐瓦解后形成的恒星流是研究这一过程的重要化石。人马座（Sgr）矮星系是银河系中最显著、研究最充分的瓦解卫星之一，其星流覆盖天空大片区域，为约束银河系质量分布、并合历史以及矮星系本身的结构提供了独特实验室。传统上，仅利用潮汐碎片的天空位置和视向速度重建前身星系的内禀结构十分困难；化学丰度特别是金属丰度，能记录恒星形成历史、星系盘与晕的组装以及气体耗散过程，因此“化学-运动学”联合分析成为解析星流前身性质的关键途径。N-body 模拟可追踪潮汐剥离过程中的相空间演化，并检验前身星系初始结构如何在星流中留下可观测印记。积分场光谱巡天如 MaNGA 则能在本地宇宙中系统测量矮星系的金属丰度分布，为比较幸存矮星系与被瓦解系统提供统计样本。
contribution: 本文利用 N-body 模拟解码 Sgr 矮星系恒星流中嵌入的化学-运动学信号，并成功再现了 Sgr 星流中的垂直金属丰度梯度。作者表明，若该星流起源于具有 $\wedge$ 状金属丰度剖面的盘成分，这一垂直梯度便可被自然解释，即 **Sgr 星流的垂直金属丰度梯度可追溯其前身星系盘中的 $\wedge$ 状金属丰度剖面**。进一步地，在 MaNGA 巡天数据中，$3/217$ 个场矮星系呈现出相似金属丰度剖面，说明 **该特征虽然罕见，但并非 Sgr 所独有**。研究还强调，**星流的垂直金属丰度梯度保存了额外的星系化石记录**，使人们能够定量重建卫星星系的特殊结构。Sgr 与银河系具有相似金属丰度剖面，也引出了二者是否存在特殊共同演化的问题。
summary: Unveiling the properties of the progenitors that formed the tidal structures of the Milky Way (MW) is essential for exploring the MW's assembly history. Such studies further afford a unique opportunity to dissect the formation and evolution of dwarf galaxies by contrasting surviving and disrupted systems. However, reconstructing the intrinsic structure of progenitors solely from the positions and velocities of their tidal debris remains a formidable challenge. Here, we decode the chemo-kinematic signatures embedded in the stellar streams of the Sagittarius (Sgr) dwarf galaxy through N-body simulations. Our simulation reproduces a vertical metallicity gradient in the Sgr streams. We show that this feature is naturally explained if the stream originated from a disk component with a $\wedge$-like metallicity profile. Remarkably, similar metallicity profiles are identified in MaNGA survey data for a few (3/217) field dwarf galaxies, suggesting this feature is rare but not unique to Sgr. The vertical metallicity gradient of stellar streams preserves extra detailed galactic fossil records, enabling quantitative reconstruction of the peculiar structure of the satellite galaxy. The similar metallicity profiles of Sgr and MW raise the question of a possible special coevolution.

title: A Solar Optical Clock
background_knowledge: 该工作位于天体物理高精度光谱学、光学频率计量与系外行星探测的交叉方向。传统径向速度（radial velocity，RV）方法通过测量恒星谱线的多普勒位移寻找系外行星；要发现真正的地球—太阳类比系统，需要优于 10 cm s$^{-1}$ 的长期测量精度，而单条谱线的微小位移仅相当于其光频的约 $10^{-9}$ 量级。常规做法依赖大光栅高色散光谱仪，覆盖成千上万条谱线并做精密波长定标，但受光谱仪漂移、定标源和恒星活动限制。光学频率梳（optical frequency comb）把光学频率绝对溯源到 SI 秒；激光频率锁定和相干探测则来自量子传感与光钟技术。热光外差光谱学可将激光与恒星热辐射场的单一空间或频率模式拍频，理论上受光子噪声极限约束。太阳是最近的可分辨恒星，其五分钟振荡、米粒组织、磁场与自转都会在谱线形状和质心中留下信号，因此也是检验极限光谱测量与恒星活动甄别的理想实验室。
contribution: 作者把激光频率锁定到 1565 nm 的太阳 Fe I 谱线：激光与太阳热辐射场的单一模式耦合，产生外差拍频，并用溯源至 SI 秒的光学频率梳计数，从而构成“太阳光学时钟”。系统工作在热光外差光谱学的光子噪声极限，**在单条太阳谱线上实现了约 $10^{-9}$ 的光频质心精度，相当于 30 cm s$^{-1}$ 的径向速度精度**。作者据此**恢复了太阳的五分钟声学振荡**，并在日食期间**探测到预期的 Rossiter-McLaughlin 信号**。文章进一步指出，若把该技术与 30 米级望远镜结合，有望在数小时内对最近的类太阳恒星达到演示精度；对具有不同磁场敏感度和形成深度的多条谱线进行绝对频率复用测量，可缩短平均时间，并帮助分离恒星米粒组织、活动与地球质量系外行星的多普勒信号，为天体物理光谱学中最苛刻的测量提供新途径。
summary: Precision spectroscopy underpins quantum sensing, atomic timekeeping, and the search for terrestrial-mass exoplanets. Finding an Earth-Sun analog requires fractional splitting of spectral features that rivals the precision of the best laboratory spectroscopy.
