This corresponds to resolution of a few parts in $10^5$ of a typical stellar spectral line, or a Doppler velocity precision of less than 10 cm s$^{-1}$. Only a few astrophysical spectrometers reach this regime, and only by dispersing starlight with large gratings and averaging thousands of lines. Here, we show that comparable precision can be achieved on a single solar line by leveraging techniques used in quantum sensors and optical clocks. A laser is frequency-locked to the 1565 nm solar Fe I line by coupling to a single mode of the solar thermal field and counted against an optical frequency comb referenced to the SI second, thus creating a solar optical clock. Operating at the fundamental photon-noise limit of thermal heterodyne spectroscopy, we achieve centroid precision of one part in $10^9$ of the optical frequency, or 30 cm s$^{-1}$ in radial velocity. We recover the Sun's five-minute acoustic oscillations and the expected Rossiter-McLaughlin signal during a solar eclipse. Combining these techniques from quantum sensing with a thirty-meter-class telescope could enable our demonstrated precision on the nearest Sun-like stars in a few hours. Multiplexing such absolute frequency measurements across lines with different magnetic sensitivity and formation depth would reduce averaging time and help disentangle stellar granulation and activity from the Doppler signature of terrestrial exoplanets, providing new approaches to address some of the most demanding measurements in astrophysical spectroscopy.

title: The Future of Gamma-Ray Bursts as Probes of the Epoch of Reionization in the Era of JWST and the Extremely Large Telescope
background_knowledge: 宇宙再电离时期（Epoch of Reionization，EoR）是宇宙从整体中性状态向高度电离状态过渡的关键阶段，涉及第一代恒星、星系和可能的 AGN 所产生电离辐射如何逐步电离星系际介质（IGM）。这一过程与星系形成、电离光子逃逸以及宇宙大尺度结构密切相关，但其时间进程和空间分布仍不清楚。观测上，高红移背景源光谱中的 Ly $\alpha$ 吸收特征可用于探测视线方向上的中性氢：当背景源位于再电离时期时，其 Ly $\alpha$ 发射/连续谱短波侧会受到 IGM 中性氢的强烈吸收，并在长波侧形成阻尼翼。阻尼翼的形状和强度对中性氢柱密度及中性分数敏感，因此可作为测量 EoR 的探针。伽马射线暴（GRB）余辉具有亮度高、连续谱相对平滑且可延伸至很高红移的特点，适合作为背景光源。除 IGM 外，GRB 宿主星系沿视线方向的中性氢柱密度还可用于推断电离光子逃逸分数，而平均逃逸分数是 EoR 模型的重要输入。JWST NIRSpec 与未来极大望远镜（ELT）HARMONI 等近红外光谱仪有望改进这类测量，但仪器灵敏度、曝光时间、目标机会（ToO）跟进速度及大气吸收线等因素都会影响参数反演精度。
contribution: 论文研究高红移 GRB 的 Ly $\alpha$ 阻尼翼作为 EoR 探针的能力，并评估 JWST 与 ELT 时代的观测前景。作者指出，阻尼翼可直接测量 GRB 宿主星系附近 IGM 的中性氢分数，同时给出沿视线到 GRB 的宿主星系中性氢柱密度；后者有助于推断星系电离光子逃逸分数。论文针对 JWST NIRSpec 和 ELT HARMONI 模拟了不同 GRB 星等与曝光时间下的光谱，以检验两者从阻尼翼中测量柱密度和中性分数的能力。结果表明，**两种光谱仪都将非常有效地获得中性氢柱密度估计**；尽管存在大气吸收线，**ELT HARMONI 仍是精确反演中性分数的强有力仪器**，而 **JWST NIRSpec 对于处在 ELT 较不有效红移区间内的明亮 GRB 的中性分数测量不可或缺**。此外，**缩短 JWST ToO 跟进时间将显著提高 NIRSpec 光谱所获中性分数估计的精度**。
summary: The Epoch of Reionization (EoR) is a key era of cosmological history that remains poorly understood. An examination of the Ly-alpha damping wing of high-redshift GRBs can provide direct measurements of the fraction of neutral hydrogen (i.e., neutral fraction) of the IGM in the vicinity of the GRB host galaxy, in addition to the neutral column in the host along the sight-line to the GRB. The latter quantity can help infer the fraction of ionizing photons escaping the galaxy (i.e. escape fraction); the average escape fraction being a key input to EoR models. New and upcoming observatories such as the JWST and the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) can obtain more robust estimates of the hydrogen column density and neutral fraction around high-redshift GRBs. We simulate spectra for the JWST NIRSpec and ELT HARMONI spectrographs using different GRB magnitudes and exposure times to determine their capabilities for measuring column densities and neutral fractions with the Ly-alpha damping wings of high-redshift GRBs. We find that both spectrographs will be highly effective for obtaining column density estimates. Despite the presence of telluric lines, we find that ELT HARMONI will be a powerful instrument for retrieving accurate neutral fraction estimates, but JWST NIRSpec will be vital for obtaining neutral fraction measurements for bright GRBs that fall in redshift ranges where ELT is less effective. Additionally, shorter JWST Target of Opportunity (ToO) follow-up times would greatly increase the accuracy of neutral fraction estimates obtained with NIRSpec spectra.

title: Ionized Gas Kinematics and Star-forming Clumps in Extremely Metal-poor Galaxies
background_knowledge: 极贫金属（Extremely Metal Poor，XMP）星系是本地宇宙中化学演化程度最低的星系，其金属丰度显著低于太阳值，因而被视为研究低金属丰度环境下恒星形成、气体动力学和星系组装的重要实验室。在冷暗物质框架下，星系通过气体吸积、合并和相互作用逐步组装，恒星形成、超新星爆发、星风与外流又会改变气体的金属丰度和运动状态。XMP 星系通常质量较低、恒星形成活动集中，常出现致密的恒星形成团块和复杂的气体运动，是连接早期宇宙低金属丰度星系与本地矮星系的重要对象。观测上，${\rm H}\alpha$ 发射线可追踪电离气体的速度场，发射线比值可估计气相金属丰度；长缝光谱能够在较小样本上同时研究旋转、扰动、多成分气体运动及团块性质，并检验质量—金属丰度关系和尺寸—金属丰度关系。
contribution: 论文利用 2.5 m Isaac Newton Telescope 上的 Intermediate Dispersion Spectrograph 对 9 个 XMP 星系开展长缝光谱观测，以 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 发射线追踪电离气体运动，并用发射线比值推导气相金属丰度。运动学分析表明，部分星系呈现有序旋转，但其运动学中心并不总与明亮的恒星形成头部重合；**多数系统显示扰动、非对称或下降的速度剖面**，明亮恒星形成头部附近的局域畸变则提示大质量团块会影响周围气体动力学。作者估算了主要团块的活动学质量，并考察质量—金属丰度与尺寸—金属丰度关系；这些团块的金属丰度较低，符合 XMP 区间，并与低质量矮星系中观测到的团块相当。**三个星系呈现反向旋转或运动学解耦的电离气体成分**，说明气体运动复杂，并可能涉及外部气体获取。样本以孤立系统为主，**金属贫乏的恒星形成主要集中在致密的头部区域**；这些性质可能源于合并、相互作用或从星系际介质和宇宙纤维结构吸积贫金属气体，也可能受到外流、气体混合、循环与随机恒星形成等内部过程影响。
summary: Extremely Metal Poor (XMP) galaxies are the least chemically evolved objects in the local Universe and provide important constraints on galaxy formation in low-metallicity environments. This work investigates the ionised gas kinematics and star formation properties of XMP galaxies to identify disturbed or multi-component gas motions and explore their connection with star formation. We analyse long-slit spectroscopic observations of nine XMP galaxies obtained with the Intermediate Dispersion Spectrograph on the 2.5m Isaac Newton Telescope. The study uses the H$α$ emission line to trace ionised gas and emission-line ratios to derive gas-phase metallicities. The kinematic analysis reveals that some galaxies exhibit ordered rotation, with kinematic centres not always coincident with the luminous star-forming heads. Most systems show disturbed, asymmetric, or declining velocity profiles, while localized distortions near bright star-forming heads suggest that massive clumps influence the surrounding gas dynamics. We derive dynamical masses for the dominant clumps and investigate the mass--metallicity and size--metallicity relations. The clumps exhibit low metallicities consistent with the XMP regime and comparable to those observed in low-mass dwarf galaxies. Three galaxies show counter-rotating or kinematically decoupled ionised-gas components, indicating complex gas kinematics and possible external gas acquisition. Our sample is predominantly composed of isolated systems, with metal-poor star formation concentrated in compact head regions. These properties may reflect gas accretion through mergers, interactions, or the acquisition of metal-poor gas from the intergalactic medium and cosmic filaments. Internal processes such as outflows, gas mixing, recycling, and stochastic star formation may also contribute to the observed properties.

title: Analytical Chemistry at the Planetary Frontier
background_knowledge: 行星科学依赖在远离地球实验室的环境中获得的化学测量，其对象涵盖月球、火星、小行星、彗星、冰卫星及系外行星系统。该领域的研究范式是把多种分析手段串成一条证据链：先用轨道遥感获得全球或区域尺度的矿物学、元素丰度和挥发分分布，再用着陆器与巡视器开展原位分析，随后采集并保存样品，最终在地球实验室进行高精度微区分析。轨道遥感常用可见光至近红外反射光谱、热发射光谱、伽马射线与中子谱；原位手段包括激光诱导击穿光谱（LIBS）、微区 X 射线荧光（XRF）、深紫外拉曼与荧光光谱、逸出气体分析、气相色谱与质谱联用（GC-MS）以及微型质谱。返回样品则可用二次离子质谱（SIMS 和 NanoSIMS）、原子探针层析（APT）、热电离质谱（TIMS）、同步辐射微区 X 射线荧光和 X 射线吸收近边结构（XANES）光谱等研究。由于航天器在质量、功耗、体积、数据率、辐射、真空、尘埃和自主操作方面受限，原位仪器的空间分辨率、检测限与样品消耗通常无法与实验室仪器相比；因此，污染控制、样品保存、定标、参考物质、化学计量学与多源数据融合是连接不同测量环节的关键。该领域的核心挑战是在极端环境与有限样品条件下保持化学测量的准确性、可追溯性和可解释性。
contribution: 本文把行星科学中的分析化学视为从轨道遥感、着陆器与巡视器原位测量、样品采集与保存，到地球返回样品微分析的一条连通链条，系统评述了各环节的代表性方法、污染控制与样品保存实践，以及定标、参考物质、化学计量学和数据融合在连接原位与实验室数据中的作用。文章从空间分辨率、检测限、样品消耗与通量等方面比较飞行仪器与实验室仪器，并讨论了计划用于土卫六（Titan）的 Dragonfly 任务的主动中子与伽马射线谱。核心结论是：**原位与实验室技术具有互补性；原位仪器提供地质背景并筛选样品，实验室技术则提供目前尚无法原位获得的同位素、分子与化学形态数据。**
summary: Planetary science depends on chemical measurements made under conditions very different from those in a terrestrial laboratory. This review treats the analytical methods of planetary science as one connected chain, from orbital remote sensing through in-situ measurements by landers and rovers and sample collection and curation, to the micro-analysis of returned material on Earth. Orbital methods, including visible and near-infrared reflectance, thermal emission and gamma-ray and neutron spectroscopy, are discussed first. In-situ techniques are then reviewed, including laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS), micro-focus X-ray fluorescence (XRF), deep-ultraviolet Raman and fluorescence spectroscopy, evolved gas analysis with gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and miniaturized mass spectrometry. Contamination control and curation practices are described, followed by laboratory techniques such as secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS and NanoSIMS), atom probe tomography (APT), thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMS), synchrotron micro-XRF and X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy. Accuracy, calibration and reference materials are discussed as the link between in-situ and laboratory data, and the role of chemometrics and data fusion is examined. Flight and laboratory instruments are compared in terms of spatial resolution, detection limit, sample consumption and throughput. Active neutron-gamma spectroscopy planned for the Dragonfly mission to Titan is also discussed. This comparison shows that in-situ and laboratory techniques are complementary. In-situ instruments provide context and select samples, while laboratory techniques provide isotopic, molecular and speciation data that cannot yet be obtained in situ.

title: Single-Parameter Exponential Model Outperforms Standard Dark Matter and Modified Newtonian Frameworks in Predicting Galactic Rotation Curves
background_knowledge: 星系旋转曲线描述盘星系中恒星与气体绕星系中心运动的速度随半径的变化，是检验引力理论与暗物质模型的基础观测量。若星系质量仅由可见重子物质贡献，则外盘旋转速度通常应随半径增加而下降；但大量观测显示旋转曲线在外部区域近似平坦，这通常被解释为存在延展的暗物质晕，或低加速度区引力规律偏离牛顿力学。该领域的研究范式是：构建重子盘与暗物质晕或修改引力模型，计算其预言的速度场，再与高质量旋转曲线联合拟合；并通过贝叶斯推断和信息准则比较拟合优度与模型复杂度。常见模型包括指数盘、NFW 暗物质晕、MOND 以及暗物质盘等。SPARC 数据库提供约 175 个盘星系的高质量旋转曲线与 3.6 μm 光度数据，是检验此类模型统计简约性与描述能力的常用基准样本。
contribution: 论文对 SPARC 数据库全部 175 个星系严格比较五种模型：受实测平盘旋转速度 $V_{\text{flat}}$ 物理约束的一参数经验（指数型）定律、两参数 Freeman 盘、三参数 NFW 暗物质晕加重子模型、一参数 MOND，以及两参数 Bosma/暗物质盘模型。作者采用贝叶斯框架与 MCMC 估计参数，并用 AICc 同时评估拟合优度与统计简约性。结果显示对受约束一参数经验模型的**决定性偏好**：它在多数样本中被选为最佳描述，**占 60.6%**，且取得最佳中位拟合优度，约化卡方为 $\chi^2_\nu = 0.41$。标准 NFW 框架仅在 12.6% 的星系中占优，MOND 与 Freeman 盘分别仅为 10.3% 与 9.1%，Bosma 模型尽管将动力学与气体分布相联系，也仅为 7.4%。作者据此认为，这一简单且具物理锚定的定律相对更复杂的既有理论取得显著统计与描述成功，**其函数形式可能是盘星系动力学中一个基础而高效的组织原则**。
summary: The functional forms of galactic rotation curves provide a fundamental test for models of gravity and dark matter. In this work, we conduct a rigorous statistical comparison of five distinct models against the complete sample of 175 galaxies from the SPARC database. The models under consideration are: (1) a one-parameter empirical law, physically constrained by each galaxy's measured flat disc rotation velocity ($V_{\text{flat}}$); (2) a classical two-parameter Freeman disk; (3) a three-parameter Navarro-Frenk-White (NFW) dark matter halo plus baryons model; (4) a one-parameter Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) model; and (5) a two-parameter Bosma/Dark Matter Disk model. We employ a Bayesian framework with Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) for parameter estimation, and use the Akaike Information Criterion (AICc) to assess the goodness-of-fit and statistical parsimony of the best-fit models. Our results reveal a decisive preference for the constrained one-parameter empirical model. It is selected as the best descriptor for a clear majority of the sample (60.6\%) and, critically, also achieves the best median goodness-of-fit, with a reduced chi-squared of $χ^2_ν = 0.41$. In contrast, the standard NFW framework is preferred in only 12.6\% of cases, while the MOND and Freeman disk models are selected as optimal for just 10.3\% and 9.1\%, respectively. The Bosma model, despite linking dynamics to the gas distribution, is preferred in only 7.4\% of cases. The pronounced statistical and descriptive success of this simple, physically-anchored law over more complex, established theories suggests that its functional form represents a fundamental and highly efficient organizing principle in the dynamics of disk galaxies.

title: Leviathan: a very massive, extended sub-millimetre galaxy spectroscopically confirmed at $\rm z = 4.05$
background_knowledge: 该子领域研究星系在宇宙历史中如何形成、获得质量、产生恒星并最终演化为宁静星系。亚毫米波星系（SMG）是在（亚）毫米波段选出的富尘埃、强恒星形成系统，通常位于 $z\sim 2$–$4$，恒星形成率可达数百 $M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$。传统图像认为，这类系统可能是紧凑宁静星系致密核区的建造者，因此它们的恒星质量、尺寸、尘埃分布以及是否位于恒星形成主序上，是检验星系形成模型的关键。JWST/NIRSpec 能提供高红移光谱确认和静止光学波段信息；结合从紫外到毫米波的多波段 SED 拟合与空间分辨分析，可以测量恒星质量、恒星形成率、半光半径和半质量半径，并与 $\Lambda$CDM 框架下的质量函数、尺寸—质量关系和主序关系进行比较。
contribution: 论文报告并用 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱确认了 $z=4.051$ 的亚毫米波星系 Leviathan。通过拟合从静止紫外到毫米波的 31 个波段，得到 $\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=11.34^{+0.15}_{-0.22}$，使其成为 $z>4$ 光谱确认的质量最大的星系之一；在恒星形成效率约 20% 时，这与 $\Lambda$CDM 预期一致。**Leviathan 并不像许多 SMG 那样是紧凑的致密核，而是显著延展的**：静止系 $0.9\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 半光半径为 4.3 kpc，空间分辨 SED 拟合给出半质量半径 $3.1\pm0.4$ kpc，与静止系 $1.5\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 成像的尺寸一致；该尺寸约为同质量宁静星系的三倍，但与 $4<z<5$ 恒星形成星系尺寸—质量关系外推到 $M_\star=10^{11.3}M_\odot$ 的结果相符。它位于恒星形成主序上，恒星形成率约 $400\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$，尘埃分布在整个盘上；其恒星质量和尘埃均比 $z\approx3$ 的 SMG 更延展。与质量、恒星形成率相近但尺寸小约三倍的 GN20.2b 对比表明，**$z\approx4$ 的大质量富尘埃星系可以具有非常不同的恒星结构，并非都把恒星质量集中在紧凑核区**。
summary: We present Leviathan, a sub-millimetre galaxy (SMG) spectroscopically confirmed at $z=4.051$ with JWST/NIRSpec. Modelling 31 bands of photometry from the rest-frame ultraviolet to the millimetre, we find a stellar mass of $\log(M_\star/M_\odot)=11.34^{+0.15}_{-0.22}$, making Leviathan one of the most massive spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at $z>4$, yet consistent with $Λ$CDM for a star-formation efficiency of approximately 20%. Although SMGs are often thought to be building the dense cores of compact quiescent galaxies, Leviathan is extended, with a rest-frame $0.9\,μ\mathrm{m}$ half-light radius of 4.3 kpc. Spatially resolved SED fitting gives a half-mass radius of $3.1\pm0.4$ kpc, consistent with its size in rest-frame $1.5\,μ\mathrm{m}$ imaging. This is three times larger than quiescent galaxies of the same mass, but consistent with the size-mass relation of star-forming galaxies at $4<z<5$ extrapolated to $M_\star=10^{11.3}M_\odot$. Leviathan forms stars on the main sequence (approximately $400\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$) with dust spread across its disc. Both its stellar mass and dust are more extended than those of $z\approx3$ SMGs. Alongside GN20.2b, which has a similar mass and star-formation rate but is three times smaller, these show that massive dusty galaxies at $z\approx4$ can have very different stellar structures, and that not all have their stellar mass concentrated in a compact core.

title: The SIMPLIFI Survey: Polarization of Dense Filaments with SOFIA III. Relative orientations of antenna temperature gradients with the magnetic field in the DR21 molecular cloud
background_knowledge:
分子云是恒星形成的场所，其内部气体呈高度团块化并普遍呈现纤维状结构。纤维体（filament）及其交汇处的致密脊（ridge/hub）常与大质量恒星形成相关。理解这些结构的形成与演化，需要同时考虑引力、湍流与磁场三者的竞争与耦合。磁场可通过磁流体力学（MHD）湍流、磁压支撑与磁制动等方式影响气体动力学，因此测量分子云中的磁场几何形态是理解其动力学状态的关键。
\n观测上，远红外与亚毫米波段的尘埃热辐射偏振是探测分子云磁场的重要手段。非球形尘埃颗粒在辐射转矩（RAT）等机制作用下倾向于沿磁场方向排列，使尘埃热辐射的偏振方向（电场矢量）通常垂直于磁场在天空平面上的投影。SOFIA 搭载的 HAWC+ 偏振仪可在远红外波段对大质量恒星形成区进行尘埃偏振成像，从而给出磁场的位置角分布。
\n速度通道梯度（Velocity Channel Gradient，VChG）方法利用分子谱线在薄速度切片中的强度（如天线温度）空间梯度方向来统计刻画湍流速度场与涡旋的取向。理论研究表明，不同 MHD 模式与引力坍缩会留下不同的统计取向特征：在磁化、亚阿尔芬速（sub-Alfvénic）介质中，Alfvén 模与慢模可使梯度方向与磁场呈垂直取向；快模或云体坍缩则可能产生平行取向。投影 Rayleigh 统计量（Projected Rayleigh Statistic，PRS）可定量检验梯度方向与磁场方向是平行还是垂直，是连接观测与 MHD 湍流理论预测的常用统计工具。
contribution:
本文结合 SOFIA HAWC+ 的远红外偏振观测与 Nobeyama 45 m 望远镜的 $^{12}$CO 与 $^{13}$CO $J=1-0$ 分子谱线数据，研究 DR21 分子云中的 MHD 湍流。作者将速度通道梯度（VChG）方法应用于 CO 谱线的薄速度切片，测量天线温度梯度在天空平面上的方向，并将其与尘埃偏振给出的局域磁场位置角进行比较，以检验 Alfvén 模、快模、慢模以及自引力理论预言的湍流涡旋取向。
\n作者对整片云以及 6 个感兴趣区域分别计算投影 Rayleigh 统计量（PRS），定量评估梯度方向与磁场方向的相对取向。结果显示，在包含该云大部分质量的 Main Ridge 中，梯度方向与局域磁场方向**以平行取向为主**。这种平行取向可由快 MHD 模或云体坍缩产生；结合此前光谱学研究所给出的 DR21 云大尺度坍缩证据，作者认为**自引力是造成观测到的平行取向的主要原因**。
\n此外，在与 Main Ridge 相连的 6 条子纤维中，有 1 条主要表现出**梯度方向与磁场方向垂直**的取向。作者指出，即使该子纤维正在吸积到 Main Ridge 上，这种垂直取向仍可能是**磁化、亚阿尔芬速介质中的 Alfvén 模与慢模**所产生。
summary: We investigate magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence in the DR21 molecular cloud using far infrared polarimetry from SOFIA HAWC+ and molecular spectroscopy from the Nobeyama 45~m telescope. The Velocity Channel Gradient (VChG) method is applied to thin velocity slices of the 12CO and 13CO J=1-0 emission to determine the antenna temperature gradients and their orientations in the plane of the sky. The relative orientations of the gradients with respect to the magnetic field position angles enable an evaluation of theoretically predicted alignment of elongated, turbulent eddies for Alfvenic, fast and slow modes and self-gravity. The projected Rayleigh statistic is calculated for both the full cloud and 6 regions of interest to provide a quantitative assessment of these alignments. Our analysis finds mostly parallel alignment of the gradient direction and the local magnetic field orientation in the Main Ridge of DR21 that comprises most of the cloud mass. While parallel alignment can result from fast MHD modes or cloud collapse, previous studies show spectroscopic evidence for the large scale collapse of the DR21 cloud, which supports self-gravity as the primary cause of the observed parallel alignment. One of the six sub-filaments that are connected to the Main Ridge exhibits mostly perpendicular alignment of the position angles of the gradient and magnetic field. These perpendicular relative orientations may be a product of Alfven and slow modes in a magnetized, sub-Alfvenic medium even if the sub-filament is accreting onto the Main Ridge.

title: The ALMA REBELS Survey: The [C II] Luminosity Function of UV-Selected Galaxies at $z\sim7$
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究的一个核心任务是测量不同宇宙时期星系的数量密度如何随光度、恒星质量或恒星形成率变化，并据此约束星系增长、尘埃遮蔽与反馈过程。光度函数（LF）通常用 Schechter 函数 $\Phi(L)\,\mathrm{d}L=\Phi^*(L/L^*)^{\alpha}e^{-L/L^*}\,\mathrm{d}(L/L^*)$ 描述，其中 $L^*$ 为特征光度、$\alpha$ 为暗端斜率、$\Phi^*$ 为归一化。高红移星系常通过紫外（UV）连续谱选择，但 UV 主要追踪未被尘埃严重遮蔽的年轻恒星；尘埃遮蔽强的星系可能被漏选。ALMA 可在毫米/亚毫米波段探测被红移到观测波段的 [CII] $158\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 精细结构线，该谱线是恒星形成区气体与星际辐射场的重要示踪。将 [CII] 光度函数与 UV 光度函数、恒星质量函数（SMF）及宇宙恒星形成率密度联系起来，是理解再电离时代星系演化、尘埃遮蔽和大质量暗弱星系贡献的重要研究范式。
contribution: 论文基于 REBELS（Reionization Era Bright Emission Line Survey）ALMA Large Program 及其先导项目，利用 27 个在再电离时代具有显著 [CII] 发射线探测的星系，给出了首个基于较大 UV 选择 ALMA 样本的 $z\sim7$ [CII] $158\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 光度函数。作者结合 ALPINE 样本校准了 $z\sim7$ 的 UV 光度–$L_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$ 与恒星质量–$L_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$ 关系。由于难以精确界定 REBELS 样本的选择体积，他们采用已发表的 $z\sim7$ UV LF 和 SMF 以及三种互补方法来推导 [CII] LF。基于 UV LF 的方法因遗漏尘埃遮蔽最强的系统而给出 [CII] LF 的下限；基于 SMF 的方法得到 Schechter 函数，其特征光度为 $L^*_{\mathrm{[CII]}}=10^{9.11^{+0.11}_{-0.27}} L_\odot$，并具有陡峭的暗端斜率。**从 $z\sim7$ 到 $z\sim5$，推断的 [CII] LF 在归一化上演化约 $+0.3\,\mathrm{dex}$，在 $L^*_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$ 上演化约 $+0.1\,\mathrm{dex}$**。结果还表明，模型普遍低估高红移 [CII] 发射体的丰度，因而可能低估 SMF 方法所暗示的大质量但 UV 暗弱系统的数密度。此外，**约 63% 的恒星形成率密度发生在 [CII] 明亮的大质量系统中，且 $z\sim7$ 的 [CII] 发射体可能有约 60%–90% 被明亮 UV 选择遗漏**，这凸显了在 $z>6$ 针对大质量、UV 暗弱源开展巡天的重要性。
summary: Luminosity functions (LF) are some of the most basic quantities providing insights into galaxy evolution across cosmic time and enabling a direct comparison between observations and simulations. Here, we present the first [CII]158$μ$m LF at $z\sim7$ from a sizeable UV-selected ALMA sample. Our analysis makes use of 27 galaxies with significant [CII] emission line detections in the epoch of reionization from the REBELS (Reionization Era Bright Emission Line Survey) ALMA Large Program and its pilot programs. We used these line detections and similar from ALPINE to calibrate UV luminosity-$L_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$ and stellar mass-$L_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$ relations at $z\sim7$. Given the challenge in precisely defining a selection volume for the REBELS sample itself, we rely on published UV LF and stellar mass function (SMF) determinations at $z\sim7$ and three complementary approaches to derive the [CII] LF. The UV LF-based method provides a lower limit on the [CII] LF, due to its missing the most dust-obscured systems. Our SMF-based estimate yields a Schechter function with a characteristic luminosity of $L^*_{\mathrm{[CII]}}=10^{9.11^{+0.11}_{-0.27}} L_\odot$ and a steep faint-end slope. From $z\sim7$ to $z\sim5$, our inferred [CII] LF shows an evolution of +0.3 dex in normalisation and +0.1 dex in $L^*_{\mathrm{[CII]}}$. Our results indicate a general underprediction from models of the abundance of [CII] emitters at high-redshift and thus potentially the number densities of massive yet UV-faint systems implied by our SMF-based method. Additionally, they suggest that 63% of the star formation rate density occurs in massive [CII]-bright systems and that $\sim$60-90% of [CII] emitters at $z\sim7$ may be missed by bright UV selections. This highlights the importance of surveys focusing on especially massive, UV-faint sources at $z>6$.

title: Euclid Bypass end-to-end simulations for spectroscopic galaxy clustering performance assessment
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构源于早期宇宙近高斯密度扰动的引力不稳定性演化；星系作为可见示踪物，其三维空间分布（星系成团性）携带暗物质分布、引力演化和宇宙学参数的信息。红移巡天通过测量星系光谱红移来重建径向距离，从而构建三维星系目录；其核心统计量是星系两点相关函数及其多极矩（单极矩、四极矩等），并可在包含重子声学振荡（BAO）与红移空间畸变（RSD）的框架下解释。然而，光谱红移的成功率、纯度、红移测量误差以及发射线误判（interlopers）都会改变观测到的成团性，因此必须精确刻画选择函数并用随机目录或前向建模进行校正。Euclid 卫星搭载可见光成像仪与近红外 slitless 光谱仪，其无狭缝光谱没有光纤选择，但会面临谱线重叠、空间变化噪声和复杂探测流程；全像素级端到端模拟计算量巨大，发展“bypass”式模拟成为在成团性分析所需精度上评估选择函数的有效途径。
contribution: 本文提出一套用于 Euclid 星系成团性测量的模拟框架，绕过全像素级模拟的巨大计算量，同时复现光谱处理链的关键行为。框架由两个互补工具组成：FastSpec 用简化的仪器与噪声模型模拟一维 slitless 光谱；Pypelid 在输入星系目录上计算探测概率，并计入巡天 dithering 序列与空间变化噪声。作者进一步建立经过校准的巡天选择函数、红移误差以及红移误判（interloper）群体的处方。应用于 Euclid Wide Survey 时，基线选择给出 **红移纯度 74%、样本完备度 45%**，且利用 Euclid 测光颜色可显著改善。红移误差分布具有宽度 $\sigma_z = 9.4 \times 10^{-4}$ 的高斯核心，在 $0.9 < z < 1.8$ 内没有显著红移趋势。被误判为 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 的 [O III] 5008 与 [S III] 9530 发射线按红移贡献约百分之几到百分之十；在低信噪比下，灾难性红移测量失败占主导。模拟 Data Release 1 天区表明，复杂巡天选择效应可通过前向建模的随机目录校正，**并成功恢复星系两点相关函数的单极矩与四极矩**。当前简化噪声模型未包含重叠光谱的残余污染及早期 Euclid 数据中的其他伪影，后续将结合 DR1 数据重新审视。该框架为在星系成团性科学所需精度上刻画 Euclid 光谱选择函数提供了高效途径，并构成 Euclid 星系成团性分析中系统误差评估的基础。
summary: We present a simulation framework for Euclid galaxy clustering measurements that reproduces the essential behaviour of the spectroscopic reduction chain, bypassing the computation required by full pixel-level simulations. The framework comprises two complementary tools, FastSpec, which simulates 1-dimensional slitless spectra with a simplified instrument and noise model, and Pypelid, which computes detection probabilities on input catalogues, accounting for the survey dithering sequence and spatially varying noise. We develop calibrated prescriptions for the survey selection function, redshift errors, and redshift interloper populations. Applied to the Euclid Wide Survey, the baseline selection yields a redshift purity of 74% and a sample completeness of 45%, which improves with the use of Euclid photometric colours. The redshift error distribution is found to have a Gaussian core of width $σ_z = 9.4 \times 10^{-4}$, with no significant trend over $0.9 < z < 1.8$. Emission lines [OIII]5008 and [SIII]9530 misidentified as H$α$ contribute a few to ten per cent depending on redshift, while catastrophic redshift measurement failures dominate at low signal-to-noise ratio. Simulating the Data Release 1 footprint, we find that complex survey selection effects can be corrected with a forward-modelled random catalogue, recovering the monopole and quadrupole of the galaxy 2-point correlation function. The simplified noise model does not include residual contamination from overlapping spectra, or other artefacts seen in early Euclid data; this will be revisited with DR1 data. The framework provides an efficient route for characterising the Euclid spectroscopic selection function at the precision required for galaxy clustering science, and is the basis for systematic error assessments in Euclid galaxy clustering analyses.

title: Coevolution of Dust Growth and Gravitational Instability in Massive Protostellar Disks
background_knowledge: 大质量原恒星盘是大质量恒星形成过程中承接吸积的重要结构，其质量大、温度高且自引力强，常处于引力不稳定状态。基础图像是：当盘面面密度足够高、声速或有效速度弥散足够低时，Toomre 参数 $Q$ 可接近或小于 1，盘内产生旋臂、团块乃至碎裂，并通过引力转矩与吸积爆发调控恒星生长。尘埃颗粒在盘中通过碰撞粘结增长，改变不透明度、热力学与冷却效率，从而反过来影响盘的稳定性；而引力不稳定产生的非轴对称、时变结构又会改变密度、温度与湍流，调节尘埃碰撞与输运。该子领域通常结合流体力学模拟、尘埃演化模型与辐射冷却/不透明度计算，研究盘稳定性、碎裂、吸积爆发及尘埃观测特征。
contribution: 论文采用二维流体力学模拟，自洽地追踪大质量原恒星盘中的气体动力学、尘埃增长以及依赖不透明度的辐射冷却，系统比较包含与不包含尘埃增长的模型。结果显示，盘形成后不久尘埃即可迅速增长到毫米至厘米尺度，**显著降低红外不透明度**；由此增强的冷却**促进盘碎裂，并产生比无尘埃增长模型更频繁的吸积驱动光度爆发**，其持续时间和峰值光度与大质量原恒星观测相当。尘埃增长在致密盘区总体受碎裂极限尺度调控，而新形成的外盘区和低密度区因碰撞时标有限及尘埃输运而偏离该极限。作者据此提出，**尘埃增长可能促进间歇性吸积与碎裂，而引力不稳定盘结构又反过来调控尘埃增长过程**。
summary: Massive protostellar disks are expected to sustain high accretion rates through gravitational instability, while dust growth may modify their opacity, cooling efficiency, and stability. Conversely, the time-dependent and nonaxisymmetric structures produced by gravitational instability may regulate the local conditions for dust growth. However, the coupled evolution of dust growth and gravitational instability in massive protostellar disks has not yet been explored self-consistently. We present two-dimensional hydrodynamic simulations that follow gas dynamics, dust growth, and opacity-dependent radiative cooling in a massive protostellar disk. We find that dust grains rapidly grow to millimeter-centimeter sizes shortly after disk formation, substantially reducing the infrared opacity. The enhanced cooling promotes disk fragmentation and produces more frequent accretion-driven luminosity outbursts than in a model without dust growth, with durations and peak luminosities comparable to those observed in massive protostars. Dust growth is broadly regulated by the fragmentation-limited size in dense disk regions, whereas newly formed outer disk regions and low-density regions deviate from this limit because of finite collision timescales and dust transport. These results suggest that dust growth may facilitate episodic accretion and fragmentation, while gravitationally unstable disk structures in turn regulate the dust growth process.

title: The chemical evolution of the LMC from APOGEE abundances: a hybrid two-infall OMEGA+ analysis
background_knowledge:
星系化学演化研究的是气体吸积、恒星形成与恒星反馈（核合成产额、超新星爆发、星风）如何共同塑造星系内星际介质和恒星表面的元素丰度分布。其基本图像是：大质量恒星在诞生后数 Myr 内以核心坍缩超新星（CCSN）的形式贡献 α 元素（如 O、Mg、Si）；而 Ia 型超新星（SN Ia）则要经过数百 Myr 至 Gyr 的延迟才主要贡献铁族元素。因此，$[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 随 $[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$ 的变化轨迹相当于一个“宇宙时钟”，记录了恒星形成历史与气体流入流出过程中的时序信息。
\n在理论侧，常用工具包括闭合盒模型与开放盒模型（采用瞬时循环近似或数值积分求解），以及由 Chiappini 等人倡导的“两阶段气体吸积（two-infall）”范式：早期一次贫金属气体吸积主导晕族与厚盘的形成，随后在较晚时期发生的第二次吸积带来较为富集的气体并触发新的恒星形成。描述模型的关键参数有：恒星形成效率（SFE，即单位气体质量在单位时间内的恒星形成率）、气体吸积时标与质量比、外流质量加载因子，以及不同质量恒星与 SN Ia 的核合成产额。模型的主要观测量包括金属丰度分布函数（MDF）、一维丰度分布、恒星形成历史（SFH）、当前恒星形成率与超新星率。
\n矮星系是检验这些物理过程的理想实验室：它们的引力势阱较浅，恒星形成效率低且常呈爆发式，易受气体吸积与超新星驱动外流的共同影响。大麦哲伦云（LMC）是银河系质量最大的卫星星系，正处于与银河系相互作用的状态，既拥有高分辨率光谱获得的大量成员星元素丰度（如 APOGEE 巡天），又能通过解析星族重建其恒星形成历史，因此成为检验矮星系化学演化模型的标杆目标。LMC 的一个显著特征是：其 $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$–$[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$ 中位数序列并非单调下降，而是在中等金属丰度处出现下凹后又回升，这一“非单调”形状很难用单次吸积加恒定恒星形成效率的简单模型解释，需要引入更复杂的气体吸积与恒星形成效率的变化历史。
contribution:
本文利用 APOGEE-2 DR17 中筛选出的 4933 颗 LMC 红巨星分支星，检验 LMC 的非单调 $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$–$[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$ 序列能否由“第二次气体吸积 + 恒星形成效率暂时提升”的混合历史来解释。作者对 $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$ 中位数序列进行自适应分箱，并用两区开放盒化学演化代码 OMEGA+ 拟合；正式拟合目标只包含 Mg 序列，而金属丰度分布函数（MDF）、一维丰度分布、恒星形成历史、当前质量分配、恒星形成率与超新星率则作为后验诊断量保留。

**最佳拟合模型以 0.01 dex 的均方根残差再现了 Mg 序列，并对 O 的后验分布给出高度吻合的结果。** 该模型包含两次延迟 τ 型气体吸积事件：**第二次吸积始于 $t_2 = 10.39\ \mathrm{Gyr}$，积分质量比为 $M_2/M_1 = 0.159$**；随后出现一个以 $t = 11.91\ \mathrm{Gyr}$ 为中心的高斯型恒星形成效率暂时增强。第二次吸积的气体被描述为富集气体与原生气体的混合物。模型成功复现了晚期恒星形成增强的时间，并在所采用的比较范围内给出了与观测相符的当前恒星形成率。
\n作者据此得出结论：**“第二次吸积 + 恒星形成效率提升”的混合历史是再现 LMC 观测 Mg 中位数序列的一种合理情景**，该拟合总体上较好地解释了 LMC 的演化。不过，MDF、质量与超新星率方面仍存在小的偏差，这表明若要进行更严格的比较，需要考虑选择函数效应，对恒星分布做更细致的处理。
summary: The Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) provides resolved stellar abundances and star-formation histories that can be used together to test models of dwarf-galaxy chemical evolution. We investigated if the non-monotonic APOGEE $[\mathrm{Mg}/\mathrm{Fe}]$-$[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$ sequence can be explained by a hybrid history that combines a second gas-infall episode with a temporary increase in star-formation efficiency (SFE). We selected 4933 LMC red-giant-branch stars from APOGEE-2 DR17. We fitted an adaptively binned median Mg sequence with the two-zone open-box code OMEGA+. The formal fitting objective contained only the Mg sequence. The metallicity distribution function (MDF), one-dimensional abundance distributions, star-formation history (SFH), present-day mass partition, SFR, and supernova (SN) rate were retained as posterior diagnostics. The best-fitting model reproduces the Mg sequence with an RMS residual of 0.01 dex and also gives a close posterior match to O. It contains two delayed-tau infall episodes, with the second beginning at $t_2=10.39$ Gyr and with integrated mass ratio $M_2/M_1=0.159$, followed by a temporary Gaussian SFE enhancement centred at $t=11.91$ Gyr. The second infall is represented by a mixture of enriched and primordial gas. The model reproduces the timing of the late SFH enhancement and yields a present SFR within the adopted comparison range. A hybrid second-infall and SFE-enhancement history is a plausible scenario for reproducing the observed LMC Mg median sequence. Our fit explains the LMC evolution fairly well, but the remaining small MDF, mass, and SN-rate discrepancies suggest that a selection-function-aware treatment of the stellar distributions is required for a stricter comparison.

title: Self-interacting dark matter from radiative bound-state-formation feedback
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型以冷暗物质（Cold Dark Matter）和宇宙学常数为基础，在解释宇宙大尺度结构方面非常成功。但星系尺度上的一些观测特征，例如小尺度结构问题和星系晕的密度分布，可能暗示暗物质并非完全无碰撞，而是具有可观的自相互作用。自相互作用暗物质（Self-Interacting Dark Matter, SIDM）通常引入一种轻的力媒介子，使暗物质粒子在低速度 $v$ 下发生较强的弹性散射，从而改变晕动力学。若媒介子很轻，非弹性过程（如激发、束缚态形成和湮灭）也可能非常高效；此时幺正性要求对两粒子自能核的吸收贡献进行重求和，重求和结果会反过来修正弹性和非弹性散射振幅。该研究方向连接粒子物理中的暗物质微观模型与天体物理中的星系晕观测，是当前暗物质间接探针和星系动力学研究的重要交叉领域。
contribution: 论文研究辐射束缚态形成对弹性散射的反馈，以及这一反馈对自相互作用暗物质的影响。作者指出，低速度下可观的暗物质自相互作用可由轻媒介子自然实现，而轻媒介子也会使非弹性过程非常高效；幺正性因此要求对两粒子自能核的吸收贡献进行重求和，并反馈到弹性和非弹性散射振幅中。本文重点分析通过发射带电标量粒子实现的俘获过程，并说明这类跃迁特别高效，因为散射态与束缚态由不同的有效势支配；通过发射非阿贝尔规范玻色子实现的辐射俘获也具有类似特征。作者表明，即使基线弹性振幅为零，上述反馈仍可产生对晕动力学重要的可观弹性散射，**并且生成的弹性截面可在低速度下增大，呈现类似长程散射的行为**。伴篇论文则讨论湮灭过程产生的反馈。
summary: Observations of galactic structure motivate sizable dark-matter self-interactions at low velocities, naturally realized through light force mediators. Such mediators can also make inelastic processes very efficient. Unitarity then requires their absorptive contributions to the two-particle self-energy kernel to be resummed, which in turn feeds back into both the elastic and inelastic scattering amplitudes. We study the feedback of radiative bound-state formation on elastic scattering and its implications for self-interacting dark matter. We focus on capture processes through emission of a charged scalar; such transitions are particularly efficient because the scattering and bound states are governed by different effective potentials, a feature also shared by radiative capture through emission of a non-Abelian gauge boson. We show that their feedback can generate sizable elastic scattering relevant for halo dynamics, even when the baseline elastic amplitude vanishes. Notably, the generated elastic cross section can grow toward low velocities, resembling long-range scattering. A companion paper examines the feedback from annihilation processes.

title: Annihilation feedback on elastic scattering in self-interacting dark matter
background_knowledge: 自相互作用暗物质（Self-Interacting Dark Matter, SIDM）是应对星系尺度结构观测挑战的重要暗物质候选框架：在标准 $\Lambda$CDM 模型之外，暗物质粒子之间若存在可观的弹性散射，就可能改变星系晕中心的密度分布并缓解小尺度难题。此类自相互作用通常由交换轻媒介子产生，因而对应长程力；当媒介子质量远小于暗物质质量时，散射可进入非微扰区域，并出现 Sommerfeld 增强、共振以及束缚态等现象。与此同时，轻媒介子也使非弹性过程（如湮灭、激发和束缚态形成）变得重要。由光学定理，总截面与向前散射振幅的虚部相联系，因此弹性散射与非弹性散射不能彼此独立处理：非弹性过程会给决定弹性振幅的两粒子自能核带来吸收性贡献，并改变入射态动力学，反过来影响非弹性振幅。该子领域的研究范式通常是把弹性、非弹性和束缚态过程放在统一的量子散射或少体框架中处理，检查幺正性、解析结构和低速度极限，并将结果映射到星系尺度观测。
contribution: 本文研究长程力存在时暗物质湮灭对弹性散射的反馈。尽管湮灭本身是短程过程，长程力可将其强烈增强；借助幺正性与光学定理，研究指出非弹性湮灭通过吸收性自能核修正弹性振幅，同时改变入射态动力学。主要结论是：**湮灭反馈在 Sommerfeld 共振附近变得显著，会压低基线弹性截面在低速度下的增长趋势；在基线弹性散射零点附近，它可产生由幺正性要求的非零弹性散射下限。** 摘要还说明，伴论文将研究辐射束缚态形成对弹性散射的反馈，该机制可产生可观的暗物质自相互作用。
summary: Sizable dark-matter self-interactions, motivated by observations of galactic structure, often arise from the exchange of light force mediators. Light mediators can render scattering nonperturbative and make inelastic processes important. Unitarity, via the optical theorem, implies that elastic and inelastic interactions cannot be treated independently: inelasticity induces absorptive contributions to the two-particle self-energy kernel that determines the elastic amplitude, while the resulting incoming-state dynamics also modifies the inelastic amplitudes. We study the feedback of dark-matter annihilation on elastic scattering in the presence of a long-range force. Although annihilation is a short-distance process, it can be strongly enhanced by such a force. We find that its feedback becomes significant near Sommerfeld resonances, where it suppresses the low-velocity growth of the baseline elastic cross section. Near baseline elastic-scattering zeros, it may instead generate a nonzero elastic floor required by unitarity. A companion paper studies the feedback of radiative bound-state formation on elastic scattering, which can generate sizable self-interactions.

title: KMOS Spectroscopic Follow-up of 16 Star Cluster Candidates of the Sagittarius Dwarf Galaxy
background_knowledge:
在近邻宇宙中，矮椭球星系（dwarf spheroidal galaxy，dSph）是暗物质主导、恒星形成历史古老的低质量星系，也是检验星系形成与化学演化的关键实验室。人马座（Sagittarius，Sgr）矮椭球星系是银河系晕中一个正在被潮汐瓦解的 dSph，其主体距离约 26 kpc，并拖曳出一条环绕银河系的长潮汐尾。它与若干已知球状星团（如 M54、Terzan 7、Terzan 8、Arp 2、Palomar 12 等）在空间位置与运动学上相互关联，被认为是这些星团可能的母星系，因此是研究星团—星系关联与潮汐剥离的理想目标。
\n球状星团是成百上千至数百万颗恒星组成的引力束缚致密系统，在颜色—星等图上表现为清晰的等龄线序列，在空间上表现为显著的中心超密度（overdensity），在速度上表现为相对背景场星较小的速度弥散。传统证认依赖空间聚集、自行、视向速度、金属丰度与光度学等多维信息。然而在 Sgr 中心方向，沿视线方向分布的密集 Sgr 场星本身就可能产生虚假的空间或运动学聚集；仅凭位置或 Gaia 天体测量结构，很容易把场星的统计涨落误认为星团。因此必须联合光谱运动学、化学丰度与测光信息，并考虑对多个候选体同时检验所带来的多重性（look-elsewhere effect）导致的假阳性风险。
\n观测手段方面，KMOS 是 VLT 上的近红外多目标积分视场光谱仪，其 $H$ 波段覆盖 Na I、Ca I 三重线、CO 分子带等关键谱线，可测量红巨星分支与渐近巨星分支恒星的视向速度与金属丰度；近红外波段受尘埃消光影响较小，适合观测高消光、恒星密集的银盘与核球方向。结合 VVVX 近红外测光与 Gaia DR3 自行，可以构建空间、运动学与化学性质联合的成员判定框架。
contribution:
本文利用 VVVX-GalCen Spectroscopic Survey 的 KMOS $H$ 波段光谱，对人马座矮椭球星系的 16 个 Minni 星团候选体开展后续观测，共分析 341 颗目标星，测量其视向速度与经验金属丰度，并与独立的 Sgr 光谱样本进行比较；同时结合 VVVX 测光与 Gaia DR3 天体测量，检验各候选天区相对于局部控制场是否存在局域恒星超密度。
\n结果显示：341 个 KMOS 目标中有 256 个（75%）的视向速度落在所采用的 Sgr 区间内，其金属丰度总体与 Sgr 对照群体重叠，说明这些目标主要示踪 Sgr 星族。**在计入对多个候选体进行检验的多重性修正后，没有任何一个天区给出统计上令人信服的、独立恒星系统的运动学证据**；Minni 329 显示出最强的空间超密度，但经多重检验校正后并不显著，且没有伴随显著的中心聚集。**因此，这 16 个候选体在现有数据下均无法被确认为独立的恒星系统**，但这一结果并不等于证明原候选体是虚假的；作者指出仍需更深成像与更大光谱样本才能确定其物理本质。
summary: The Sagittarius (Sgr) dwarf spheroidal galaxy hosts several known globular clusters and numerous additional cluster candidates identified toward its crowded central regions. Establishing the nature of these candidates is difficult because apparent spatial and astrometric structure can arise from the underlying Sgr population. We investigate sixteen Minni stellar-cluster candidates with KMOS spectroscopy to determine whether the observed stars are compatible with Sgr and whether any candidate field shows evidence for a distinct stellar system. We analyse H-band KMOS spectra of 341 targets from the VVVX-GalCen Spectroscopic Survey, deriving radial velocities (RVs) and empirical metallicities. We compare these with an independent Sgr spectroscopic sample and use VVVX photometry and Gaia DR3 astrometry to test for localized stellar excesses relative to local control fields. Of the 341 KMOS targets, 256 (75%) have RVs within the adopted Sgr interval, and their metallicities broadly overlap the Sgr comparison population. No field shows statistically compelling kinematic evidence for a distinct system after accounting for the multiple candidates examined. Minni 329 shows the strongest spatial excess, but this is not significant after multiple-testing correction and is not accompanied by significant central concentration. The KMOS targets predominantly trace the Sgr population, but Sgr compatibility alone does not confirm the individual candidates as distinct stellar clusters. None of the sixteen fields can be confirmed as a separate stellar system with the present data, although this does not establish that the original candidates are spurious. Deeper imaging and larger spectroscopic samples are required to determine their physical nature.

title: MadStree: automated evaluation of tree-level de Sitter correlators
background_knowledge: 宇宙学关联函数是连接极早期宇宙量子涨落与晚期天文观测的核心统计量。在暴胀图像中，宇宙经历近 de Sitter 的加速膨胀，标量场与度规的量子涨落在视界退出后变为经典曲率扰动；其两点及高阶关联函数编码功率谱、非高斯性等信息，并可通过 CMB 与大尺度结构观测检验。理论计算通常在 Bunch-Davies 真空下使用 in-in 形式，将晚时关联函数写成对历史路径的积分，并按相互作用顶点展开为树图与圈图。树级宇宙学关联函数对应无圈图，是检验暴胀相互作用、理解高阶关联的首要对象；但涉及多个体传播子、时间积分和复杂动量依赖，解析计算随外线数与顶点数迅速变复杂。递归关系、微分方程与符号计算自动化因此成为该方向的重要研究范式。
contribution: 论文针对任意树级宇宙学关联函数，推导了递归约化公式与 dlog 形式微分方程，并显式纳入无质量体传播子的外线关系。该微分方程可被系统求解，从而对树级 de Sitter 关联函数进行高效计算。作者将方法实现为 Mathematica 软件包 MadStree，使用户能够方便地计算任意树级宇宙学关联函数。**核心成果是建立一套可系统化、自动化的树级宇宙学关联函数计算框架，并发布可用的 MadStree 工具。**
summary: We first derived the formulae of recursive reduction and dlog-form differential equations for arbitrary tree-level cosmological correlator, taking the external relations of massless bulk propagators into consideration. The differential equations could be systematically solved and provide the efficient evaluation of them. We have implemented this methodology as a user-friendly Mathematica package MadStree for computing arbitrary tree-level cosmological correlators.

title: Floquet Instability of Photon-Axion Conversion
background_knowledge:
轴子（axion）最初是为解决强 CP 问题而提出的赝戈德斯通玻色子，也可作为暗物质候选粒子或超出标准模型新物理的代表。其关键特征之一是通过 $g_{a\gamma\gamma}\,a\,F_{\mu
u}	ilde F^{\mu
u}$ 与电磁场耦合，因此在外部磁场中轴子与光子可以相互转化。这一“轴子-光子转化”是轴子探测（如太阳轴子望远镜、腔体实验）和天体物理限制的核心物理基础，转化概率通常依赖于磁场强度、相干长度、轴子质量以及等离子体效应。

Floquet 理论描述周期性驱动系统：若系统哈密顿量随时间周期变化，则可引入准能量与 Floquet 模式；当不同 Floquet 复制态发生共振交叉时，可能出现指数增长的不稳定模式，即参量共振或 Floquet 不稳定性。将这一框架用于轴子-光子混合系统，需要把空间与时间周期性磁场背景下的耦合波动方程化为可分析的周期线性系统，并研究其模式稳定性。
contribution: 论文研究在同时具有空间周期性与时间周期性的背景磁场中发生的轴子-光子转化。作者通过 Lorentz 变换将耦合的轴子-光子系统映射为时间周期线性系统，并利用 Floquet 定理进行分析。研究发现，与 Floquet 复制态之间共振交叉相关联的不稳定模式会产生复 Floquet 指数，从而导致指数增长的解，作者将其识别为 **Floquet 不稳定性**。随后，作者通过微扰分析确定了该不稳定性出现的参数区域，并进一步表明该不稳定性能够增强由初始光子场产生的轴子场振幅。**论文结论表明，时空周期性的磁场背景可通过 Floquet 不稳定性提供一种独特的机制，用以调制轴子-光子转化。**
summary: The discovery of axions would provide evidence for physics beyond the Standard Model. In this work, we investigate axion-photon conversion in the presence of a background magnetic field with simultaneous spatial and temporal periodicity. By performing a Lorentz transformation, the coupled axion-photon system is mapped onto a time-periodic linear system that can be analyzed using Floquet theorem. We find unstable modes associated with resonant crossing between Floquet replicas. The resulting complex Floquet exponents lead to exponentially growing modes, which we identify as a Floquet instability. Then, we determine the parameter regions in which this instability appears in a perturbative analysis. We further show that the Floquet instability enhances the axion-field amplitude generated from an initial photon field. Our results demonstrate that spatiotemporally periodic magnetic backgrounds provide a distinct mechanism for modifying axion-photon conversion through Floquet instability.

title: Searching for Dense Perturbers in Cold Dark Matter Simulations
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型 $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ 中，暗物质约占宇宙能量密度的四分之一，并通过引力主导结构形成。冷暗物质（CDM）无压且自由流动尺度小，因而在等级成团框架下先形成低质量暗晕，再并合形成星系尺度的暗晕；大质量暗晕中应保留大量子晕（subhalo）。CDM 数值模拟通常预言子晕密度轮廓近似为 NFW 型：内区斜率较缓（即 $\rho \propto r^{-1}$），并可由浓度参数描述。子晕在宿主晕中受潮汐剥离，外缘被截断，内区相对保留，因此其内密度和浓度是检验暗物质性质的重要探针。观测上，引力透镜（尤其强透镜通量比异常、透镜扰动）、恒星流扰动以及卫星星系动力学可用于推断低质量致密扰动体；若这些扰动体被解释为暗物质子晕，其内密度高于 CDM 预言，会构成“致密子晕问题/小尺度危机”的一类表现，也可能暗示自相互作用暗物质、温暗物质、模糊暗物质或特殊形成历史。该领域通过高分辨率宇宙学模拟与观测统计比较，检验 CDM 在小尺度上的有效性。
contribution: 作者利用一个仅含 CDM 的银河系质量类似体 zoom-in 高分辨率模拟，系统检验观测推断的致密扰动体与 CDM 子晕之间的密度张力。他们分析 **超过 5000 个子晕，质量低至 $10^6\,M_\odot$**，并用潮汐截断模型重建其内密度轮廓，然后将模拟子晕与观测到的致密扰动体在密度轮廓、包围质量、浓度和投影圆柱质量等统计量上进行比较。核心结果是：**在所模拟的 CDM 子晕中，没有任何一个具有足够高的内密度，能够重现观测扰动体所推断的质量分布**。作者还考察了子晕浓度随红移的演化，并给出描述该演化的拟合函数。该结果促使进一步研究能否通过极罕见的形成历史产生此类致密扰动体，以及是否需要超出标准 CDM 的物理机制。
summary: Recently, several low-mass, dense perturbers have been inferred from astrophysical observations of gravitational lensing, stellar streams, and satellite galaxies. If interpreted as dark matter subhalos, their inner densities exceed the predictions of the standard cold dark matter (CDM) model. We systematically investigate this tension using a CDM-only zoom-in simulation of a Milky Way analog. We analyze more than 5000 subhalos with masses down to $10^6\,M_\odot$ and reconstruct their inner density profiles using a tidal truncation model. The simulated subhalos are then compared with the observed compact perturbers in terms of their density profiles, enclosed masses, concentrations, and projected cylindrical masses. None of the simulated CDM subhalos is sufficiently dense to reproduce the inferred mass distributions of the observed perturbers. We further examine the redshift evolution of subhalo concentrations and derive a fitting function to characterize this evolution. Our findings motivate further investigations into exceptionally rare formation histories that could produce such dense perturbers, as well as the possibility of physics beyond the standard CDM model.

title: Are Dynamical Dark-Energy Cosmologies Old Enough?
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 ΛCDM 模型为基准：当前宇宙的能量组成中约 68% 为暗能量、约 27% 为冷暗物质，其余为重子与辐射；暗能量通过加速宇宙膨胀影响膨胀历史、距离—红移关系以及宇宙年龄。标准情形下暗能量被当作宇宙学常数，其状态方程满足 $w=p/\rho=-1$；检验暗能量是否随时间演化常采用 $w(a)=w_0+w_a(1-a)$ 或 $w_0w_a$ 参数化，其中 $w_0$ 为当前状态方程值，$w_a$ 描述其演化幅度。观测上，重子声学振荡（BAO）、宇宙微波背景（CMB）与 Ia 型超新星等数据联合可约束 $(w_0,w_a)$，近期 DESI 相关分析对偏离 ΛCDM 的动力学暗能量给出了一定统计偏好。与此同时，宇宙年龄由膨胀历史积分决定，最古老恒星与球状星团的年龄测定提供了独立的下限；若某组宇宙学参数要求宇宙比最老天体更年轻，则该参数组合在物理上不可接受。因此，恒星纪年可作为检验暗能量演化信号稳健性的独立宇宙学一致性条件。
contribution: 论文针对 DESI DR2+CMB+Pantheon+ 数据所给出的 $w_0w_a$ 暗能量偏好，引入最老恒星种群年龄作为独立的宇宙学一致性要求，对允许的膨胀历史施加逐步增强的下限：$t_0 \geq 13.6$、$13.75$、$13.8$ 与 $13.85$ Gyr。结果显示，**随着最小允许宇宙年龄提高，$(w_0,w_a)$ 后验系统性地向 ΛCDM 预测 $(w_0,w_a)=(-1,0)$ 移动**；**当 $t_0 \geq 13.85$ Gyr 时，相对 ΛCDM 的马氏距离由 $2.56\sigma$ 降至 $1.72\sigma$，ΛCDM 预测进入 95% 可信区域**。作者据此指出，**当前动力学暗能量证据对独立的宇宙年龄信息敏感，恒星纪年可作为检验 DESI 所偏好膨胀历史的直接稳健性测试；要求足够古老的宇宙可显著降低对标准 ΛCDM 偏离的统计偏好**。
summary: Recent analysis combining baryon acoustic oscillation measurements with cosmic microwave background and Type Ia supernova data show an apparent preference for a time-dependent dark-energy equation of state within $w_0w_a$ parameterizations. Here we test the robustness of this result against an independent cosmological consistency requirement, namely that the expansion history must provide sufficient time to accommodate the oldest observed stellar populations. Motivated by recent stellar and globular-cluster age determinations, we impose progressively stronger lower bounds, $t_0 \geq 13.6$, $13.75$, $13.8$, and $13.85$ Gyr, on the expansion histories allowed by DESI DR2+CMB+Pantheon+ data. We find a systematic displacement of the posterior in the $(w_0,w_a)$ plane toward the $Λ$CDM prediction, $(w_0,w_a)=(-1,0)$, as the minimum allowed age is increased. For $t_0 \geq 13.85$ Gyr, the Mahalanobis separation from $Λ$CDM decreases from $2.56σ$ to $1.72σ$, bringing the $Λ$CDM prediction inside the 95\% credible region. Our results show that the current evidence for dynamical dark energy is sensitive to independent cosmic-age information and that stellar chronometry provides a direct robustness test of the DESI-favored expansion histories. Requiring sufficiently old cosmologies can appreciably reduce the statistical preference for departures from the standard $Λ$CDM model.

title: The GLEAM 4-Jy (G4Jy) Sample: V. Broadband spectral analysis
background_knowledge:
射电噪活动星系核（radio-loud AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞吸积提供能量，以相对论性喷流把能量与物质注入周围介质，形成延展的射电瓣（radio lobe）。射电辐射主要来自相对论电子在磁场中的同步辐射，若忽略辐射损失，宽波段能谱近似为幂律 $S_
u \propto 
u^{-\alpha}$：延展的瓣通常为陡谱（$\alpha \sim 0.7$–$0.8$），而致密的射电核多为平坦谱（$\alpha \lesssim 0.5$）。当低频端出现能谱转折（turnover）时，一般归因于同步自吸收（SSA）或自由–自由吸收（FFA），这类峰值谱源（GPS/CSS 型）往往对应年轻、且/或处于致密环境中的射电星系，因此宽波段 SED 的“弯曲”本身携带了年龄与环境的信息。

射电瓣的膨胀常用自相似动力学模型描述：瓣在环境介质中扩张，环境密度剖面常取 King 型 $ho(r) \propto [1+(r/r_c)^2]^{- eta}$。环境越致密，瓣膨胀越慢、内部磁场越强，同步辐射与逆康普顿损失也越显著，于是射电功率–尺度（$P$–$D$）图（类似赫罗图）成为区分演化阶段与环境性质的重要诊断工具。RAiSE（Radio AGN in Semi-analytic Environments）是一套半解析演化框架，以喷流功率、活动时标与环境密度剖面为输入，预言射电瓣的尺度与光度随时间的演化，从而可由观测 SED 反演源的年龄与喷流功率等物理量。

观测层面，低频巡天是搜寻与刻画射电 AGN 的关键：MWA 的 GLEAM 巡天覆盖 72–231 MHz 并具有优良的低频灵敏度；ASKAP 的 RACS 在约 700–1800 MHz 提供高分辨率图像；ATCA 则可跟进到数十 GHz。多频点、宽波段的通量密度测量（$1\ \mathrm{Jy} = 10^{-26}\ \mathrm{W\,m^{-2}\,Hz^{-1}}$）是把 SED 从单一幂律推广到含弯曲与峰值的物理模型的基础；而亮源样本（如数 Jy 量级）虽数目有限，却因信噪比高、可进行多波段详细建模，成为检验射电星系演化模型的理想实验室。
contribution:
本文是 G4Jy 样本系列的第五篇，聚焦宽波段射电谱分析。G4Jy 样本共包含 1,863 个南天最亮的射电源，选自 GLEAM 巡天在 151 MHz 的星表。作者对 RACS 在 887.5、1367.5 与 1655.5 MHz 的射电图像逐源进行目视检查，并以 flag 系统记录射电辐射关联的质量评估；结合已有的低频数据以及 ATCA 最高至 20 GHz 的观测，为源构建宽波段射电谱能量分布（SED）。
\n作者用多项式函数拟合这些 SED，并统计各源的最优拟合模型类型，发现 **约 11% 的样本由吸收（峰值谱）模型最优描述**。随后使用 RAiSE 半解析框架对 SED 进一步建模，分别假设三种环境密度剖面（由典型晕质量 $10^{12.5}$、$10^{13.5}$、$10^{14.5}\ M_\odot$ 设定）。结果表明，**导出的源年龄在射电功率–尺度（$P$–$D$）图上呈现出符合预期的分布**；同时**导出的喷流功率表现出非线性行为**，作者认为这是由较高密度环境所伴随的较强磁场限制了射电喷流与射电瓣的膨胀所致。
summary: The G4Jy Sample consists of 1,863 of the brightest sources in the southern sky, as selected at 151 MHz using the GaLactic and Extragalactic All-sky MWA (GLEAM) survey. We supplement existing, low-frequency radio data by completing visual inspection of radio images from the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS) at 887.5, 1367.5 and 1655.5 MHz. Doing so on a source-by-source basis allows us to assess the quality of the association of the radio emission, which we indicate via a flag system. Having multiple radio flux-densities allows us to construct broadband radio spectral energy distributions (SEDs), and these extend up to 20 GHz for sources that also have data from the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA). We fit polynomial functions to these SEDs, and determine the distribution of sources that are best-fit by absorption models, these accounting for 11 per cent of the sample. The SEDs are further modelled using the Radio AGN in Semi-analytic Environments (RAiSE) framework, for three assumed density-profiles (set by typical halo masses of 10^12.5, 10^13.5, and 10^14.5 Msol). The derived source ages show the expected distribution in the radio-power--size (P--D) diagram, whilst derived jet powers show non-linear behaviour. The latter is believed to be the result of higher densities, associated with higher magnetic fields, restricting the expansion of the radio jets/lobes.

title: A Multipole Technique for the Simulation and Analysis of Gravitational Waveforms from Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals
background_knowledge:
极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是指一个恒星级致密天体（如恒星级黑洞、中子星或白矮星）绕超大质量黑洞缓慢旋近并最终并合的引力波源。其质量比可达 $10^{-6}$ 至 $10^{-4}$，轨道在旋近过程中会经历大量周期，且往往具有明显的偏心率和轨道倾角，因此波形携带了强场时空几何、中心黑洞质量与自旋以及轨道参数的丰富信息，是空间引力波探测器（如 LISA）的重要目标。
\n在理论上，EMRI 常被处理为 Kerr 时空中的测试粒子测地线运动，并叠加缓慢的辐射反作用。Kerr 时空的测地线运动可积，轨道由能量 $E$、轴向角动量 $L_z$ 与 Carter 常数 $Q$ 等守恒量描述。辐射反作用使这些量随旋近缓慢演化；在绝热近似下，能量与角动量的演化可由引力波通量给出，但 Carter 常数的演化更微妙，需要借助自引力、Teukolsky 通量或有效方案来建模。研究范式通常包括高精度测地线积分、辐射反作用模型、波形模板构造、参数估计以及检验广义相对论。环境效应（如吸积盘相互作用、潮汐扰动）则代表对理想真空、点粒子图像的重要扩展。
contribution: 论文提出并介绍了 EMRICode，一个基于 Python 的数值框架，用于在 Kerr 时空中演化一般的极端质量比旋近（EMRI）。该框架将测试粒子测地线的自适应数值积分与轨道运动守恒量的长期演化模型相结合，可跟踪偏心、倾斜轨道在长时间旋近尺度上的演化。论文重点处理 Carter 常数 $Q$，其演化不能由当前模型所用的能量与轴向角动量主导阶通量直接确定。作者考察了多种确定 $Q$ 演化的方案，发现 **基于径向势的方案在所考察方案中行为最稳定，但对近平面轨道存在系统性残余偏差**。论文还将所得旋近结果与已有辐射反作用近似进行比较，包括 Peters 弱场处理和文献中基于 Kerr 时空的方案，并据此评估实现的定性行为与局限。**EMRICode 的模块化结构允许辐射反作用方案独立于底层测地线演化进行替换**，从而为纳入更精确的通量模型和额外物理效应提供框架。文中给出两个简单示例，说明与吸积盘相互作用以及部分潮汐瓦解如何驱动恒星级 EMRI 轨道演化。**因此，EMRICode 为研究 EMRI 轨道动力学以及探索超越理想真空、点粒子近似的扩展提供了灵活的计算框架。**
summary: We introduce EMRICode, a Python-based numerical framework for evolving generic extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) in Kerr spacetime. The code combines adaptive numerical integration of test-particle geodesics with a prescribed model for the secular evolution of the orbital constants of motion, allowing eccentric and inclined trajectories to be followed over long inspiral timescales. We focus in particular on the treatment of the Carter constant, whose evolution is not directly determined by the leading-order fluxes for energy and axial angular momentum used in the present model. We investigate several prescriptions for determining its evolution and find that a radial-potential-based prescription provides the most stable behavior among those considered, while also exhibiting a systematic residual bias for nearly planar orbits. We compare the resulting inspirals with established radiation-reaction approximations, including the weak-field treatment of Peters and Kerr-based prescriptions from the literature, and use these comparisons to assess the qualitative behavior and limitations of the implementation. The modular structure of EMRICode allows the radiation-reaction prescription to be replaced independently of the underlying geodesic evolution, providing a framework for incorporating more accurate flux models and additional physical effects. We present two simple examples of how interactions with accretion disks and partial tidal disruptions can drive the evolution of a stellar EMRI orbit. EMRICode therefore provides a flexible computational framework for studying the orbital dynamics of EMRIs and for exploring extensions beyond the idealized vacuum, point-particle approximation.

title: 20,000 Rotation Periods in Nearby Open Clusters and Moving Groups from ZTF and ASAS-SN
background_knowledge: 恒星自转是低质量恒星演化中的基本参量之一。对于 GKM 型主序星，对流外层与磁场耦合产生的星风会带走角动量，即磁制动，使恒星自转整体随年龄减慢；自转还与恒星内部结构、磁活动、星斑、耀发以及星—行星相互作用密切相关。因此，测量不同质量、金属丰度和年龄恒星的自转周期 $P_{\mathrm{rot}}$，是检验角动量演化与磁制动模型的核心途径，也是利用“陀螺年代学”估算恒星年龄的基础。疏散星团和移动群中的恒星大致同时形成，并共享初始化学组成和距离，这使它们成为研究自转—质量—年龄—金属丰度关系的天然实验室。传统上，星团自转样本多来自空间测光，例如 Kepler、K2 和 TESS；空间任务在测光精度和连续性上有优势，但天区覆盖、观测基线或样本选择可能带来偏差。地面长基线时域巡天可覆盖更广天区并提供多年基线，是空间测光的重要补充；不过周期光变信号并不只来自恒星自转，还包括食双星、脉动变星等，需要结合成员星证认和变源分类来构建干净、无偏的星团自转样本。
contribution: 论文利用 Zwicky Transient Facility（ZTF）和 All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae（ASAS-SN）的地面长基线时域测光，面向距离约 $1.5\ \mathrm{kpc}$ 以内的近邻疏散星团与移动群成员，构建了包含约 20,000 个周期光变信号的星表；这些信号涵盖恒星自转、食双星和经典脉动变星等类型。**该工作的核心贡献是建立一个大规模、基于地面巡天且适用于近邻星团与移动群成员的周期光变样本**，从而弥补空间测光在覆盖和基线方面的局限。该星表为研究恒星角动量演化对质量、化学组成和年龄的依赖提供了新的经验基础，并可用于在较宽的质量和演化状态范围内检验磁制动模型。摘要未报告具体的自转—年龄关系或磁制动定律的定量结果，其价值主要体现为观测目录与后续分析基础。
summary: Open clusters provide uniquely powerful laboratories for studying stellar evolution because their members share a common age and chemical composition. Stellar rotation of low-mass GKM dwarfs in open clusters provides direct empirical constraints on magnetic braking, with implications for stellar interiors, magnetic activity, and star--planet interactions. However, existing cluster rotation samples are dominated by space-based observations, whose limited spatial coverage and short observing baselines can make it difficult to construct an unbiased sample. Long-baseline ground-based time-domain surveys therefore provide an important complement to space-based photometry. I present a catalog of $\sim$20,000 periodic photometric signals, including stellar rotations, eclipsing-binaries, and classical pulsators, measured from the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) and the All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae (ASAS-SN) for members of nearby open clusters and moving groups within 1.5 kpc. This catalog provides a new empirical foundation for studying the mass, chemical composition, and age dependence of stellar angular-momentum evolution and for testing models of magnetic braking across a broad range of stellar masses and evolutionary states.

title: Optical and Ultraviolet Emission from the Gas Photoionized by Gaia BH3: Archival Constraints and Predictions for the 2029 Periastron
background_knowledge: Gaia BH3 是一个约 32.7 $M_\odot$ 的恒星级黑洞，与一颗金属贫巨星组成宽轨道、偏心双星，轨道周期约 11.6 yr、偏心率 $e=0.73$，距离约 590 pc。它处于低吸积率、风致吸积情形：巨星风被黑洞引力捕获，但只有一小部分气体能到达黑洞附近。理解本文需要几个前置概念。第一，Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 捕获：风物质能否被黑洞吸积取决于黑洞质量、风速、轨道间距和气体密度，轨道偏心率会改变近星点与远星点的捕获效率。第二，Eddington 光度与 Eddington 比：$L_{\rm Edd}=4\pi G M m_p c/\sigma_T$，$f_{\rm Edd}=L/L_{\rm Edd}$；低 $f_{\rm Edd}$ 时吸积流往往是光学薄、辐射效率低的热流，其电离光谱与标准薄盘不同。第三，光致电离与复合线：热吸积流发出的紫外和 X 射线光子被星风或入流气体吸收后，会激发并复合产生 H$\alpha$、He II 4686 等谱线；这些线的强度反映被吸收的电离光子数，线宽和轮廓反映气体的密度、速度与运动学。第四，高分辨率光学光谱，如 UVES 和 ESPRESSO，可检验弱发射线并给出速度信息。Gaia BH3 的 2029 年近星点将提高捕获率和观测机会，因此可用光学/紫外发射线独立约束其风质量损失率与吸积状态，并与 X 射线、射电上限互补。
contribution: 论文研究 Gaia BH3 风致吸积中被热流光致电离气体能否产生可观测的光学和紫外发射线，以及这些线能揭示什么。与 X 射线、射电观测不同，光学/紫外谱线直接计数气体吸收的电离光子，并示踪气体密度和速度。作者用 Cloudy 计算沿轨道变化的 H$\alpha$ 和 He II 4686 发射，模型覆盖 $\dot M_{\rm w}=10^{-11}$–$10^{-8}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$、$f_{\rm Edd}=10^{-8}$–$10^{-5}$，并考虑 30 km s$^{-1}$ 慢风和 100 km s$^{-1}$ 快风，再把每个模型与档案 UVES 和 ESPRESSO 光谱比较。结果表明 **$f_{\rm Edd}$ 主要决定线强**；在密集模型中，谱线来自自由落向黑洞的气体，速度展宽可达数千 km s$^{-1}$。慢风情形下，档案光谱在 95% 置信度排除 $f_{\rm Edd}=2\times10^{-6}$ 时 $\dot M_{\rm w}>2\times10^{-9}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$，以及 $f_{\rm Edd}=10^{-5}$ 时 $\dot M_{\rm w}>2.6\times10^{-10}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$；不过这些 $f_{\rm Edd}$ 已高于远星点 Chandra 上限 $f_{\rm Edd}<7.6\times10^{-7}$。在两个模拟观测方案中，只有 2029 年近星点附近约 25 个 epoch 能超越现有观测上限。慢风的捕获率近似恒定，因此 **$\ge5\sigma$ 的 H$\alpha$ 探测将意味着吸积状态比 2024 年上限高 2–3 倍**。快风的捕获比例在近星点升高 14 倍，观测方案可探测 $\dot M_{\rm w}\simeq10^{-8}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$ 且 $f_{\rm Edd}\gtrsim1.2\times10^{-6}$ 的情形，而该 $f_{\rm Edd}$ 仍被远星点上限允许。**在 Chandra 上限以下，慢风不产生可探测谱线**。
summary: Gaia BH3, a $32.7\,M_\odot$ black hole (BH) on an 11.6-yr, $e=0.73$ orbit around a metal-poor giant at $\approx590$ pc, accretes from its wind. Neither its mass-loss rate $\dot M_{\rm w}$ nor the fraction of captured gas reaching the BH is known. We ask whether optical and ultraviolet lines from gas photoionized by the hot flow are observable and what they reveal. Unlike X-ray and radio data, they count the ionizing photons the gas absorbs and trace its density and velocity. With Cloudy we compute the H$α$ and He II 4686 emission of the wind and inflow along the orbit for $\dot M_{\rm w}=10^{-11}$-$10^{-8}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$, Eddington ratios $f_{\rm Edd}=10^{-8}$-$10^{-5}$ and wind speeds of 30 (slow) and 100 km s$^{-1}$ (fast), and test each model against archival UVES and ESPRESSO spectra. $f_{\rm Edd}$ mainly sets the lines; in dense models they come from gas falling freely onto the BH, spread over thousands of km s$^{-1}$. The archival spectra exclude $\dot M_{\rm w}>2\times10^{-9}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$ at $f_{\rm Edd}=2\times10^{-6}$ and $>2.6\times10^{-10}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$ at $10^{-5}$ (95%, slow wind), Eddington ratios already excluded by the apastron Chandra limit, $f_{\rm Edd}<7.6\times10^{-7}$. Of two simulated campaigns, only 25 epochs around the 2029 periastron go beyond existing limits. For a slow wind, whose capture rate is constant, a $\ge5σ$ H$α$ detection would imply an accretion state 2-3 times above the 2024 limit. For a fast wind, whose captured fraction rises 14-fold toward periastron, the campaign detects $\dot M_{\rm w}\simeq10^{-8}\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr^{-1}}$ for $f_{\rm Edd}\gtrsim1.2\times10^{-6}$, which the apastron limit allows. Below the Chandra limit, a slow wind produces no detectable line.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Astrophysics and Cosmology
background_knowledge: 现代天体物理与宇宙学本质上是一门关于「关系」的学科：星系并非孤立存在，而是嵌于宇宙网的大尺度环境中；暗物质晕拥有随时间演化的并合树；探测器中的光子击中则构成不规则的点云。传统分析常把天体当作独立同分布的样本，或把数据投影到规则网格上用卷积网络处理，但这样会损失或扭曲数据本身的几何结构。图 $G=(V,E)$ 以节点表示对象、以边表示对象之间的关系，可自然地编码空间、时间乃至因果联系。图神经网络（GNN）的核心是消息传递机制：每个节点依据邻居信息迭代更新自身表示，$h_i^{(l+1)} = \phi\big(h_i^{(l)}, \bigoplus_{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)} \psi(h_i^{(l)}, h_j^{(l)}, e_{ij})\big)$，其中聚合算子 $\bigoplus$（求和、均值、最大值等）对邻居顺序不敏感，因此模型天然具备置换等变性，并能容纳平移、旋转等已知对称性。在几何深度学习视角下，卷积网络可视为定义在规则网格上的图网络，Transformer 可视为在全连接图上进行注意力型消息传递，二者均为同一几何蓝图的特例。这一框架使模型更轻量、物理含义更清晰、可解释性更强，成为近年天体物理中快速兴起的建模范式。
contribution: 这是一篇系统性综述，其核心论点是 **GNN 往往比其它架构更适合物理学与物理数据**：GNN 契合领域与信号的固有几何，便于嵌入研究者已建立并信赖的对称性与先验知识，又足够灵活以刻画尚未理解的结构；其物理直观的工作方式还使其 **比其它深度学习架构更具可解释性**。文章从深度学习几何的一般原理出发，自底向上地构造图与 GNN，并给出统一的几何蓝图，说明卷积网络与 Transformer 均可视为该蓝图的特例。综述覆盖宇宙学、星系形成、动力学与观测仪器等多个方向的应用，并勾勒出该领域的前沿。**一个值得注意的定量结论是：在仪器类之外的研究中，仅约六分之一的工作将 GNN 用于真实观测数据，其余仍局限于模拟数据**。作者还提炼出一套最佳实践准则，其中包括在何种情形下不应诉诸图结构。
summary: Physics seldom makes breakthroughs when we consider objects only in isolation. Instead we model and measure how objects sit among their neighbours, spatial, temporal, or otherwise: a galaxy in its environment, a halo in its history, a photon hit in a detector. Graphs are ideally suited for encoding exactly these relations, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) learn the geometric functions that respect them. This review presents the use of GNNs for astrophysics and cosmology, and argues that GNNs often suit physics and physical data better than any alternative: they fit the native geometry of the domain and the signal, enable the incorporation of the symmetries and prior knowledge we already trust and have toiled to build, and stay flexible enough to capture what we do not yet understand. GNNs' physically intuitive workings also render them more interpretable than other deep-learning architectures. We show how we can begin from general principles of the geometry of deep learning and build the graph and the graph neural network from the ground up, and how other architectures, like the convolutional network and the transformer, can be seen as special cases of one unified geometric blueprint. We survey applications across cosmology, galaxy formation, dynamics, and instrumentation; and we chart the frontier. From this survey, we find that only one in six articles outside instrumentation applies GNNs to data rather than just simulations. We also distil a set of best practices, including when not to reach for a graph. Throughout, we will prioritise physical intuition and foundational principles over mathematical machinery whenever possible.

title: Elementary-Symmetric Ricci Gravity: Metric Formulation
background_knowledge: 现代引力理论以广义相对论为基础：时空度规 $g_{\mu\nu}$ 的动力学由 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量中的 Ricci 标量 $R$ 描述，物质能动张量决定时空曲率，而真空中的宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 可给出 de Sitter 型加速膨胀，被广泛用于描述暴胀与暗能量。为处理量子引力、宇宙学常数及早期/晚期加速膨胀等问题，研究者常构造修改引力理论，在作用量中加入曲率不变量。此类理论必须回答几个基本问题：度规变分得到的场方程是什么、真空解有哪些、线性扰动中包含哪些自由度、这些自由度是否稳定，以及背景宇宙学方程是否给出可行的膨胀历史。一般而言，高阶曲率项可能引入额外的标量自由度甚至 ghost 或快子不稳定性，因此需要在最大对称背景附近做线性化，将扰动分解为标量、矢量与自旋-2 张量模式并检验经典稳定性。Ricci 张量的初等对称多项式 $e_k$ 是由 $R^\mu{}_\nu$ 的本征值构造的一类自然曲率不变量，其线性组合可视为对 Ricci 标量理论的一种推广；相应的真空结构可能包括 Einstein 空间以及 Ricci 张量协变常数的平行-Ricci 空间。宇宙学上，这类理论通常给出推广的 Friedmann 约束与演化方程，其 de Sitter 不动点的存在性与稳定性直接关系到暴胀能否发生、持续以及如何结束。
contribution: 本文研究一个四维度规引力理论，其拉格朗日量为 Ricci 张量初等对称多项式的线性组合。作者推导了场方程，刻画了 Einstein 真空以及一类实、可对角化的平行-Ricci 真空；后者包含两个常曲率曲面的直积，并可呈现曲率半径的层级结构。对于 Einstein 真空，作者发现其具有与某个多项式不同根相对应的多个分支，而该多项式的重根定义了参数空间中的边界。论文进一步在最大对称背景上推导线性化方程，区分标量自由度与自旋-2 自由度，并分析其经典线性稳定性。作者还得到推广的 Friedmann 约束及相应的均匀演化方程。一个示例性空间平坦解从某个不稳定 de Sitter 解附近演化到稳定 de Sitter 解；**这一行为可能为早期与晚期加速膨胀的研究提供动机，并给出一种由引力本身驱动的暴胀自动结束机制**。
summary: We investigate a four-dimensional metric theory of gravity whose Lagrangian is a linear combination of the elementary symmetric polynomials of the Ricci tensor. We derive the field equations and characterize Einstein vacua and a real, diagonalizable class of parallel-Ricci vacua. The latter includes direct products of two constant-curvature surfaces and can exhibit a hierarchy of curvature radii. The Einstein vacua possess multiple branches associated with the distinct roots of a polynomial, whose multiple roots define boundaries in parameter space. We derive the linearized equations on maximally symmetric backgrounds, distinguish the scalar and spin-2 degrees of freedom, and then analyze their classical linear stability. We also obtain the generalized Friedmann constraint and the associated homogeneous evolution equations. An illustrative spatially flat solution evolves from the neighborhood of an unstable de Sitter solution toward a stable de Sitter solution. This behavior may motivate further investigation into early- and late-time accelerated expansion and provide a gravity-driven mechanism for automatic end of inflation.

title: A Natural Dark Matter-Dark Energy Interaction from Axion-Monopole Dynamics
background_knowledge:
现代宇宙学标准图像认为，宇宙能量预算中约四分之一为冷暗物质（CDM），约七成为暗能量（DE）。CDM 通过引力成团，解释星系旋转曲线、星系团质量、宇宙微波背景（CMB）以及大规模结构；暗能量驱动当前宇宙加速膨胀，通常用宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 或具有负压的动态标量场描述。
\n传统 $\Lambda$ CDM 模型把暗物质与暗能量视为彼此分离的组分，但二者的相互作用（interacting dark energy，IDE）是自然且重要的扩展：若二者交换能量与动量，会改变背景膨胀历史和结构增长，可能影响 $H_0$、$S_8$ 等宇宙学张力，并改变 DESI 等巡天对动态暗能量的限制。构建这类模型既需要具体的粒子物理机制，也必须控制量子修正，否则相互作用诱导的势能可能远大于暗能量标度，造成自然性问题。
\n在粒子物理方面，轴子（axion）是超轻赝标量场，可作为暗能量或第五力媒介；'t Hooft-Polyakov 磁单极子是非阿贝尔暗规范理论中的拓扑孤子，可作为暗物质候选。Witten 效应使磁单极获得依赖轴子场的电荷与质量，形成 dyon 态，从而把暗物质与暗能量联系起来。宇宙双折射描述 CMB 偏振面在传播中发生旋转，常由轴子-光子耦合等宇称破缺机制产生，是检验超轻轴子与暗能量模型的重要宇宙学探针。
contribution:
论文提出一个基于暗规范扇区中轴子-磁单极子动力学的自然暗物质-暗能量相互作用框架。具体而言，暗物质由暗 't Hooft-Polyakov 磁单极子构成，暗能量为超轻轴子；轴子与暗规范场的耦合通过 Witten 效应诱导依赖轴子场的 dyon 质量，从而产生直接的暗物质-暗能量相互作用。
\n作者指出，一般具有显著暗物质-暗能量耦合的模型存在自然性问题：相互作用诱导的 Coleman-Weinberg 势通常远大于暗能量标度。本文模型中，量子修正来自 dyon 态的 monodromy 塔，可被指数压低。**在最小设定下，相互作用强度被预言为约 $0.1\%$，低于当前观测灵敏度。**
\n文章进一步讨论，宇宙学尺度上较高电荷 dyon 的布居可将相互作用增强到百分之一量级，并产生表观上为 phantom 的暗能量状态方程。**拟合暗能量光谱仪（DESI）结果所偏好的轴子-磁单极子模型参数空间，也能以较小的反常系数自然解释宇宙双折射。**
summary: We propose a natural framework for interacting dark matter and dark energy based on axion-monopole dynamics in a dark gauge sector. Dark matter is composed of dark 't Hooft-Polyakov monopoles, while dark energy is an ultralight axion whose coupling to the dark gauge field induces an axion-dependent dyon mass through the Witten effect. This generates a direct dark matter-dark energy interaction. We show that generic models with a significant dark matter-dark energy coupling suffer from a naturalness problem: the Coleman-Weinberg potential induced by the interaction is typically much larger than the dark energy scale. In our model, the corrections arise from a monodromy tower of dyon states, allowing them to be exponentially suppressed. In the minimal setup, the interaction strength is predicted to be $\sim 0.1\%$, below the sensitivity of current observations. We discuss scenarios in which cosmological population of higher-charge dyons can enhance the interaction to the percent level, producing an apparent phantom dark energy equation of state. We further show that the parameter space of the axion-monopole model preferred by fitting the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) results can also naturally explain the cosmic birefringence with a small anomaly coefficient.

title: VVV CL001: A strong candidate for the most ancient star cluster in the Galaxy
background_knowledge: 球状星团是银河系中最古老的天体系统之一，其年龄、金属丰度和轨道性质记录了银河系早期组装历史。研究这类天体通常依赖颜色-星等图（CMD）：通过多波段测光获得恒星在温度、光度上的分布，再用等龄线拟合主序转折点（MSTO）确定年龄，用水平分支和等龄线确定距离，同时需要考虑星际消光与红化。成员星筛选常结合自行、测光质量和聚类算法，以降低场星污染。对于极老、极贫金属的球状星团，精确年龄可约束银河系年龄的下限；其轨道和金属丰度还可区分原位形成与吸积来源，并帮助理解银河系核球及原银河系早期组装。
contribution: 论文针对银河系核球方向、金属丰度约为 $[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}] \sim -2.2$ dex 的球状星团 VVV CL001，利用 FourStar/Baade PSF 测光联合 HST 近红外宽滤光片 PSF 测光，构建了迄今最深的 $J$、$K_S$ 颜色-星等图；通过自行计算和 HDBSCAN 算法筛选成员，并在五维参数空间中用 MCMC 迭代赋予成员概率。作者利用 DECam/Blanco 的 $r$ 波段数据证认水平分支成员，结合等龄线拟合得到 $d = 7.34 \pm 0.46$ kpc，为迄今最精确的距离；由主序转折点附近成员及不同等龄线组得到年龄 $13.4 \pm 0.4$ Gyr，**表明 VVV CL001 是银河系最古老球状星团之一**。轨道分析确认该星团属于银河系核球；结合其年老年龄与低金属丰度，**它可能关联早期原银河系的组装过程，并扩展已知原位球状星团的贫金属端**。
summary: Finding the oldest globular cluster of the Galaxy is important to constrain a lower limit on the age of the Galaxy and the Universe. VVV CL001 ([l,b]= [5.26,0.77]) is perhaps the most metal-poor ([Fe/H]~-2.2 dex) globular cluster in the Galactic bulge and a promising candidate to be the oldest globular cluster in the entire Milky Way. Due to its recent discovery and high extinction, its physical parameters, especially the distance and age, remain highly uncertain, yet they are essential to define it as an ancient native stellar system of the Milky Way. We aim to refine the distance and age of VVV CL001 using deep and high-quality photometry, to study its role in the formation of the Milky Way, and to determine whether it is the oldest Galactic globular cluster. We used J and KS observations to construct the deepest CMD of VVV CL001 to date, based on FourStar/Baade PSF photometry combined with HST near-IR wide-filter PSF photometry. We selected cluster members through proper motion calculations and the HDBSCAN algorithm, and assigned membership probabilities via Markov-Chain Monte Carlo iterations in a 5-dimensional parameter space. Using r band data from DECam/Blanco, we optically identified horizontal branch members and applied an isochrone-fitting technique to determine the cluster distance, while members around the main-sequence turn-off yielded the age from different isochrone sets. Finally, we refined the cluster orbital parameters. We obtained a distance of d = 7.34 +- 0.46 kpc, the most precise to date. We derived an age of 13.4 +- 0.4 Gyr, indicating that VVV CL001 is one of the oldest globular clusters in the Galaxy. The orbit confirms that the cluster belongs to the Galactic bulge, which, together with its age and metallicity, could link it to the early proto-Milky Way assembly, extending the metal-poor end of the known in situ globular clusters.

title: Estimator Precision and Selection for Up-the-Ramp Sampling with a High-Read-Noise InGaAs Camera
background_knowledge: 该工作属于天文近红外探测器读出与图像处理、测光精度领域。InGaAs 相机在近红外波段具有较高且随增益变化的读出噪声。现代红外阵列常采用 up-the-ramp 非破坏性读出：在曝光内多次采样像素电荷，并用时间序列斜率估计入射计数率。每个采样含读出噪声，信号本身还受 Poisson 噪声支配；当总计数率、拟合时间跨度与单次读出噪声满足一定比例时，最优加权方式会改变。广义最小二乘（GLS）在已知协方差时给出最小方差无偏估计，是精度基准，但需要完整噪声模型且计算复杂；普通最小二乘（OLS）忽略采样间权重差异，相关双采样（CDS）只用首末样本作差分，二者实现简单但可能损失精度。估计器选择因此是精度、复杂度与噪声工作点之间的权衡。
contribution: 论文以已知协方差的广义最小二乘（GLS）为精度基准，系统评估普通最小二乘（OLS）与相关双采样（CDS）在不同噪声工作点的适用性和精度代价。定义 $\eta=fT/\sigma_\mathrm{R}^2$，其中 $f$ 为总像素计数率、$T$ 为拟合跨度、$\sigma_\mathrm{R}$ 为单次读出噪声。对于恒定通量、均匀采样以及独立白读出噪声加 Poisson 噪声，已有有限采样方差表达式表明：当 $\eta=10$ 且 $N\ge4$ 次读出时 OLS 与 CDS 方差相等；低于该边界时 OLS 更优，高于该边界时 CDS 更优。针对三种增益模式的解析与 Monte Carlo 比较量化了较优简化估计器相对 GLS 的精度损失。在高增益在轨数据中，20 s 时选择 OLS、90 s 时选择 CDS，相比两迭代可行广义最小二乘（FGLS），背景残差标准差分别增加 **3.55%** 和 **3.01%**。对 21 个共同源做测光，未能清晰分辨大多数估计器之间的差异。观测到的 OLS-CDS 交叉早于理想预测，说明超出理想模型的时间协方差也影响选择边界。观测验证仅限高增益；中、低增益下的选择依赖使用标定参数的理论和模拟。总体而言，在合适工作点 OLS 或 CDS 可以替代 GLS 而仅有较小精度损失；**理想判据可作为初始选择规则，但实际边界需依据观测时间协方差进行验证**。
summary: The noise properties of an InGaAs camera vary with gain, requiring a trade-off between implementation complexity and precision. Using generalized least squares (GLS) with known covariance as the precision benchmark, we examine the applicability and precision penalties of ordinary least squares (OLS) and correlated double sampling (CDS) at different noise operating points. We define $η=fT/σ_\mathrm{R}^2$, where $f$ is the total pixel count rate, $T$ the fitting span, and $σ_\mathrm{R}$ the single-read noise. For constant flux, uniform sampling, and independent white read noise plus Poisson noise, established finite-sampling variance expressions give equal OLS and CDS variances at $η=10$ for $N\ge4$ reads; OLS is favored below this boundary and CDS above it. Analytical and Monte Carlo comparisons for three gain modes quantify the precision loss of the better simplified estimator relative to GLS. In high-gain on-sky data, choosing OLS at 20 s and CDS at 90 s increases the background residual standard deviation by 3.55% and 3.01%, respectively, relative to two-iteration feasible GLS (FGLS). Photometry of 21 common sources does not clearly resolve most estimator differences. The observed OLS-CDS crossover occurs earlier than the ideal prediction, indicating that temporal covariance beyond the ideal model also affects the selection boundary. Observational validation is limited to high gain; medium- and low-gain choices rely on theory and simulations using calibrated parameters. OLS or CDS can replace GLS with a small precision penalty at suitable operating points. The ideal criterion provides an initial selection rule, whose practical boundary requires validation against observed temporal covariance.

title: Gaussian process-based Bayesian imaging of bolometric (sub-)millimetre data
background_knowledge: 亚毫米/毫米波段（约 350 μm 至 4 mm）的单天线望远镜，特别是采用测辐射热计阵列（bolometric array）的仪器，具有扫描速度快、对较大空间尺度结构敏感的优势，适合测量星系团等扩展天体的毫米波总强度或 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 信号。此类观测记录的是随时间变化的总功率（time-ordered data）；要恢复天空图，需要把仪器响应、大气发射、光子噪声与仪器噪声同真实天文信号区分开来。大气水汽涨落在大尺度上高度相关，而光子噪声和仪器噪声主导小尺度，因此成像本质上是病态逆问题。贝叶斯成像将天空信号 $s$ 视为随机场，结合似然 $P(d|s)$ 与先验 $P(s)$ 计算后验 $P(s|d)$，从而在抑制噪声和伪影的同时量化不确定度。高斯过程先验用协方差核描述信号在空间或时间上的相关性；信息场理论（Information Field Theory, IFT）及其数值实现 NIFTy 则为高维贝叶斯反演提供变分推断和模块化生成模型。对下一代单天线望远镜而言，JAX/GPU 加速也是处理大数据集的必要条件。
contribution: 论文构建并验证了 maria-nifty：一个基于高斯过程和 NIFTy 的贝叶斯成像框架，用于从单天线测辐射热计数据重建天空图。其模块化生成模型能将天文信号与大气发射有效分离，并对重建天图给出逐像素不确定度；即使多个天体物理信号在天空中叠加，也能被干净地分离。作者先在 maria 软件生成的合成时间序列表上完成验证，随后将该方法应用于 Green Bank Telescope（GBT）上 MUSTANG-2 测辐射热计阵列观测的真实数据。对星系团 RXJ1347.5-1145，他们**成功分离了扩展的星系团发射与中心致密源**，并与同一数据的标准最大似然重建相比，**获得了更平滑、伪影更少的天图**。基于 JAX 的实现与 GPU 加速为处理下一代单天线望远镜产生的远更大数据集奠定了基础。
summary: Widefield single-dish telescopes operating at (sub-)mm wavelengths ($λ\sim 4$~mm to 350~$μ$m) tend to feature much faster mapping speeds than radio interferometers at the same wavelengths, and are more suitable for measuring signals on larger spatial scales. However, the data are dominated by atmospheric fluctuations on large scales and by photon and instrumental noise on smaller scales, making it difficult to recover the true astronomical sky. We build on maria-nifty, a Gaussian process-based Bayesian imaging framework for reconstructing sky maps from single-dish telescope data, implemented on top of Numerical Information Field Theory (NIFTy). It uses modular generative models to efficiently separate the astronomical signal from atmospheric emission while providing pixel-wise uncertainty quantification for the reconstructed sky maps. Moreover, our method cleanly separates individual astrophysical signals, even though they are superposed on the sky. Following its successful validation on synthetic time-ordered data generated using the maria software, we apply it to real data observed with the MUSTANG-2 bolometric array on the 100-meter Green Bank Telescope. For the galaxy cluster RXJ1347.5-1145, we separate the extended cluster emission from the compact source at its centre and obtain a smoother map with fewer artefacts compared to a standard maximum-likelihood reconstruction using the same data. The JAX-based implementation and GPU acceleration provide the basis for applying the method to the vastly larger datasets that the next generation of single-dish telescopes will deliver.

title: Globular Clusters GMRT Pulsar Survey (GCGPS) III: ORION - a multi-beam acceleration search pipeline
background_knowledge: 球状星团是银河系中由成千上万颗恒星组成的致密引力束缚系统，其核心恒星密度极高，双星比例和动力学交会频繁，为形成和演化特殊致密双星提供了理想场所。毫秒脉冲星是经历吸积加速的老年中子星，自转周期 $P$ 通常为几毫秒到几十毫秒，磁场较弱；它们多起源于低质量 X 射线双星，吸积角动量使其自转加快。球状星团因此被视为毫秒脉冲星的富集区，也是检验双星演化和星团动力学的重要实验室。射电脉冲星搜索的基本流程包括多波束或相控阵观测、消色散、周期性搜索与加速度搜索、折叠验证与候选体认证。星际介质中的自由电子使射电脉冲不同频率成分到达时间不同，形成色散，色散量 $\mathrm{DM}$ 越大，低频端延迟与脉冲展宽越显著；相干消色散可校正大部分效应，但通道内残余色散和有限时间采样仍会造成灵敏度损失。球状星团脉冲星常处于双星系统中，轨道运动产生多普勒加速度，使脉冲周期在观测期间漂移，因此需要加速度搜索甚至更高阶的 jerk 搜索。现代巡天还利用多波束接收、GPU 加速和傅里叶域滤波提高视场、灵敏度与计算吞吐量。
contribution: 论文介绍球状星团 GMRT 脉冲星巡天（GCGPS）Phase II 的观测策略，并发布 GPU 加速处理管线 ORION。Phase II 使用 SPOTLIGHT 系统同时形成 **160 个合成波束**，相较 Phase I 的两个相控阵波束大幅扩展瞬时视场；通过调节波束重叠和参与天线数，可在空间覆盖与灵敏度之间取得平衡。作者量化了通道内色散弥散与有限采样造成的灵敏度损失，并据此采用 Band 3 与 Band 4 的色散量上限分别为 **50 与 150 pc/cc**。ORION 将 PULSCAN 的高吞吐傅里叶域滤波与 PRESTO 的局部参数精化相结合。在单波束模拟双星脉冲星测试中，**ORION 相对基于 CPU 的 Phase I 管线将处理时间缩短约 15 至 30 倍**，折叠检测显著性相当或更高。Cycle 49 的实际观测验证恢复了 4 颗已知球状星团脉冲星，自转周期约 5.4 至 406 ms。使用 8 块 GPU 与 64 个 CPU 核心时，ORION 处理完整的 160 波束观测约需观测时长的 0.25 至 0.33 倍，即达到 **3 至 4 倍实时吞吐**。该工作为扩展球状星团脉冲星搜索提供了可规模化框架，未来将面向高加速度及 jerk 双星系统继续发展。
summary: Globular clusters host rich millisecond pulsar populations, but the known population remains incomplete. We present the observing strategy for Phase II of the Globular Clusters GMRT Pulsar Survey (GCGPS), which uses the SPOTLIGHT system to form 160 synthesised beams simultaneously, substantially expanding the instantaneous field of view compared with the two phased-array beams of Phase I. The configuration is tunable through the beam overlap and the number of contributing antennas, allowing spatial coverage to be balanced against sensitivity. We quantify the sensitivity losses from intra-channel dispersion smearing and finite sampling, which motivate the adopted dispersion-measure limits of 50 and 150 pc/cc for Bands 3 and 4. To process the resulting data, we introduce ORION, a GPU-accelerated pipeline that combines the high-throughput Fourier-domain filtering of PULSCAN with localised parameter refinement using PRESTO. In single-beam tests with simulated binary pulsars, ORION reduces processing time by a factor of approximately 15 to 30 relative to the CPU-based Phase I pipeline, with comparable or higher folded detection significance. On-sky validation with Cycle 49 observations recovered four known globular cluster pulsars with spin periods of approximately 5.4 to 406 ms. Using eight GPUs and 64 CPU cores, ORION processes full 160-beam observations in approximately 0.25 to 0.33 times the observation duration, corresponding to three to four times real-time throughput. Together, the Phase II strategy and ORION provide a scalable framework for expanding globular cluster pulsar searches, with future development targeting highly accelerated and jerked binary systems.

title: Illuminating Light Dark Matter with Fixed-Target Experiments
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学与天体物理观测表明，宇宙中存在大量不发光、不参与电磁相互作用的暗物质，其约占宇宙能量密度的四分之一，但粒子本质仍未知。传统暗物质直接探测主要假设暗物质质量在 GeV-TeV 量级，并通过与原子核的弱相互作用产生核反冲；这类弱相互作用大质量粒子方案迄今尚未给出发现。质量在 MeV 至 GeV 的轻暗物质可在早期宇宙通过热冻结产生符合观测的遗迹丰度，但其核反冲信号通常低于探测阈值，因此电子反冲、缺失能量或动量以及固定靶束流实验成为重要探针。固定靶实验利用高能电子或质子束轰击靶，测量散射电子、缺失能量或动量以及次级衰变产物，对 MeV 至 GeV 暗物质及其媒介粒子具有较高灵敏度。LDMX 是电子束固定靶实验，SHiP 是下一代束流 dump 实验。理论上，需要把模型构造、信号模拟、统计推断与全局拟合结合起来，才能将实验数据转化为排除、发现或参数测量，并比较不同暗物质模型。
contribution: 该论文围绕固定靶实验中的轻暗物质搜寻，构建并整合了从模型构造、信号模拟到统计推断与全局拟合的理论和统计工具。论文系统梳理固定靶轻暗物质搜寻版图，重点分析 **LDMX 实验**，并模拟暗物质在下一代 **SHiP 实验**中的特征以评估其灵敏度。针对最小暗物质模型，作者提出基于 **完整二维反冲电子分布**的似然统计框架，在频率学派与贝叶斯框架下统一处理排除、发现、参数估计和模型比较，从而 **确立 LDMX 的发现潜力**，并量化独立确认潜在信号所需的直接探测曝光。进一步，论文对 **标量和费米子轻暗物质**开展全局拟合，综合宇宙学、天体物理和实验室约束；将固定靶搜寻扩展到 **自旋为 1 的暗物质**及具有更高电磁矩的 **暗光子**，给出与其他探针强互补的丰富信号。最后，论文超越暗光子产生的标准核模型，引入 **弹性核形状因子**和来自多体 ab initio 方法的 **谱函数**，替代解析处理。
summary: Astronomical and cosmological observations provide overwhelming evidence for a non-luminous matter component, dark matter (DM), whose particle nature remains unknown. Experimental searches for non-gravitational DM interactions have largely targeted DM with GeV-TeV masses via nuclear recoils, yielding no discovery thus far. DM in the MeV-GeV mass range, however, is theoretically motivated, reproducing the observed relic abundance while remaining invisible to nuclear recoil searches. Such light DM is better probed via electron recoils or at fixed-target experiments. This thesis advances the theoretical and statistical toolkit for light DM searches at fixed-target experiments, spanning model building, statistical inference, global fits, and signal simulation. We survey the landscape of fixed-target searches for light DM, focusing on the Light Dark Matter eXperiment (LDMX). We also simulate DM signatures at the next-generation experiment SHiP to assess its sensitivity. Within minimal DM models, we present a likelihood-based statistical framework for LDMX using the full two-dimensional recoil electron distribution, spanning exclusion, discovery, parameter estimation, and model comparison in frequentist and Bayesian formulations. This establishes the discovery potential of LDMX, and we quantify the direct detection exposure needed to independently confirm a potential signal. Beyond this paradigm, we perform global fits of scalar and fermionic light DM, combining cosmological, astrophysical, and laboratory constraints. We then extend fixed-target searches to spin-1 DM and higher electromagnetic moment dark photons, yielding rich signatures with strong complementarity to other probes. Finally, we go beyond standard nuclear modelling of dark photon production, incorporating elastic nuclear form factors and spectral functions from many-body ab initio methods in place of analytic treatments.

title: ASTROLABE: A 3D Particle-Level Surrogate for Cosmology Simulation with Physical Flow Matching
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构研究暗物质、气体与星系如何在引力作用下，从早期宇宙的微小密度扰动增长为暗物质晕、纤维状网络、星系团和空洞。标准图像是冷暗物质模型（$\Lambda$CDM）：暗物质提供主要引力势阱，重子物质随后冷却、成星并形成可见星系；初始扰动近似尺度不变，经过辐射转移、线性增长和非线性塌缩，最终形成高度非线性的宇宙网。核心观测量包括功率谱 $P(k)$、双谱、晕质量函数、速度场、晕密度剖面以及重子声学振荡等。研究范式上，大尺度可用微扰理论描述，而强非线性区域主要依赖 N 体模拟和流体模拟；模拟以离散粒子表示相空间，并通过引力求解器演化。暗物质微观物理（如粒子质量、温暗物质、自相互作用等）会在不同尺度留下印记，因此需要扫描理论参数空间，但高分辨率模拟成本极高。机器学习代理或仿真器试图从初始条件直接映射到末态，但常受网格分辨率限制，或只能预测特定观测量，并且需要尽可能保持物理守恒律。
contribution: 论文提出 Astrolabe，一种基于 flow matching 的生成式宇宙学仿真代理，直接作用于 $N$ 个粒子的 $6N$ 维相空间坐标。由于输出不依赖体素网格，它没有体素分辨率上限，原则上可从推断结果中测量任意观测量。Astrolabe 采用场-粒子混合 Transformer，使每个粒子对多尺度场 token 做 cross-attention，从而让计算量和内存随粒子数 $N$ 线性增长。方法还引入物理 flow matching：将 flow 的先验分布设为基于 COLA 的近似共动拉格朗日加速度坐标，而非无物理意义的噪声，并在整个 flow time 上强制动量和质量守恒。在测试的 $\Lambda$CDM 情形中，Astrolabe 能产生真实的场，并给出准确的功率谱、晕质量函数、速度剖面和晕密度剖面；还表现出分布外泛化能力，可准确模拟暗声学振荡初始条件。它也可通过微调模拟非常大的 $N$，论文以远低于原模拟的成本模拟 TNG50-3-dark 作为演示。该工作**是迈向通用且强大的宇宙学模拟代理的第一步**，未来可能纳入重子物理，并系统探索更丰富的暗区相互作用。
summary: The microphysics of dark matter (DM) is imprinted on cosmological structure across an enormous dynamic range. Nonlinear cosmological observables are most reliably modeled with N-body and hydrodynamic simulations. However, systematic N-body scans over DM theory space are prohibitively expensive. Machine learning emulators provide a possible solution, but are currently limited by either low resolution or only the ability to emulate specific observables. We introduce Astrolabe, a flow-matching-based generative emulator designed to be free of both constraints. Astrolabe acts directly on the 6N phase-space coordinates of N individual particles. With no voxel grid in the output, there is no voxel-resolution ceiling, and in principle any observable can be measured from inference. Astrolabe is computationally tractable via a field-particle hybrid transformer in which every particle cross-attends to multiscale field tokens, so compute and memory are linear in N. Astrolabe incorporates physical flow matching by taking the prior distribution for the flow to be approximate COmoving Lagrangian Acceleration (COLA)-based coordinates rather than unphysical noise, with momentum and mass conservation enforced at all points along flow time. In the Lambda-CDM cases we test, Astrolabe produces realistic fields with accurate power spectra, halo mass functions, velocity profiles, and halo density profiles. We also observe out-of-distribution generalization, with accurate emulation of dark-acoustic oscillation initial conditions. Astrolabe is also capable of being fine-tuned to simulate very large N and we demonstrate this by emulating a TNG50-3-dark simulation at a fraction of the cost.This method represents a first step toward a general and powerful cosmology simulation surrogate, which may eventually permit the inclusion of baryonic physics and a systematic exploration of richer dark sector interactions.

title: Metal-poor molecular clouds in dwarf galaxies at parsec-scale resolution
background_knowledge: 分子云是恒星形成的主要场所，其性质决定了恒星形成的效率与初始质量函数。观测上，冷分子氢 $\mathrm{H}_2$ 缺少易激发、易探测的转动跃迁，因此通常以 CO 的转动谱线作为分子气体的示踪剂；但 CO 的丰度依赖金属丰度和尘埃遮蔽，在低金属丰度环境中辐射较弱、分布团块化，使分子云探测和云尺度统计变得困难。矮星系提供了近邻、低金属丰度的恒星形成实验室；借助 ALMA 等干涉阵列在秒差距尺度分辨分子云，并利用尺度—线宽关系、维里参数、CO-to-$\mathrm{H}_2$ 转换因子等诊断气体引力束缚、湍流与恒星形成关系，是当前该方向的重要研究范式。
